notes.title: The California’s Elegant Tradition Prevails with this Week’s Reward Car
notes.content:
Almost effortless beauty, classic styling, and impressive power come in this week’s 20 PTS reward car: the look-stealing, jaw-dropping [b]2014 Ferrari California T.[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d0d7ea1229af734a059936f614fb6740ed611097.jpg[/img]
Mounted in this car is the powerful, twin turbocharged 3855 V8 engine capable of putting out 552 horsepower. F1 inspired technology as well as twin-scroll turbines reduces turbo-lag to almost cero, meaning you’ll enjoy this car’s incredible power as soon as you step on the pedal 

The California’s design is as functional as it is appealing. Its size makes its handling capabilities shine even brighter, the engine is mounted closer to the ground which provides a much better center of gravity; finally, its chassis and body are made of aluminum to make it as light as possible. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/6de3c3944b96a0f978313d8f8daf89916aea21e6.jpg[/img]
If you have encountered any issues with this update, please make sure to report it on our [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting Hub[/url]. You will find other known issues we are currently investigating as well.

[*]80 PTS: [b]2010 Ferrari 599 GTO [/b]
[*]160 PTS: [b]1969 Ferrari Dino 246 GT[/b] [/list] 

[b]SPRING REWARDS [/b] 

[list]

[*]40 PTS: Backstage Pass [/list] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d30dd3c90a8c21e3465884e21dfc479be7f231fb.jpg[/img]
A new selection of cult classics is available to unlock this week on the Festival Playlist. Get your hands on a [b]1971 Meyers Manx, 1969 Toyota 2000GT, 2017 Volkswagen #34 Volkswagen Andretti Rallycross Beetle[/b], and a lot more this week.

notes.title: Explore Horizon Realms Today with Players from All Platforms!
notes.content:
Discover Forza Horizon 5's vibrant legacy with its latest update rolling out today: Horizon Realms. Venture into 11 previously limited-time only Evolving Worlds and the brand-new Stadium Track. Unlock new cars, Accolades, and Achievements! 

In addition to the Horizon Realms update, PlayStation 5 players will be joining us at the Horizon Festival for the first time ever as Early Access with the Premium Edition begins rolling out on the PlayStation Store. Get ready to cross-play with your friends across Xbox consoles, PC via the Microsoft Store and Steam, and PS5! 

That’s not all! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3339980/Forza_Horizon_5_Nissan_Retro_Rides_Car_Pack/]The Nissan Retro Rides Car Pack[/url] is also now available and included with the Ultimate Car Pack Collection. 

[h1]Diving into Horizon Realms[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/6121b288169425a5a8499e540f6b5b8cbc1adfc7.png[/img]

Not only is [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-horizon-realms]Horizon Realms[/url] reintroducing previously limited time only Evolving World locations, but it also comes with new reward cars to unlock, badges to collect, and achievements to earn.  

Once available, you can access the Horizon Realms feature by going into the “Campaign” tab in the Main Menu or going to Horizon Realms’ spatial indicator located to the left of the Stadium. 

If you are new to Forza Horizon 5, you need to unlock the Festival Playlist in order to play in Horizon Realms. The steps needed to do so are detailed in [url=https://microsoft.sharepoint.com/:w:/t/ForzaCommunityTeam/EY6lsdvmxGRAqa_hKfmUWHoB4OsbsD4fc0_R1KTZt7RcCw?e=pZctvf]this article.[/url]

[h1]Horizon Realms Reward Cars [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/251e428f55d0b89e55306eb06b04d7f503e9b481.png[/img]
Unlock these four new reward cars by earning Accolades on each of the 12 Realms available in this new update. This collection of rewards comes with amazing power and perhaps more wheels than you expected. 

[h2]2024 Lamborghini Revuelto [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/598867d138be0eb5b5bafd43f176ce4790fd3c33.png[/img]
The raging bull goes hybrid with the latest addition to its exotic hyper car collection: the 2024 Lamborghini Revuelto.  

The total power output of this car is the largest of any Lambo ever: 1001 bhp. 814 horsepower comes from the V12 engine set in the middle of the car, and the rest comes from three electric motors (two mounted on the front axles and one in the gearbox).  

Rear-wheel steering and improved stability make the Revuelto handle corners like a breeze.  

Plug into the madness of Lamborghini’s ultimate hybrid drive with the Lamborghini Revuelto. 

[h2]2023 Lamborghini Huracán Sterrato [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/854388421a86a94f487b3d9c0e3dbfbe7af5eadc.png[/img]
Lamborghini takes to the dirt with the 2023 Lamborghini Huracán Sterrato! The Italian brand’s icon of the roads gets off-roading modifications to take the dirt roads by storm. 

The Huracán Sterrato marks a very important moment in time for Lamborghini. It is the last “special edition” of the Huracán; it is the last Lambo to use the iconic V10 engine; and it is the first time Lamborghini put a Rally button on a coupé. 

The first noticeable changes come with adding a new air intake on the roof of the car and removing the side intakes to prevent the car from breathing too much dirt. Next comes a modified version of the classic V10 engine that puts out 601 horsepower! 

Flip the off-road switch in the raging bull, available in Horizon Realms! 

[h2]2018 Lotus Exige Cup 430 [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/c14f9f703b73a819e7b704de54c6673fa998703b.png[/img]
The ultimate Lotus experience has arrived at the Horizon Festival with the 2018 Lotus Exige Cup 430, an even stronger and loonier version of the Exige. 

Hidden in plain sight within the car’s name is its first impressive stat: the horsepower. The Exige Cup 430 produces 430 horsepower dispatched by a 3.5-litre V6 engine. While that number might not sound crazy, when it’s paired up with the car’s extreme lightweight and improved downforce, the 430 reaches 100 kph in about 3.3 seconds.  

Designed to fulfill your deepest track fantasies, the Exige Cup 430’s gorgeous design and crazy speed will not disappoint racing fans eager to dominate the courses of the Horizon Festival. 

[h2]2022 Hennessey Mammoth 6x6[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/c91cc5a457af9b3a2a80c25fcfbbe1c2846ed1ae.png[/img]
Trumpeting its way towards the Horizon Festival comes a speed behemoth with a prehistoric attitude. The 2022 Hennessey Mammoth 6x6 is the bulkier and meaner version of the RAM TRX built by Hennessey’s mad scientists. 

In case it wasn’t obvious enough, the Mammoth was built to dominate any terrain conceivable by its driver. The Hennessey team fitted a 6X6 rear axle locking differential, upgraded suspension, and 20-inch wheels.  

True to fashion, the Mammoth can also storm a track and score more than impressive times with its 1000 horsepower and 969 lb-ft torque thanks to several improvements made on its engine, including a 2.5-liter supercharger. 

Become the king of the Ice Age with the Hennessey Mammoth 6x6! 

[h1]See You at Horizon Mexico[/h1] 

Join our [url=http://discord.gg/forza]official Discord server[/url] and stay in touch with our community. You’ll be able to interact with more players, find builds and liveries to download, EventLab creations to try, photos taken by our community, and more.  

Subscribe to our [url=https://forza.net/newsletter]newsletter[/url] and stay in the know of all things Forza Horizon 5. 

Races, challenges, customization, and more are waiting at the Horizon Festival! We hope you enjoy your Forza Horizon 5 adventure.

notes.title: Dive into the Horizon Realms on April 25!
notes.content:
Forza Horizon 5 is getting one of its biggest updates!  

This April, the Horizon Festival evolves with Horizon Realms. 

[previewyoutube=3uloIoUR9xc;full][/previewyoutube]

This brand-new feature will let players dig into Forza Horizon 5’s history of Evolving World updates. Explore 12 fantastic Evolving World locations: 11 of the best previously limited-time locations and the premiering Stadium Track.  

Collect new Horizon Realms-exclusive accolades to unlock four new-to-Horizon reward cars.  

Revisit your favorite environments, or discover them for the first time, in Horizon Realms available for every platform on April 25! 

[h2]A Selection of the Best Evolving Worlds  [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/357d150f95ec02b08c8b03ec856397d2c5f16491.png[/img]

Horizon Realms gives players the chance to explore a hand-picked collection of some of the community’s favorite previously released Evolving World updates.  

Get ready to (re-)discover and adventure though these beloved locations while behind the wheel of your favorite cars:  
[list]
[*] Stunt Park  
[*] Ice Rink  
[*] Oval Track  
[*] Summer Party  
[*] Neon Airstrip 
[*] Día de Muertos  
[*] Winter Wonderland  
[*] Lunar Drift Arena  
[*] Retrowave Highway  
[*] Cars and Coffee  
[*] Stadium Maze  
[/list]
Along with these 11 returning environments, there will be a brand-new one: The Stadium Track! 
You can also race around this Evolving World with the new permanent race route coming to the game, the Horizon Stadium Circuit. You can find details further into this post. 

[h2]New Dedicated Accolade Tab[/h2]
A new Accolade Tab exclusive to Horizon Realms will be added to the game featuring 60+ accolades. While most of them are new to this update, you will also be able to unlock previously released accolades tied to the returning Evolving Worlds that are now accessible with Horizon Realms.   

Each of the Evolving World locations featured in Horizon Realms includes 5 new accolades to unlock! Find them under the Horizon Realms Accolades tab.  
You can also find an Accolade for the Horizon Stadium Circuit under the Road Racing tab. 

Complete Horizon Realms Accolades to acquire 12 new badges coming to the game. Plus, for the first time ever, unlocking an accolade will reward the player with #Forzathon Points! Go for a 100% in every Realm and unlock rewards with your newly acquired Points. 

[h2]Obtain 4 New Reward Cars [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a8d8c9c8e6ad30f1a1eb554a2d87f11e0ca526c2.png[/img]

Earning accolades will also score new cars for your garage. Complete unique challenges featured on every Realm to unlock four new-to-Horizon reward cars:
[list]
[*] Lamborghini’s take on a hyper hybrid, the 2024 Lamborghini Revuelto 
[*] Stomp the off-road scene with the 2023 Lamborghini Huracán Sterrato 
[*] The mightiest version of the Exige, the 2018 Lotus Exige Cup 430 
[*] Ride the king of the Ice Age with the 2022 Hennessey Mammoth 6x6  
[/list]
[h2]Two Ways to Dive into Horizon Realms  [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ca5cea549c0aa0e396dd269b1677323a4ac33f91.png[/img]
There will be two different ways to experience Horizon Realms:  

[h3]Skill Mode  [/h3]
hoose one of the Horizon Realms to enter and try to bank as much Skill Score as possible. Each Evolving World has its own separate Skill Score leaderboard, and there will also be a total Skill Score Leaderboard tallying up all points banked on each Realm – so try to take the top spot in all of them!  

Earning enough Skill Score will also unlock new player Badges unique to Horizon Realms!  
[h3]Free Mode  [/h3]
This mode puts the leaderboards to the side and focuses on players having a good time in their favorite Realms.  

Enter on your own or with your friends in a Convoy to explore your favorite Realms, obtain Badges tied to previous content updates, unlock accolades to earn #Forzathon Points, and more!  
[h2]Start Your Engines at the New Stadium Track[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/1454c12ad40aa25489223bc1af16b38477f9cedf.png[/img]

Line up at the starting line of a brand-new race route: the Horizon Stadium Circuit! Featuring corners, bends, and racing decorations, this new track will become a permanent race route in the game – complete with its own event icon on the map and Rivals leaderboard!  

Score your best time on this new race route in Rivals and Horizon Open, and explore the Stadium Track Realm in Horizon Realms' Free Mode and Skill Mode. 
[h2]Explore Nissan’s Heritage with a New Car Pack [/h2]
Four new cars from throughout Nissan’s automotive history will become available for purchase as Forza Horizon 5 releases for PlayStation 5 with the Nissan Retro Rides Car Pack. 

This new DLC pack includes the 1989 Nissan Pao, 1991 Nissan Figaro, 1989 Nissan Scargo, and the 1987 Nissan Be-1. 

Add these cars to your collection and customize them how you want! 

The Nissan Retro Rides Car Pack will be available starting April 25 for $4.99/€4.99/£3.99.  [b]Players who bought the Ultimate Car Pack Collection will receive this Car Pack at no additional cost. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8a8aa34d3e2bf941fb254a51522154e659f73696.png[/img]

notes.title: Forza Horizon 5 Comes to PlayStation 5 in Spring 2025
notes.content:
[h1]The Horizon Festival Welcomes a New Community of Players. [/h1]

With nearly 900 cars available in the game, over 40 thematic game updates, two expansions, and so much more content, our team is excited to announce that this spring, PlayStation 5 players will be able to explore Mexico’s beautiful roads and experience the Horizon Festival for the first time as we are officially launching Forza Horizon 5 on PS5.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2335f497b8bbf8c419e16322454719779283906c.png[/img]

The PlayStation 5 version of Forza Horizon 5, developed by Panic Button in partnership with Turn 10 Studios and Playground Games, will have the same content as the Xbox and PC releases of the game. Previously released Car Packs, as well as the Hot Wheels and Rally Adventure expansions, will also be available for purchase. 

We are excited to see the Forza Horizon 5 community grow with new players on PS5, and we can’t wait to see the creativity and skill these new creators, builders, and racers will bring to our vibrant community. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/5ef8d83fe04d12c46c61e0eb970c38775b3c9d04.jpg[/img]

In addition to bringing Forza Horizon 5 to PS5, we’re working on a special new free content update for all platforms, Horizon Realms. Realms will give players the chance to explore a curated collection of some of the community’s favorite previously released Evolving Worlds, alongside some other surprises. Stay tuned to [url=https://linktr.ee/forzahorizonofficial]our channels[/url] for more details soon.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7fb4cd9187d23b834b080bcfe7cc2528a9181e90.png[/img]

Wishlist Forza Horizon 5 on the PlayStation Store today to stay informed about updates and release times. If you already own the game on another platform, share the news with your friends in the PS5 community and tell them to get ready to join your convoys as cross-play will be available for all Forza Horizon 5 players across Xbox consoles, PC and PS5.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/09b97b7bce51c3554fce45197fca23133b6ddbdf.png[/img]

We look forward to welcoming new players to the Horizon Festival, and we are sure Forza Horizon 5 veterans will share their experience, tips, and tricks to make beginners feel right at home as they start their adventures. 

Join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/forza]official Forza Discord server[/url] to connect with other players, follow our [url=https://www.instagram.com/forzahorizonofficial/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/ForzaHorizon]X (formerly Twitter) accounts[/url] to stay in the loop, and [url=https://forza.net/newsletter]sign up for our newsletter[/url] to get more details about Forza Horizon 5’s release on PlayStation 5 and all things Forza. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2520b2047acf87cea61050ef3d664704f23c1771.png[/img]

Whether you are adventuring through Forza Horizon 5’s Mexico on Xbox, PC or PS5, we look forward to racing alongside you all at the Horizon Festival this spring.

notes.title: It’s Lights Out and Engines on with Midnight Muscle.
notes.content:
Time to flex and to race in Forza Horizon 5’s latest update: Midnight Muscle. This series brings back some fan-favorite Evolving World features such as the extended night cycles, Neon Airstrip, and neon decorations in racing events. 

Unlock two muscle cars from the modern era on Midnight Muscles Festival Playlist. 

A brand-new feature will let you pick your favorite cinematic Start Screen from previous Forza Horizon 5 content updates. 

Midnight Muscle also introduces the Festival Playlist Voting which lets players vote between two prior Festival Playlist to return to the game during the following month. 

Make those engines roar underneath the neon lights with Midnight Muscle! 

[h2]Release Notes[/h2]

[h3]New Features (Available from January 28)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cinematic Start Screen Selection 
[*] Festival Playlist Voting (From January 30 onwards) [/list]
[h3]"Midnight Muscle" Limited Timed Series Features (Available from January 30 to February 28)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Returning Neon Airstrip Evolving World and Drone Show 
[*] Returning Evolving World Neon H Collectible and Neon Tank Photo Decorations 
[*] Returning Neon Decorated Races 
[*] Returning Extended Nights 
[*] 1 Series Car Collector Accolade[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes and changes (Available from January 28)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Retroactively marked the Series 40 Horizon Track Day “ISO 200” Treasure Hunt Challenge as completed 
[*] Fixed an issue with the Horizon Backstage where cars in the Backstage Shop were not ordered by the date they were added 
[*] Fixed an issue with the 1971 Nissan Skyline 2000 GTR where the widebody kit front splitter couldn’t be painted 
[*] Fixed an issue with the 2014 Ford UTE where the lamps were incorrectly showing a ‘’CH_1’’ when braking [/list]
[url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409616884883-FH5-Known-Issues]You can find a list of issues we are currently investigating here.[/url] The [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting Hub[/url] is always open for you to leave any reports you have. 

[h2]Cinematic Start Screen Selection[/h2]
Available from January 28, players will be able to select their favorite Start Screen video from a curated list of favorites. 

Your selected cinematic will replace the traditional “Welcome to Mexico” default screen every time you boot the game.  

Players will be able to choose the following cinematics:
[list][*] Welcome To Mexico (Standard) 
[*] Welcome to Colorado (FH1) 
[*] Welcome to Europe (FH2) 
[*] Welcome to Australia (FH3) 
[*] Welcome to the UK (FH4) 
[*] Italian Automotive 
[*] Horizon Retrowave 
[/list]

If you can’t choose your favorite (we know how difficult it must be), there will also be a Shuffle option available which will automatically choose a different video every time you start the game. 

[h2]Festival Playlist Voting[/h2]
From January 30 onward, our community will vote between two previous Festival Playlists they want to replay next month! 

Head over to the “Playlist Vote” section (which replaces the Coming Soon section) and vote for one of two previous Festival Playlist options. The one with the most votes will be available to play in Forza Horizon 5 for the next 4 weeks. Voting starts on the first week of each series. The winner will be announced with a dedicated screen as week 4 starts 

The first Playlists available for voting will be Italian Automotive and High Performance, make sure to cast your vote before time ends! 

For more information, please take a look at our [url=https://aka.ms/FH5NewFestivalPlaylists]dedicated blog post.[/url]

[h2]Race Under the Neon Lights[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/bd94cc6bbbcf63aa00df48fbc6b3e68b783a8c80.png[/img]

Buckle up and start your engines to race underneath the neon lights decorating racing events this series. 

To enjoy the neon-lit scenery, the extended night cycles make a triumphant return as well! 

Aeródromo en la Selva becomes shrouded in lights once more as neon decorations and the Drone Show from Midnights at Horizons returns to this iconic location. 

If those features aren’t as bright for you, there’s still more coming. The Neon Tank Photo Decorations are coming back for Photo Challenges during the four weeks of Midnight Muscle. Travel to the Horizon Street Scene Outpost in week four to find and smash the Neon Cube Collectible! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/1f37cfefdfc4e29ebfe838a192afe19840d772bb.png[/img]

[h2]What’s Next [/h2]

Don’t forget to vote for the Festival Playlist you want to replay with the new Playlist Voting! The first duel puts [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-high-performance]High Performance[/url] and [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-italian-automotive]Italian Automotive[/url] head-to-head. 

There's still more content coming to Forza Horizon 5, so [url=https://forza.net/newsletter]sign up for our Newsletter[/url] where you can stay up to date with the latest news about the game!

notes.title: 2024 Forza Year in Review
notes.content:
[h2]Introduction [/h2]

2024 has been one of Forza’s busiest years yet, as both Forza Horizon 5 and Forza Motorsport continue to receive regular feature and content updates from our developers at Playground Games and Turn 10 Studios.  

With so many game updates to keep up with, this year we launched the [url=https://forza.net/newsletter]Forza Newsletter[/url], a periodic notification service that delivers the latest Forza news to your email inbox. Whether you prefer exploring offroad vistas, zooming through chicanes on circuits, or even doing both kinds of racing, there’s something for everyone in the [url=https://forza.net/newsletter]Forza Newsletter[/url]. (Psst... keep an eye out, and you might find some in-game goodies in a future newsletter...) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/2fc08563d1e161adb5dbaf6e5596f77e2163249c.png[/img]
[i]Livery by JDMADIAZ[/i]

[h2]Forza Community[/h2]

Cars and community—a combination made possible by game developers and game players, together. The Forza team is continuously inspired by the out-of-the-box and thoughtful creations made by the millions of Forza players across our games. While we’ve shared some examples in this article, our complete “Best of 2024” collections on the forums will let you peruse some of our favorite photos and livery designs. You may find a new signature look for your favorite car, or maybe you’ll be inspired to start creating and sharing your own in-game artistic talents! 
[list]
[*] [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/best-of-2024-in-fh5-photos/749897]Best of the year in FH5 Photos [/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/best-of-2024-in-fh5-liveries/749895]Best of the year in FH5 Liveries [/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/best-of-2024-in-fm-photos/749988]Best of the year in FM Photos [/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/best-of-2024-in-fm-liveries/749989]Best of the year in FM Liveries [/url]
[/list]

Forza Horizon 5 players--there’s still time to [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/official-fh5-golden-tank-awards-2024-vote-now/749234]vote for your favorite EventLab creations in this year’s Golden Tank Awards![/url] These fantastical and elaborate races, obstacle courses, puzzles, adventures, and tracks continue to evolve in quality as more players try their hand at building their own blueprint and placing props.  

2024 was also the year of creative UGC collaborations. Livery artist PTG Fluex and EventLab expert JohCee came together to produce "Miniracers," a project featuring four unique EventLab creations designed to evoke the charm of racing vintage toy cars in nostalgic and whimsical environments, with liveries inspired by classic toy cars. 

The collaborations went far beyond just individual players teaming up; one example is the fan groups Forza Street Wars and the Forza Creators Guild, who partnered to create compelling competitive courses that highlighted the technical skills of EventLab builders while challenging the racers of Street Wars tournaments with exciting and unfamiliar terrain. 

Arguably, the biggest Forza Motorsport community event of 2024 was the 9 Hours of Kyalami World Cup, hosted by TORA (The Online Racing Association) and featuring over 100 teams, with 350+ individual drivers. And yes, they all really raced for 9 whole hours! Congratulations to ESV Motorsports! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/df4e5911fb1a554794006c3df60d0146d717d711.png[/img]
[i]Livery by FormFirm
[/i]
[h2]Forza Motorsport[/h2] 

2024 was a steady year of progress for Forza Motorsport. Between 12 content updates, the game bolstered its lineup of cars and tracks, while also introducing several new features and quality of life improvements, [url=https://aka.ms/SHUB]many of which were inspired by the community voting on Suggestions Hub. 
[/url]
Some of the notable track highlights over the past year include Nürburgring Nordschleife, Sebring International Raceway, Road Atlanta, [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-13]Sunset Peninsula – last featured in Forza Motorsport 4[/url] – and most recently, Mount Panorama Circuit, Bathurst – home of the V8 Supercars Championship. 

Many new and returning cars were also added to the game, such as the 2024 Next-Gen NASCAR, 2024 Ford Mustang RTR, 2019 Ginetta G40 Junior, 2018 Aston Martin #97 AMR Vantage GTE, 2018 Saleen S302 Black Label, 1988 Chevrolet #77 Beretta Trans Am, and even more.   

There have been improvements to overall stability and performance, new game modes like Drift, Endurance and Multi-Class, and a host of new feature additions, including Car Proximity Radar, Spectate, Practice & Qualifying in Private Multiplayer, Advanced Car Ghosting, and more. [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-12]With Challenge Hub, it became possible to earn reward cars by playing either the Career or Featured Multiplayer,[/url] and we’ve continued making updates to other aspects of the game, including visual fidelity and audio quality, Drivatar AI, Forza Race Regulations, and Driver & Safety Ratings. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/b67b884db70d3fae2d3ef430675e645d088d8d83.png[/img]
[i]Photo by FRT Davi[/i]

As we work towards the future of Forza Motorsport, we started some new community initiatives this year to help ensure we’re going in the right direction. [url=https://forza.net/news/motorsport-community-august-2024]Our team has been sharing progress updates in our letters to the community[/url], and [url=https://forza.net/news/in-the-garage-frr-discord-ama]we kicked off a new “In the Garage” Discord AMA[/url] series to allow our developers to go deeper into the areas of the game that you care the most about.  

We also opened the Forza Insiders Program where you can [url=https://forza.net/insiders]sign up for the opportunity to participate in playtests[/url] of future Forza Motorsport updates on PC or console as well as share your opinions on game content in feedback surveys and our exclusive forums. 

We’ve celebrated [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-14]numerous partnerships throughout 2024[/url], including Mobil 1 – [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-8]with new Rivals challenges and a rebranding of Maple Valley[/url] – as well as Logitech, McLaren, and NASCAR. An undoubtable highlight was our sneaker collaboration with Jordan and professional basketball player Luka Dončić. This included a rendition of Hakone featuring the iconic Jordan brand, and all players were sent a custom 1969 Chevrolet Camaro Jordan Luka 3 Motorsport Edition. Players can compete in the Jordan Luka 3 Motorsport Series using this car – inspired by the shoe – to unlock a special racing suit, and [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-gamescom-2024]we also made the vehicle available to everyone playing Forza Horizon 5. [/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/5461975ba7fb0ba1ca60963fab5c11c6570f28e4.png[/img]
[i]Photo by Kerles[/i]

[h2]Forza Horizon 5 [/h2]

Never thought we could dribble around the roads of the Horizon Festival in a car like the 1969 Chevrolet Camaro Jordan Luka 3 Motorsport Edition, but 2024 was a year with a ton of surprises coming to Forza Horizon 5 that we hope you enjoyed and will keep enjoying while adventuring through Mexico.  

We kicked off the year with [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-Community-Choice]Community Choice[/url], a content update done partially with members of our community. Our players got the chance to vote which cars, features, and decorations they wanted to see back into the game. The votes were tallied, and the result was a series filled with neon lights at Aeródromo en la Selva, 16 returning stunts, 10 reward cars added to the Autoshow, and a Festival Playlist packed with European Exotics. 

That’s not the only time our community came together for an update. Back in March, the [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-Horizon-Race-Off]Horizon Race-off went live[/url]. This update gave our players a collaborative goal: complete street and off-road racing events to unlock two cars for the entire community! A new traveling outpost made its way to the Horizon Festival this series too. The Race-Off Outpost showed players progress on both the street and off-roading challenges, but the past part of this new feature is that it changed its location every week allowing players to explore the map to find it. 

Two months after the Race-Off, a wave of retro vibes took over the Horizon Festival with [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-horizon-retrowave]Horizon Retrowave[/url]. This content update featured a new start screen players saw (and many chose as their favorite) as soon as the game booted with the update. The Retrowave wasn’t only about the looks, but also the sounds. Forza Horizon 5 welcomed a new synthwave radio station: Horizon Wave. Hosted by Isabel Moss, the new station featured 21 new songs including a streamer friendly “Encanto Remix” by Mitch Murder.  

An exciting new game mode came to Forza Horizon 5 this year on the [url=https://aka.ms/FH5HiddenHorizons]Hidden Horizons[/url] update along with all the cars and content: Hide & Seek. This new 5v1 experience had players enjoy a thrilling game of chase between two teams. 5 players joined the game as the Seekers whose job is to find and stay close to the Hider in order to fill their meter. If the meter reached 100% before time runs out or before the Seeker reaches their destination, they took home the win! On the other side, Hiders had to use the environment and NPC cars to cover themselves and stay hidden from the Seekers until the End Zone location was revealed to all players. When the End Zone is revealed, their mission becomes to reach that location before Hiders complete their meter. The following game update, [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-back-to-the-90s]Back to the 90’s[/url], gave players the opportunity to unlock accolades and achievements related to Hide & Seek. We hope you still enjoy hiding and chasing as much as we have! 

EventLab creators had a great time this year with all the props added to the game that ranges from coffee cups, racing decorations, highways, elevation pieces, and of course the new Halo props that came in the [url=https://aka.ms/FH5HorizonTrackDay]Horizon Track Day[/url]. Our largest Prop Pack ever featured 71 pieces with iconic structures from the Halo franchise such as the Covenant Barricade, UNSC Barricade, Covenant Drop Pod, Energy Shield, Covenant Crate, UNSC Pelican, and more. Most of these pieces came directly from Halo Studios, bringing them right out of Forge Mode and into the Horizon Festival. Three songs from Halo’s OST were also added to the game during this series to FH5’s radio stations. Horizon XS now plays the Halo Theme Gungnir Mix (feat. Steve Vai) and Radio Eterna added Installation 04 and The Trails to its catalogue. 

Forza Horizon 5 saw an amazing set of car packs with a large variety of cars, including EVs, superstar racers, pop culture icons, and more. One of our community’s favorites was the [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-modern-horizons]Universal Icons Car Pack[/url], which included 5 cars from TV shows and movies: 3 versions of the Back to the Future Time Machine with movie-like lights and sounds, the 1982 Universal Studios K.I.T.T. (featuring the Super Pursuit Bodykit), and the iconic 1992 Universal Studios Jeep Wrangler Sahara ‘Jurassic Park.’ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/a0eff52cbb068a6bf5be2fd29c7e3a92ca35384d.png[/img]

[h2]A Fond Farewell to Forza Horizon 4 [/h2]

By the time this article is published, Forza Horizon 4 will no longer be available for purchase at online stores. However, the game is still completely playable, and the game’s servers are still running, so you can still hop in and explore Britain’s beautiful landscapes with other players in the open world! Remember that if you played Forza Horizon 4 on Xbox Game Pass and bought any DLC content for the game, you may be eligible for a game token that you can still redeem. [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-4-delisting]Please take a look at our blog post for more information. [/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/90219e2205f8c08a80cdd195ab77a16482b1b40e.png[/img]

[h2]Conclusion [/h2]

In the grand scheme of time, 2024’s coming and going marks 19 years since the release of the very first Forza game. That’s right—2025 is Forza’s 20th anniversary, and we’re planning some fun activities and surprises for the whole Forza community next year.  

Thanks for racing with us this year, and we’ll see you on the road in 2025!

One of our community’s favorites was the Universal Icons Car Pack, which included 5 cars from TV shows and movies: 3 versions of the Back to the Future Time Machine with movie-like lights and sounds, the 1982 Universal Studios K.I.T.T. (featuring the Super Pursuit Bodykit), and the iconic 1992 Universal Studios Jeep Wrangler Sahara ‘Jurassic Park.’

notes.title: Coming to your Garage this Month!
notes.content:
[h1]Horizon Holidays Mix-up (December 5 – January 2)[/h1]

[h2]Festival Playlist[/h2]
A nice quilt and hot cocoa inside a new reward car... is there any better plan for the holidays?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/763fea338d97aa9d3497e33adc2ca90527765785.png[/img]

To get you started on your winter adventures, we present four reward cars (three new to Horizon) during the four entirely wintry weeks of Horizon Holidays Mix-up, all with four doors and room for a ton of presents.

[b]2024 Nissan Z NISMO[/b]

[i]Complete the “Nissan Eazy” Seasonal Championship during Week 1 “Winter” of the Horizon Holidays Mix-up Festival Playlist. Available from December 5 until December 12.[/i]

For this season of giving, Nissan gave the Z a racing makeover and a nice little badge that reads NISMO. This not only means the car looks slicker, but it also performs better on the track.

To start, the Z NISMO found a new twin-turbo V6 engine that produces 420 reindeerpower, wrapped under the tree with its name on it. Next to it was a handling package that includes Akebono performance brakes and a track-focused suspension.

Instead of an itchy festive sweater, Nissan’s racing division gave the car a new aerodynamic look that evokes the brand’s past and improves downforce with side spoilers, air splitters, and a rear wing.

Unlock and customize this car with the included Liberty Walk Rear Wing and Widebody Kit!

[b]2021 Bentley Flying Spur[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/177c922374fd58eade2d65a91f8e9eff820cc306.png[/img]

[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 1 “Winter” of the Horizon Holiday Mix-up Festival Playlist. Available from December 5 until December 12.[/i]

Chestnuts are roasting on an open fire, and leather is covering your new favorite four-door AWD supercar, the 2021 Bentley Flying Spur.

This distinguished gentleman comes with a mighty W-12, twin-turbocharged engine that provides it with 616 [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower]reindeerpower[/url]. That alone allows the car to reach 100 kph in just over 4.5 seconds.

As luxurious as it is powerful, the Flying Spur’s interior is covered in high-quality leather and natural wood and metal finishes. If this car’s raw power isn’t amusing enough, you can also get it with a wi-fi package and, if the track did a number on your back, massaging seats are also available.

[b]2006 Mercedes-Benz E 55 AMG Wagon[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/3cd9f4ddd71ae68da95d7f0202f8210c631ffb2b.png[/img]

[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 2 “Winter” of the Horizon Holiday Mix-up Festival Playlist. Available from December 12 until December 19.[/i]

With room in the back for an entire team of toy-building elves and an engine you wouldn’t expect in a family wagon, the 2006 Mercedes-Benz E 55 AMG Wagon might be the car that can do almost anything.

Thinking of taking it to the track? Not a problem, the E 55 is equipped with a 5.4-liter, supercharged V8 engine built by hand that produces an astonishing 469 reindeerpower. That translates into a 0-100 kph time of just above 4 seconds and a quarter mile in just 12 seconds.

Not only is this certified mom vehicle fast, but its weight distribution and rear-wheel drive allow it to handle amazingly around corners.

The holiday season is better enjoyed with family and friends, so give them a surprisingly thrilling ride with the E 55 AMG Wagon.

[b]2022 BMW M5 CS[/b]

[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 3 “Winter” of the Horizon Holiday Mix-up Festival Playlist. Available from December 19 until December 26.[/i]

BMW’s M division does it again, this time upgrading the M5 and creating the thrilling 2022 BMW M5 CS, the most powerful M production model ever created.

For those wondering, CS stands for Competition Sport. This means the lightweight construction with carbon panels, strong V8 engine, and new sports suspension aren’t just a coincidence. In fact, the car was built with performance in mind, so much so that it can reach 100 kph in just 3 seconds.

An all-wheel drive system completes the performance package, putting all the 627 reindeerpower to good use, and the gold accents and wheels make the outside of this car an unmissable sight. Customize even further with AC Schnitzer body parts (a rear bumper, a side skirt, and one of two rear wings!). Drive the fastest and latest in BMW’s luxury-performance division with the M5 CS.

[b]2014 Cadillac CTS-V Sport Wagon[/b]

[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 4 “Winter” of the Horizon Holiday Mix-up Festival Playlist. Available from December 26 until January 2.[/i]

Superpowered, super luxurious, and super spacious. The 2014 Cadillac CTS-V Sport Wagon is everything you want in a luxury muscle car with enough room in the back for decorations and presents.

The Horizon Festival can’t have enough built-for-the-city cars to turn into track or off-road monsters, especially when they are packed with a turbocharged 2.0-liter, four-cylinder engine.

The biggest highlights of this car are found inside, with bucket seats covered in leather and a huge trunk to pack everything you might need for the holiday season.

Transform this family vehicle into a track shredder unlocking it on the Festival Playlist!

[h1]Horizon Extreme (January 2 – 30)[/h1]

[h2]Festival Playlist[/h2]

Four weeks of extreme flips and stunts deserve a daredevil that can match their freak, and the Horizon Extreme Festival Playlist has exactly that coming up.

[b]1965 DeBerti Chevrolet C10 ‘Slayer’[/b]
[i]
Earn 20 PTS during Week 1 “Summer” Season on the Horizon Extreme Festival Playlist. Available from January 2 until January 9.[/i]

This DeBerti build is all about extreme numbers: 900 horsepower, 6 wheels, 3 axles, 5 inches of adjustable height, and so much more packed in a car that’s as badass as they come.

In an effort to get as close as possible to 1,000 bhp while running on regular 93-octane gasoline, a 2020 GM LSX-B15 V8 engine provided by Chevrolet Performance was added as this monster’s beating heart. A hydraulic suspension from Mittler Bros allows the driver to lift the car an additional 5 inches, or keep it as close to the ground as possible.

Like a warning sign, this car sports red details all over the place to let you know the “Slayer” name is not a game; it is what this car came to do.

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]

Time to flex under the moonlight with Midnight Muscle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/179cc80f27355312cea82d671961ce49e1bf5ce3.png[/img]

This new update brings new events and reward cars, along with the return of the extended night cycle.

A new highly requested feature will also let you set your favorite start screen!

notes.title: Holiday Festivities and Extreme Experiences Return to Forza Horizon 5
notes.content:
Greet the season with a double whammy! That’s right, we have two content updates coming up: one before and one after the holiday season.

Starting December 5 and sledding until January 2, your favorite Horizon Festival holiday specials return, but this time dj scratch it’s remix of two in Horizon Holiday Mix-up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/f65f1f9be54bffac196fec3c44d79e9714e369d3.png[/img]

Gear up and start earning points to unlock four new cars available as your Festival Playlist rewards including the luxury cars, wagons, and more!

Two different winter-themed Stadiums will take over during every other week of the Holiday Mix-up. ‘Tis the season of racing!

From January 2 until January 30, flips, turns, and twists take over the Horizon Festival in Extreme Horizon, with the return of a special Stadium from Horizon PR Stunt Party and a new reward car to unlock. For our community’s creators, Extreme Horizon will also bring 4 new EventLab Stubs to build on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/308033a60e3d9c1c1b540344c6571d8833fb2485.png[/img]

Get cozy (and greasy) with the new content updates coming to Forza Horizon 5 for this holiday season!

[h2] Release Notes & Game Fixes [/h2]

[list]
[*] The following list details some of the fixes and changes we are implementing with this new update:
[*] Fixed the issue causing backfire to appear on the side of the 1970 GMC Jimmy instead of its back
[*] Fixed the 2022 Cadillac CT5V Blackwing’s roll cage obstructing driver and rear window view
[*] The logo on the 2021 Lamborghini Sian Roadster’s rear wing will no longer appear to be floating
[*] The 2022 Gordon Murray T.50 will now appear under the “European Hypercar” category
[*] Fixed an issue with the “Unbeatable Street Racing” Accolade which didn’t match its menu description
[*] Fixed an issue with the “On The Naughty List” Accolade which sometimes wasn’t unlocking after photographing the 1997 Lamborghini Diablo SV
[*] The 2023 Porsche 911 GT3 RS now shows the accurate badge on the wheels, and the silhouette displayed on the infotainment screen has been fixed
[/list]

[url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409616884883-FH5-Known-Issues]You can find a list of issues we are currently investigating here[/url]. The [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting Hub[/url] is always open for you to leave any reports you have.

[h2]Lights, Cameras, Outfit![/h2]

The best films of history come together to celebrate one of the most wonderful times of the year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/bf7083b34aaa5aa8d6f528e8cca1c3b786c9a407.png[/img]

Usher in the holidays by wearing the Classic Cinema Outfit, which you can earn by completing the “Snow Business” Seasonal Championship during Week 4 of the Festival Playlist.

[h2]The 911 Rallye Takes Over a Showcase Remix [/h2]

The holiday season wouldn’t be complete without a ghost or two: the Horizon Holiday Mix-up welcomes a remixed version of the On a Wing and a Prayer Showcase event: The Flying Deutsch-man. Your goal is to drive a Porsche 911 Rallye across multiple environments during different times of day.

Revisit one of your first adventures at the Horizon Festival on the third week of the Festival Playlist.

[h2]The Stadium Gets Festive in Two Different Styles [/h2]

The Stadium wraps itself in holiday cheer with two different winter-themed transformations taking place during the four winter weeks of the Holiday Remix.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/956debce8126618f2b68dca66e985eb5f8dbdb60.png[/img]

On the first and third weeks of Horizon Holiday Remix, enjoy the snow and decorations of the Winter Wonderland Stadium. Enjoy the view and coziness of candy canes, Christmas trees, and snowmen in this returning Evolving World feature.

You better have your ice skates ready as the Stadium freezes over to welcome the return of the Ice Rink, complete with hockey pucks, lines, and goals during the second and fourth weeks of the update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/63b5f71020f3829d7292d02253de29126c0e4ba0.png[/img]

[h2]Horizon Extreme (January 2 – 30)[/h2]

After the Horizon Holiday Mix-up ends, the Stadium cleans out the ice and snow and replaces them with the returning Stunt Park.

Visit Stunt Park to find ramps, half-pipes, smashable items, and more extreme additions to perform jumps and flips in the air.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2a579bd9853f4a2ae2ec3fac0d7914ab97d8b07a.png[/img]

During the first week of the Horizon Extreme Festival Playlist, explore the Stunt Park to find and smash the returning Dinosaur Pinata Collectible!

[h2]A Belated Gift for EventLab Creators[/h2]

The new year brings new ways to create events for the community to share and enjoy. Take your creativity to the limit with four new EventLab Build Stubs scattered throughout the Mexico map, available permanently starting January 2:

[list]
[*] Volcan Build Stub
[*] Montaña Build Stub
[*] Dunas Blancas Build Stub
[*] Sierra Verde Build Stub
[/list]

Get a breath of inspiration from these new Stubs and start creating new events!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/04b4b2edd045160ebae89543bf9adbb2902d8258.png[/img]

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/179cc80f27355312cea82d671961ce49e1bf5ce3.png[/img]

This new update brings new events and reward cars, along with the return of the extended night cycle.

A new highly requested feature will also let you set your favorite start screen!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/c9084fdeb877795692285fc7e69f1dde67ad7b2a.png[/img]

Your new best friend for track days is available to unlock. Gather 20 PTS on the Festival Playlist until November 14 to get the 2023 Porsche 911 GT3 RS’s engine running! 

The GT3 RS is everything you love about a 911 but kicked up a notch (or maybe two). Packed with a 4-liter six-cylinder engine, it can produce 518 bhp and 342 lb-ft, allowing it to fly to 100 kph in almost 3 seconds. 

Engineers behind this project brought ideas from F1 and applied them to this car, which led to improvements such as the 88 lbs of downforce this car makes, as well as the aerodynamic improvements in its body kit and adjustable wing. 

Made from lightweight materials from front to back, this Porsche was designed to obliterate tracks with you at the wheel. 

If you have any suggestions to make the Forza Horizon 5 experience better than it has been, visit our [url=http://aka.ms/SHUB]Suggestions Hub[/url] and let us know! 

Contact the team [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]on the Troubleshooting Hub[/url] if you see any issues with this new update or its features.

notes.title: Start Your Engines for Out-of-this-World Racing with Horizon Track Day!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7c286189a662b7446828a94152b014af8ce120c4.png[/img]

We are off to four weeks of racing with Horizon Track Day. 

Four modern Porsches line up as this month’s weekly reward cars. Earn Festival Playlist points and complete different challenges to unlock them all and go for a race on the different events going around the Horizon Festival. 

The largest EventLab prop pack we’ve ever made is also arriving, featuring different elements of a game series that’s out of this world. Save the human race (no pun intended) from extinction with the 71 props from the Halo universe coming to Forza Horizon 5 this month. 

Get ready to run around the Oval Track once more as this timed feature returns to the Stadium for the duration of this update. Joining the roster of returning features, we are bringing back the Helmet Piñata Collectible! 

Get your car to the starting line and make that engine roar on Horizon Track Day!

[h3]Release Notes & Game Fixes[/h3]
The following list details some of the fixes and changes we are implementing with this new update:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing player’s level to reset after a match of Hide & Seek 
[*] Fixed an issue where game crashes could break a player’s completion streak in Hide & Seek 
[*] Fixed an issue in Hide & Seek where sometimes players could cross outside the border area of the Playa Azul Map 
[*] Fixed the “Missing Required Keybinds” bug in the Wheel Settings menu 
[*] Added the 2021 Toyota GR Yaris to the Homologation Heroes category
[*] [url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409616884883-FH5-Known-Issues]You can find a list of issues we are currently investigating here[/url]. The [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting Hub[/url] is always open for you to leave any reports you have.  
[/list]
[h3]Race to Unlock this Accolade[/h3]
The Horizon Track Day Series Collector Accolade will be available for completionists out there to obtain. 

Unlock every Festival Playlist reward car available in this series to earn this new accolade. 

[h3]Halo’s Legacy Comes to the Horizon Festival with New EventLab Props and Options[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/fe09ec66ff3c8a89d809a2a6a3434e147e6e2953.png[/img]
[b]“Yes, sir. Finishing this build.” [/b]

Some of the most recognizable structures from the entire Halo saga come to Forza Horizon 5, in our largest prop pack ever. Halo Studios provided some of these props straight from Halo's Forge mode! Enjoy creating out-of-this-world events with the 71 Halo props added to the game this series. 

This prop pack includes:  
[list]
[*] Covenant Barricade 
[*] UNSC Barricade 
[*] Covenant Drop Pod 
[*] Energy Shield 
[*] Barrel 
[*] Health Pack 
[*] UNSC Packing Crate 
[*] Covenant Crate 
[*] UNSC Pelican 
[*] Totem Ring A 
[*] Totem Ring B 
[*] Totem Ring C 
[*] Totem Ring Chunk 
[*] Totem Ring Debris 
[/list]
You can peruse the whole list of Halo-themed EventLab props (nineteen of which have Snapping functionality!) in our [url=https://aka.ms/FH5HorizonTrackDayRN]Release Notes[/url]. 

Top off your creations with two new sky options available for EventLab creations. Bask in awe at the Halo Sky Day and Halo Sky Night options available to use as soon as the series rolls out. 

[h3]Turn Every Trip into a Mission to Save the World with Three New Songs[/h3]
A tribute to the Halo saga would not be complete without remembering the epic music that accompanied your missions through space. 

Three new tracks from Halo’s OST will be added to the game in two different stations as Horizon Track Day rolls out.  

Horizon XS will receive the Halo Theme Gungnir Mix (feat. Steve Vai) and Radio Eterna will get Installation 04 and The Trails.  

[h3]Drive Your Cars to the Limit on the Oval Track. [/h3]
The Oval Track returns once more to the Horizon Stadium! 

Experience extreme speed by driving close to the Oval’s edge and through the obstacles in the center of its track.  

Visit the Oval Track on the second week of Horizon Track Day, and after you are done going after a few laps, find and smash 10 Helmet Piñata Collectibles, the collectible coming back to the Horizon Festival this series. 

[h3]Vote for Your Favorite Creations in this Year’s Golden Tank Awards! [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8e873d74791d797bc656f316ca2dc935283557e8.png[/img]
The moment you have been waiting for, the day in which we celebrate the creations of our community has arrived: it’s time for the 2024 Golden Tank Awards. 

Like last year, our team will create a shortlist of nominees for each of the categories available. Then, our community of players will vote on who they want to see take home the gold. Any creations made until November 15 could be eligible for the shortlist. Keep creating and may the most creative players win! Feel free to share your creations (and discover others’ EventLab gems!) on social media using #FH5GoldenTankAwards. 

Here are this year’s categories:  
[list]
[*] Most Creative Event 
[*] Best EventLab Island Event 
[*] Best Race Event 
[*] Best Photo Location 
[*] EventLab Creation of the Year 
[/list]
Voting starts in December, and we will announce the winners in January 2025. Stay tuned for more details coming soon. 

As always, our game would not be the experience it is today without the effort of countless creators who spent hours upon hours designing events, liveries, photos, and more. Here's to another year of amazing creations from the Horizon community! 
[h3]
What’s Next? [/h3]
The Horizon Festival welcomes the holiday season with Stadium decorations, new reward cars and clothing items, and a special showcase remix!

notes.title: A Car as Rad as the 90s, Unlock the 1996 SUBARU SVX
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e45e4bb939eb343f6caed4844e84d51e9fa27139.png[/img]

The 90s came and took wrote down “extreme” in their description, and Subaru took of note of that. To match the vibe of era they made the 1996 SUBARU SVX, a car that could (and did) run from Seattle all the way to the Arctic Circle. 

Right of the bat is the SVX’s unique rood: The almost one-piece glass canopy built on top of this car was designed after aircrafts, which resulted in the car having different sections of windows. 

The SVX came with a 3.3-liter straight six engine that put 231 horsepower into all wheels thanks to its AWD system. All the aerodynamic design created a car that had a drag coefficient of 2.9, pretty close to hypercars of the era.  

Unlock a sample of the raddest era of all from October 31 until November 7. 

If you have encountered any issues with this update, please make sure to report it on our [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting Hub[/url]. You will find other known issues we are currently investigating as well.  

The throwback comes to an end with Treasure Hunts, stunts, and plenty of other challenges: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/4575fcc09bd875599d6f99ed66b92c27da7a8c11.png[/img]

[b]SERIES REWARDS [/b]   

[list]   

[*]80 PTS: 1992 Mercedes-Benz 500E   

[*]160 PTS: 1992 GMC Typhoon [/list]  

[b]SPRING REWARDS [/b] 

[list] 

[*]20 PTS: 1996 SUBARU SVX 

[*]40 PTS: Backstage Pass [/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/148bfc2680dca7dc54e4f0d201e70ffb634d32aa.png[/img]
The 1997 Toyota Soarer 2.5 GT-T has the futuristic feel of 1990s technology, and the power of a street racer put into one. 

Toyota’s move on the sports/luxury front came equipped with an EMV touchscreen (guaranteed to make you the coolest among your friends) and was one of the first cars to ever include an integrated satellite navigation system.  

The totally radical features of this car do not stop at its electronic gear, the Soarer has algo got a powerful heart under its hood in the shape of a 1JZ-GTE 2.6-liter engine that produces 278 bhp. 

Does the fun stop there? AS IF! The Soarer proudly presents an Origin Lab front bumper, rear bumper, side skirts and Forza front bumper and rear wing to customize to your liking. 

Unlock this car from October 10 until October 17. 

If you have any suggestions to make the Forza Horizon 5 experience better than it has been, visit our [url=http://aka.ms/SHUB]Suggestions Hub[/url] and let us know!

notes.title: Your Favorite Era is Back: Rewind Back to the 90’s on Forza Horizon 5.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/854cf6988148cd23d97f3a4827e8691327ae5a9e.png[/img]

The Horizon Festival jumps back to an era filled with boy bands, flannel shirts, CDs and VHS tapes in Back to the 90’s. Not only are we welcoming a ton of nostalgia, but we also wave hello to a returning feature: the Horizon Backstage. Unlock and customize four reward cars with a style that’s very fitting for the era (that means very geometric). Enjoying Hide & Seek? Get your grind on to unlock the 10 new achievements we have lined up for you exclusive to this game mode this series. You will automatically unlock these achievements if you managed to complete them before.A new collectible item makes its way to the Horizon Festival, and don’t worry, you don’t have to return this one any time soon.

Take a look at everything coming when we travel back to the 90’s!

[h2]Release Notes and Game Fixes[/h2]
[h3]Cars[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with the 1994 Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution III GSR where the yellow color was missing from the paint selection screen[/list]
[h3]Hide & Seek[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue in which players’ license plates weren’t resetting after exiting the game mode
[*]Fixed an issue in which players could activate the reset car feature while moving
[*]Fixed issues in which players weren’t able to join games of Hide & Seek through the Festival Playlist while on a Convoy
[*]Fixed an issue in which players starting Hide & Seek from a DLC map would be sent to the main map instead of starting the session
[*]Fixed accolades not being localized correctly in in German, Danish, Spanish, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Dutch, Russian and Swedish[/list]
[url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409616884883-FH5-Known-Issues]You can find a list of issues we are currently investigating here.[/url] The [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting Hub[/url] is always open for you to leave any reports you have.

[h2]Unlock Previous Festival Playlist Exclusive Cars in The Horizon Backstage![/h2]
The Horizon Backstage has returned!

In case you missed a previous Festival Playlist reward car, the Horizon Backstage will help you complete your collection. 

To purchase cars in the Backstage Shop you will need to get Backstage Passes, a new kind of currency to use only with this feature. Backstage Passes can be obtained in one of two ways: As a Festival Playlist Seasonal Reward for 40 PTS and on the Forzathon Shop for 1,000 Forzathon points. Therefore, you will be able to get 2 Backstage Passes per week!

To celebrate the arrival of the Horizon Backstage, you will receive a Backstage Pass via in-game message on October 10,  so you can try the Backstage Shop once it goes live!

The cars available for purchase in the Backstage Shop will be voted on by the community. Each week, two pairs of cars will be eligible for players to vote for. The winning pair will become available for purchase on the Backstage Shop the following Season. To vote, enter the Horizon Backstage, select Backstage Voting, and pick your favorite pair of cars. 

Get to the Horizon Backstage through the Pause menu or reach the spatial marker near the main Horizon Festival Site, then select whether you are there to vote or purchase a car!

However, you do not need to wait an entire week to make your first Backstage purchase. Here’s the initial list of cars available to buy from the Shop starting October 10:
[list]
[*]1980 Fiat 131 Abarth
[*]2021 BMW M4 Competition Coupe
[*]2013 Cadillac XTS Limousine
[*]1967 Mercedes-Benz 280 SL
[*]2016 Pagani Huayra BC
[*]2022 Rivian R1S[/list]
For more information on the Horizon Backstage, please visit this [url=https://aka.ms/HorizonBackstageFAQ]article[/url].

[h2]New Hide & Seek Achievements[/h2]
Been enjoying Hide & Seek? If you have, you are going to love going after the brand-new achievements added to the game with Back to the 90s. If you completed any of them before this update, they will be automatically unlocked for you.

[table]
[tr][th][b]Name[/b][/th][th][b]Description[/b][/th][th][b]Gamerscore[/b][/th][/tr]
[tr][td]Hider and Seeker[/td][td]Complete a match of Hide & Seek as both the Hider and the Seeker[/td][td]10[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Bounty Hunter[/td][td]Complete 25 matches of Hide & Seek as a Seeker[/td][td]20[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]The Hidden[/td][td]Complete 5 matches of Hide & Seek as a Hider[/td][td]20[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Dedicated to the Cause[/td][td]Reach a Streak of 20 in Hide & Seek[/td][td]30[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Never Back Down[/td][td]Reach a Streak of 50 in Hide & Seek[/td][td]50[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Lay of The Land[/td][td]Complete a match in every area in Hide & Seek[/td][td]10[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Catching a Break[/td][td]Successfully hit a total of 20 Seekers with Chase Breaker in a game of Hide & Seek[/td][td]50[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Blending In[/td][td]Win as a Hider in Hide & Seek[/td][td]15[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]The Big Reveal[/td][td]Win as a Seeker in Hide and Seek[/td][td]15[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Covering Ground[/td][td]Drive 50 miles in Hide & Seek[/td][td]30[/td][/tr]
[/table]

[h2]No Need to Rewind Our Newest Collectible.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/613dc3df6080b8198fec45b884f21281b0dbf548.png[/img]
It might not have 4K resolution, it might not have the best audio quality, it might not even fit in the VCR you have sitting in your basement, but we still hope you enjoy finding and smashing the Inflatable VHS collectible added to Forza Horizon 5. 

In addition to taking you on a trip through memory lane, the Inflatable VHS will also appear in a Festival Playlist Challenge on Week 3 of Back to the 90s.

In case you were thinking of opening your own video rental store in EventLab, this new collectible will also be available to use as a prop for your creations!

[h2]Your Childhood Memories Turned into Badges.[/h2]
We have three new badges coming for Back to the 90’s all featuring your favorite memories from that era.

Stay Cool
[list][*]Take a photo of the 1997 Toyota Soarer 2.5 GT-T during Back to the 90’s[/list]
Cassetting the Trend
[list][*]Equip the 90’s Outfit during Back to the 90s [/list]
Would You Like Help
[list][*]Drive 10 miles (16 kilometers) in any car from the 1990s in Back to the 90’s[/list]

[h2]Live the 90’s Vibe with the 90’s Outfit.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/fa0a9c9bc53ddfe0ff092249abcc59b42f4df30c.jpg[/img]
With those colors, textures and patterns, that outfit could certainly land you a spot on your favorite boyband.

Unlock the 90’s Outfit by completing the #DressToImprezza Photo Challenge on the first week of the Festival Playlist.

[h2]What’s Next[/h2]
Next month we’ll see new reward cars added to the Festival Playlist as well as new clothing items, collectibles, and EventLab props for your characters on Horizon Track Day!

notes.title: Mysterious and Elusive, the Limited C30 Polestar Arrives in FH5!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/26efb005f838851976e2ec20bf35fb1a84a8edd0.png[/img]
The final chapter of the mystery novel we call Festival Playlist is here. Complete its challenges to earn 20 PTS and get your hands behind the wheel of a limited production car: the 2013 Volvo C30 Polestar. 

Like Sherlock and Watson, Volvo partnered with Polestar to create a 405 horsepowered ready to race hatchback. With an aerodynamic design inspired by the C30 Volvo signed up for the Swedish Touring Car Championship and a 2.5-liter turbo engine; the C30 can run from 0-100 kph in just about 6 seconds. 

Find missing Captains, search for lost jewels, chase after supernatural dogs, or simply run around the track on this week’s 20 PTS reward! Unlock it from October 3 and until October 10. 

If you have encountered any issues with this update, please make sure to report it on our [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting Hub[/url]. You will find other known issues we are currently investigating as well.  

Finish the month of mysteries with a final adventure in the Horizon Festival:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/4fdbf5da389c7731846a75c99e56908bf7108252.png[/img]

Join a thrilling game of chase with Hide & Seek: the new multiplayer game mode available now in Forza Horizon 5. 

Play as the Hider and conceal your presence to reach the End Zone undetected or join as part of the Seekers to take home the win by staying close to the Hider and fill your meter before time runs out. 

This new 5v1 game mode includes crossplay functionality. You can also join solo or with a group of friends as a convoy.

notes.title: Discover the Mysteries of Our Latest Update in Hidden Horizons!
notes.content:
[h3]The time has come to grab your magnifying glass and get the hunting hat off the rack to uncover the secrets of Hidden Horizons! Your detective and hiding skills will be put to the test with the new Hide & Seek multiplayer mode. From the courts to the roads of the Horizon Festival, our latest partnership with Jordan features a custom version of a muscle car classic. 

The Stadium transforms into a giant maze for the next four weeks! Complete it using the platforms we have added and find its hidden treasure. Track & Field meet as this series’ Reward Cars features limited builds and all-time rally favorites. Sleuth and speed around the Horizon Festival in our latest update, Hidden Horizons![/h3]

[h2]Release Notes and Game Fixes[/h2]

[b]Cars[/b]
[list][*]2018 Lamborghini Aventador SVJ’s exhaust pipes are now correctly painted
[*]Fixed an issue with the 2022 Cupra Formentor and the 2022 Cupra Tavascan where livery decals were applying to the steering wheel badge
[*]Fixed the 2020 Lamborghini SC20’s brake caliper location and the rev red line
[*]Fixed an issue with the 2021 BMW M3 with some inaccurate textures on the M Performance front, side, rear and wing carbon fiber upgrades[/list]
[url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409616884883-FH5-Known-Issues]You can find a list of issues we are currently investigating here.[/url] The [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting Hub[/url] is always open for you to leave any reports you have.

 [h2]An A-maze-ing New Stadium to Solve![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/332abbde4b3c48094817483ebdcc3bf81c5569f9.png[/img]

Try to solve the maze that has taken over the Stadium during Hidden Horizons. This Evolving World Location comes with platforms that will help you find the exit to the Stadium and are also great photo opportunities to take solo pictures or group shots.

The Maze Stadium will also be featured in some Festival Playlist challenges, so be on the lookout for rewards to find inside this limited-time location!

[h2]Join a Thrilling Game of Chase with Hide & Seek[/h2]
[previewyoutube=Z32r8ECNNiA;full][/previewyoutube]
Forza Horizon 5 welcomes Hide & Seek, its newest multiplayer experience. 
In this brand-new game mode, a group of six players will take part in a game of chases taking on one of two roles. 

Hiders are tasked with remaining hidden from their opponents until the End Zone (the location the Hider needs to reach) is revealed. After the End Zone has been disclosed, the Hider will have to reach it before time runs out and before Seekers build enough points to take the win.

On the other hand, Seekers will be tasked with finding and staying close to the Hider. Doing so will earn them points to complete the Seeker’s Detection Meter. Seekers must complete their bar before time runs out and before the Hider reaches the End Zone to put the win under their belt. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0b1f847089ac090420cb9bb29d3fb34f9bf4eb52.png[/img]

Hide & Seek will have its own in-game progression system through which players will be able to earn badges and complete accolades unique to Hide & Seek.

Achievements for this game mode will be available in our next update!

To learn more details about Hide & Seek, read [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-gamescom-2024]here[/url].

[h2]FH5’s Latest Partnership is Nothing but Net (And a Custom Car)[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/1657f3fb9272895cdda3161a7fcd7c5ca4e611d9.jpg[/img]

Drive a classic muscle car inspired by a sneaker icon in our latest partnership with Jordan. 

Available through the Gifts Tab in your Message Center starting September 10, the 1969 Chevrolet Camaro Jordan Luka 3Motorsport Edition will let you dunk around the roads of the Horizon Festival in style.

[h2]Shroud Your Character with the New Outfit Available this Month[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8446dd89587258060d95b9d719da5301bc88ea4a.png[/img]

The best fit to match your all-terrain adventures is now available to unlock!

Complete the “Expedition” Photo Challenge featured on the first week of the Festival Playlist to unlock the Camo Race Suit.

Just make sure you are not taking pictures next to trees or in tall grass, OK?

[h2]Put Your Investigating Skills to the Test Finding Our Latest Collectible.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/911337f03d6858dc8db7a53adb415233b94e8bbe.png[/img]

Hiding within the Stadium Maze is a new collectible item: the Detective Tank.

Solve the case of the hiding Tank by smashing 10 Detective Tank collectibles to complete the “In Plain Sight” Festival Playlist Challenge during week 3 of the Festival Playlist.

If you’re eager to write your own mystery, the Detective Tank will also be available to use as a prop for EventLab.

[h2]What’s Next[/h2]
Our next series will come with new badges, clothing items, collectibles, and cars!
Flash back to another era in Back to The 90’s.

notes.title: Forza Presents a New Game Mode for Forza Horizon 5 and Reveals New Partnership
notes.content:
We are thrilled to be on the floor at [url=https://aka.ms/ForzaAtGamescom]Gamescom 2024[/url] with a sneak peek of what we’ve got in store for Forza Horizon 5—and it’s all coming next month!

A brand-new multiplayer game mode inspired by our community and their creations comes into Forza Horizon 5 for you to enjoy with 5 friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/b3dcecead90e378bc668bbb3d834ed96198277aa.jpg[/img]
From the hoops to Forza’s tracks and roads, our latest partnership brings a custom muscle classic and a new racing suit.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0f628edf736c6734f9b59c0d251411b15b3b3bc5.jpg[/img]
[h3]All Gas. And Brakes.[/h3]

The court and the road come together for the Jordan Luka 3 collab in Forza. 

[previewyoutube=dKK2vJNi0cc;full][/previewyoutube]

Check out the custom Luka 3 ‘Motorsport’ inspired 1969 Chevrolet Camaro coming to you this September on Forza Horizon 5. This exciting new collab car will be sent to players via the Gifts tab in the in-game Message Center this September.

[h3]Find the New Game Mode Coming to Forza Horizon 5![/h3]

The entire Forza Horizon 5 team is excited to announce the new game mode coming to the Horizon Festival: Hide & Seek.

[previewyoutube=Z32r8ECNNiA;full][/previewyoutube]

In this new game mode, one of two possible roles will be assigned to players at random: 

[b]Hiders.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/31b8da2c5e54538936805d4c8aa2c656a2592efe.jpg[/img]

The Hider will be tasked with getting to a location in a set amount of time without getting caught by the team of Seekers. 

Sneak past Seekers by blending into the traffic and hiding within the environment to reach your destination before the time runs out or Seekers gather enough points to win!

As a Hider, you will be able to drive the following cars: 
[list]
[*]2012 Jeep Wrangler 
[*]2017 Ford F-150 Raptor 
[*]2017 Chevrolet Colorado ZR2 
[*]2018 Mercedes X Class [/list]
[b]Seekers.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/051d83fea336395cf51e082cbda3f94cb91148ee.jpg[/img]

5 players will take on the role of Seekers whose main objective is to find and stay close to the Hider. By finding and staying close to their opponent, Seekers will start filling the Seeker’s Detection Meter. If your team completes it, you will win the round!  

Make the most out of the high-spec rental car that will be assigned to you to complete your mission.  
The vehicles available for Seekers are:  
[list][*]2016 BMW M4 GTS  
[*]2017 Chevrolet Camaro ZL1  
[*]2011 Mercedes SLS AMG  
[*]2015 Audi RS6  
[*]2008 Mitsubishi Lancer Evo X GSR  
[*]2021 Ford Bronco [/list]
All playable cars for both Hiders and Seekers will only be available on their stock version, so liveries, tunes, and builds will not be available to play.

[b]How to Play.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0df294697fba257c00ce722fbcdb639f68113433.jpg[/img]

The game is split into two phases, each with a 4-minute duration. 

In the first phase, the Hider will have to remain undercover while Seekers make their best effort to locate them before this phase ends and lock on their position to fill the Seeker’s Detection Meter and ensure the win.

During the second phase, a randomly spawned [b]End Zone[/b] becomes active. The Seekers have 4 minutes to detect the Hider before they reach the End Zone. The time is ticking, remain shrouded as much as you can to avoid the Seekers or use your tools to find the Hider and fill the Detection bar!

[b]Power-ups.[/b]

Both Seekers and the Hider will have special powers available to help them complete their objectives.

The Seekers' [b]Radar[/b] points to the approximate location of the Hider. Once they have found their target, they can use their [b]Ping[/b] ability to lock onto their exact location and show it on the map (for 20 seconds) for the rest of the team to follow.

The Hider's ability is called [b]Chase Breaker:[/b] when activated, Hiders can force-brake the Seekers and turn off their Radar and Ping for 20 seconds. Chase Breaker will also ghost your car, meaning you will become transparent and able to pass through any smashable object in the game.

Be careful when using your abilities! They have a cooldown period, so you don’t want to be caught empty at the wrong time; manage your resources properly and secure your win.

[b]Matchmaking.[/b]
Once Hide & Seek becomes available to play, a new location will be added to your map to enter this new game mode. You will also be able to access games through the Online page of the main menu.
You will be able to join games alone and matchmake with other players in the community or join as a convoy leader and play with your friends.

[b]Rewards.[/b]
Besides being a fun new game mode to try, there are other perks that come when completing sessions of Hide & Seek.

First, Hide & Seek will have its own separate progression track. You will be able to earn XP exclusive for this game mode by completing games. Leveling up will earn you new badges when you reach certain thresholds.

If you play this game mode frequently, you will build a play streak. When you do, bonus XP will be earned with every completed game, allowing you to level up faster.

Finally, new accolades tied to Hide & Seek will be added to the game for players to unlock while discovering this new multiplayer experience! A set of achievements will be released in a future update in October.

Hide & Seek will be available when the Hidden Horizons series goes live on September 10; we hope you enjoy queuing up for games in this new mode or joining with your friends as a convoy!

notes.title: Coming to your Garage this Month!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/820784ba981347ad0d78e6825f60ee1929440163.png[/img]

[h1]2022 Ford Focus ST[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8913de7955edaf721213094f159c375dc09d6ef5.png[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 1 “Summer” Season on the High-Performance Dailies Festival Playlist. Available from August 15 until August 22[/i]

This version of the Focus ST got a facelift done to it, having its badge displayed on top of a new grill underneath a renovated hood. The intakes are positioned differently, and overall, this new look is quite satisfying for a car meant to be driven every day.

However, the best part of a Focus since the beginning of time is the way it drives. Fitted with a 2.3-liter turbocharged engine that nets 276 bhp will take you from 0-100 kmh in 5.5 seconds. In addition to that great engine, the superb driving of the ST makes your everyday rides feel like you are completing a racing circuit.

[h1]2023 Toyota Camry TRD[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2e87e47733ec421efdb459e07c0e42443673b905.png[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 2 “Autumn” Season on the High-Performance Dailies Festival Playlist. Available from August 22 until August 29[/i]

In the history of motorsport, only three letters can take a car from regular jJoe to track superstar; and that is the case with the 20 PTS reward available during the Autumn Season on High-Performance Dailies.  Take a spin around the new circuits available this series on the 2023 Toyota Camry TRD.

Designed to take the Camry into a newer and sportier horizon, the TRD was fitted with an all-new suspension for more precise handling and body control. A front splitter, side aero skirts, a rear diffuser, and a rear spoiler were added to its kit to maximize aerodynamics and reduce drag. 

Completing the performance package in this car, a 3.5-liter V6 engine sits snugly underneath this car’s hood, and taking a close look at the wheels will reveal the new sports brakes added to the car. 

[h1]2023 Ford Fiesta ST[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0e9f6bc8d8ef0962d8b18554799bcdfe5addc610.jpg[/img]Earn [i]20 PTS during Week 3 “Winter” Season on the High-Performance Dailies Festival Playlist. Available from August 29 until September 5[/i]

The final version of the 2023 Ford Fiesta ST sprints into the Horizon Festival. To wave goodbye to entire generations of fans, Ford has produced a street racer that may look small but has charmed the masses with its amazing handling.

The Fiesta ST is fitted with a 1.5 Ecoboost turbocharged engine that produces 197 bhp and 236 lb-ft of torque: a racing experience that is as economical as it is thrilling.

Of course, the main feature of every Fiesta (and especially the ST) is its agility, made possible by its softer steering and a new suspension. 

One of the UK’s favorites runs into Mexico to win new fans and a ton of races. Have a go at the multiple customization pieces available for the car as you unlock it!

[h1]2021 Dodge Durango SRT Hellcat[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/21067634269520b867ed7e353c08f1014502620d.png[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 4 “Spring” Season on the High-Performance Dailies Festival Playlist. Available from September 5 until September 12[/i]

Close this daily-drive-party with a performance SUV branded with the Hellcat badge: the 2021 Dodge Durango SRT Hellcat.

A 6.2-liter V8 engine powers this performance SUV and produces a whopping 710 brake horsepower making this the most powerful car ever produced in its category at the time. The Durango’s massive power can be put to the test in a race as the car breaks the 100 kmh barrier in just 3.5 seconds --or by towing, since it can hold up to 8,700 pounds (about 3946.25 kg).

Bembo brakes, shocks, and wide tires tame the power of this performance SUV and translate it into excellent handling. 

Overall, the Durango Hellcat gives a muscle-like experience to share with an entire family.

[h1] What's Next?[/h1]

Next stop: Hidden Horizons! Join us as we welcome a brand-new game mode, new reward cars, the Stadium Maze, and the return of Pathfinder!
