notes.title: Everyday Racers Line Up at the Starting Line in High-Performance Dailies
notes.content:
The [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-high-performance-dailies]new update[/url] coming to Forza Horizon 5 features everyday cars built for performance. Unlock four reward cars that celebrate the car-next-door vibe with two hatchbacks  and an extreme off-roader.

Make the most out of these vehicles with the four Sprint Road Race Routes that will be added permanently to the game starting this series. 

Get your foot on the gas pedal and make your engines roar in High-Performance Dailies!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7d37c374364e01a530518f35447bc2cc996ebba1.png[/img]
[h2]Get Your Racing on with Four New Road Race Routes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2af2621a9fd2e837875f60467813481744855443.jpg[/img]
Get your cars to the starting line and prepare to set the fastest times you can on the four new Road Race Routes we have added to Forza Horizon 5 on High-Performance Dailies. 

Each of these new roads will let you earn an Accolade for posting a clean time on them and they will also be featured on different Festival Playlist challenges. They will all be permanently available after the series ends!

The four new races are: 
[list][*] Cloverleaf Sprint
[*] San Juan Sprint
[*] Valle del Rio Sprint
[*] Rocosa Sprint [/list] 
Enjoy these routes on both Horizon Open and Rivals from August 13 and on the World Map starting August 15!  

[h2]New Collectible Added[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ca8a99cc00d205e3789e75018741752923a9e418.png[/img]

To remind you that going fast and smashing through things is a very serious matter, we have added a collectible item that’s suited up and ready to race.

Featured on the Festival Playlist’s second week, the Business Suit Tank Collectible will be available to find, smash, and add to your collection. 

Your EventLab creations will feel like the casual Friday at the office as you will be able to add this collectible to your events as well.

[h2]Let Your Inner Artist Flourish![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ee0a6e62ee77e3f488b17ef0ba9403d44144aad2.png[/img]
Time for a color splash for your character!

Available as a reward on the first week of High-Performance Dailies’ Festival Playlist, unlock the Artist Outfit by completing the #BackToSchool Challenge.

Now you’ll know what to wear when making a new livery or build for your cars.

[h2]Festival Playlist[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/820784ba981347ad0d78e6825f60ee1929440163.png[/img]
The next four weeks will be packed with four everyday cars overloaded to provide maximum performance. 

Make room in your garage for three hatchbacks and an off-road SUV as the weekly rewards coming to Forza Horizon 5 in High-Performance Dailies.

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]
Next stop: Hidden Horizons! Join us as we welcome a brand-new game mode, new reward cars, the Stadium Maze, and the return of Pathfinder!

notes.title: Get Your Cup Filled to the Brim with Cars & Coffee- July 16th!
notes.content:
Relax with the latest update coming to Forza Horizon 5: Horizon Cars & Coffee. This new series features a brand-new Evolving World Location, the Coffee Shop, which will become your favorite location for solo or group photo ops. Stay for a late cup o’ joe and watch the new drone show featured at the Coffee Shop at night! 

The finest beans are waiting for you to take a sip, or should we say a smash, as you find our newest collectible hidden in the Coffee Shop. 

Cars from around the world converge at the Festival’s new hot spot with the Reward Cars coming this series including the 2017 Aston Martin Vanquish Zagato Coupé, 2021 Lamborghini Aventador LP 780-4 Ultimae, 1976 Volkswagen SP-2, 2022 Mazda MX-5 Miata RF, and the 1973 Volkswagen Thing. 

Four of Japan’s biggest stars shine brighter than ever in the JDM Jewels Car Pack coming this series welcoming Japan exclusive cars that have made their way to Mexico to Forza Horizon 5. 

Props, badges, outfits, and more will be available starting July 16 in Horizon Cars & Coffee! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/661837cd6b4f7e6d7c0692e96629093a7d058e79.png[/img]
 
[h2]Release Notes and Game Fixes. [/h2] 
[b]General [/b] 
[list] 

[*]General performance and stability fixes 

[/list] 

[b]Cars [/b] 

[list] 

[*]The 2023 Hyundai Ioniq 5 N’s rear badge will now show as intended 

[*]Fixed the 2024 Ford Mustang Dark Horse’s dark matte textures 

[*]All three Time Machine’s side mirrors will now display properly 

[*]Fixed an issue with the 1992 Jeep Wrangler Sahara ‘Jurassic Park’ where sometimes wheels were clipping after large jumps 

[/list] 

[url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409616884883-FH5-Known-Issues]You can find a list of issues we are currently investigating here[/url]. The [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting Hub[/url] is always open for you to leave any reports you have. 
 

[h2]A New Evolving World Location is Brewing at the Horizon Festival. [/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/c82e3cec7ac1169ab55d2d7a004b0016c0fe7c9f.png[/img]

Horizon Cars & Coffee brings you the best place to ingest your mandatory dose of much needed daily caffeine in the Coffee Shop Location. This new spot is piping hot with locations to take pictures of your cars and even entire convoys! 

The Coffee Shop is riddled with the same murals you can see in different areas of the Mexico map, and some new artwork on its walls. Furthermore, you can use the drive-through area for cool photo opportunities. 

Look at the inside of the Coffee Shop and you’ll find a nice photo studio when you need a picture of your favorite rides with a clean white background. Special lights will also turn on at this section of the Shop at night for a unique illumination on your pictures.  

All around the Coffee Shop you will see platforms designed to fit multiple cars; these are amazing for group shots to immortalize your convoys. In total, there are three platforms surrounding the Shop; one features another iconic mural seen across Mexico, while the other two use nature as their backdrop. 
 

[h2] A Coffee with Unique Body for You to Unlock [/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2af5d3b94bf2303101634ca5067c10d6de3c12ff.png[/img]

Nothing beats the sensation of putting on your most comfy set of clothes to get a nice cup of your favorite kind of coffee and going for a ride on the crisp roads of the Horizon Festival.  

To help you with that first part, we have added the Coffee Cup outfit as an unlockable reward on the first week of the Festival Playlist. 

We know how hard it is to put a smile on your face before you have had your first cup of the day, so we decided to include a premade smile on this outfit, so you don’t have to fake it until that first glorious sip. 
 

[h2] The Most Caffeinated Drone Show Yet! [/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/3a62305e3cf32ee3ebd3daa478e02a181511e536.png[/img]

The Coffee Shop Location will also be the host of a completely new drone show in this series! 

Visit the new Evolving World Location at night and watch the flying drones make the shapes of a coffee cup, a car wheel, and this series’ logo. 

The drone show plus the spotlights that appear at night near the Coffee Shop will also provide unique photo opportunities for you and your convoy. 
 

[h2] Spill the Beans with This New Collectible [/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/47bd8e57e6791662ba244bd72a72e0025515aa53.png[/img]

There’s no need to make a line for this one-of-a-kind cup, you just need to find it. 

Visit the Coffee Shop during the third week of Horizon Cars & Coffee and smash 10 Coffee Cup Collectibles to complete the Spill the Beans challenge available that week. 

Be careful with the cup! As soon as you hit it, you’ll see its content spilled all over the place. 
 

[h2] No Sugar, No Cream, Just Props. [/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0a3440064112642ce0b85b210fc8383db459a48a.png[/img]

EventLab creators, your order is up and ready! 

If you liked what you saw at the Coffee Shop, we are making some of the bits and pieces that made the new area special available for your EventLab creations.  

Six new props to build your own relaxation station or a highly caffeinated racing course will be available this series. Enjoy building with: 

[list] 

[*]Ramps & Platforms  

[list][*]Cars & Coffee Plinth[/list]  

[*]Walls & Fences  

[list][*]Cars & Coffee Barrier[/list]  

[*]Flags  

[list][*]Cars & Coffee Flag[/list]  

[*]Gameplay  

[list][*]Cars & Coffee Cup[/list]  

[*]Decoration  

[list][*]Cars & Coffee Mural   

[*]Cars & Coffee Board 

[/list][/list] 

Do not fret, your Cars & Coffee Barrier includes an extra shot of snapping functionality for easier maneuverability. 
 

[h2] Festival Playlist[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/1f0e0d4600cafd0de0c86df29e36ff121c52cc20.jpg[/img]

Five cars are gathering from all around the world to taste the Festival’s bean juice as this update’s Festival Playlist Reward Cars. 

From exclusive flashy rides to convenient utility vehicles, this series’ rewards are a fun and diverse collection of international marvels. 

[h2]What’s Next[/h2]

Time to rev those engines High-Performance Dailies. The next series coming to Forza Horizon 5 will feature 4 Festival Playlist Reward Cars, new racing routes, and new EventLab props including our latest collectible.

The GR Yaris is a four-wheel drive daredevil built to fight its way through rally circuits; it’s powered by a 2.1-liter turbocharged engine that puts out 268 bhp and can reach 0-100 kmh in 5.2 seconds. And that’s before you get your hands on it and start tuning!

notes.title: Coming to Your Garage this Month
notes.content:
[h2]Can you unlock these future legendary vehicles?[/h2]

[h3] 2023 KIA EV6 GT [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e67260a49cae3a8f89ef545717f5a72fc5b546e4.png[/img]

Earn 80 PTS during the Modern Horizons Festival Playlist to unlock as a Series Reward. 

The 2023 KIA EV6 GT has the heart-and-home feel of an SUV that crosses the “GT” line on the sand to become a racing utility vehicle that’s as comfy as it is powerful.  

Like a futuristic spaceship, EV6 GT features a green button on the steering wheel that unlocks its true power, transforming this changeling from urban driver into racing speedster able to go from 0 – 100 kmh in just 3.2 seconds using its surprising 576 bhp. 

To keep you on your toes from the get-go, this KIA’s inside is adorned with racing interiors like the seats and trim, so even the tamest drives around the Festival will have the unique race-to-the-finish feel. 

Did we mention it’s 4 wheel-drive and electric? Because it is and we love it. 

[h3] 2024 Ford Mustang Dark Horse [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/b21bddef136340b353e7caf55baa09187c3e664b.jpg[/img]

Galloping to the Horizon Festival with crashing footfalls; it’s the latest, biggest, and meanest horse we have seen: the 2024 Ford Mustang Dark Horse. 

As soon as you pop this car’s hood you will be greeted with a very delightful badge, one that says “5.0”. The emblem is not there only for decoration, it’s to remind you of the massive 5.0-liter V8 naturally aspirated Coyote engine that drives this car forward and powers it with 500 horsepower. 

6-speed manual transmission and rear-wheel drive to get the complete muscle car experience and an updated braking system to excel its performance on the track as well 

Enjoy the reckless charge of the 2024 Ford Mustang Dark Horse! 

[h3] 2023 Hyundai iONIQ 5 N [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d911da39277c506e00d30887e9d081fe4169df26.png[/img]

The future has arrived. Looking like your regular Sunday-drive SUV, but hiding a potent powertrain and futuristic technology, the 2023 Hyundai IONIQ 5 N is an auspice for cars to come.  

The all-electric powertrain will put its 320 bhp to work and to make the 5 N vanish right in front of your eyes as it reaches 100 kmh from a standstill in 4.5 seconds.  

This new iONIQ is a great outdoors partner with an upgraded towing capacity, a great ride, and a minimalist interior design you’ll want to live in. 

[h3] 2021 Toyota GR Yaris [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/04d5908c5738f4f645bd629cd229f55bbfc1a2d6.png[/img]

Running on sheer force of vigor and with a willingness to take you from point A to point B in the least number of seconds possible, the 2021 Toyota GR Yaris is taking its shot as your new favorite hot hatch.  

The GR is quite hot, actually: a daredevilish four-wheel drive system to make quick work of corners, a very eager 2.1-liter turbocharged engine that puts out 257 bhp, and a six-speed manual transmission to experience corner taking like a true champion built to smash the giants of the track. 

Drive around the Horizon Festival in the new benchmark for modern hatchbacks and create your own special build of the versatile vehicle. 

[h3] 2023 Porsche Taycan Cross Turismo Turbo S [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0e0942979c51a673694bef7211cdab34bb919db3.png[/img]

Picture it: the echo of eons of Porsche's magnificent history added to modern electric technology and comfort of an all-wheel-drive SUV. You don’t have to imagine it anymore: it's the 2023 Porsche Taycan Cross Turismo Turbo S,: Porsche’s all-electric sports utility vehicle. 

As the name implies, this Taycan shares a lot of aspects and components with its sedan counterpart. However, the electric SUV comes with two engines that output 750 horses as soon as you touch that pedal. You will cruise so comfortably inside; you’d probably forget that this vehicle can reach 100 kmh in just 2.4 seconds. 

Porsche reaps the past by adding elements of its racing legacy into this model which perfectly contrasts with the new generation additions such as touch screens and, of course, the completely modern electric power train bringing the racing history of the brand into the modern era. 

[h2] Universal Icons Car Pack [/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/1ce2e1108d694ce35c7b3d37af71d4373ca79b6b.png[/img]

From the big screen to your gaming monitor, these icons from your favorite movies and TV shows take the Horizon Festival for a retro revival!  

Experience new adventures for K.I.T.T. from Knight Rider, the Jurassic Park 1992 Jeep Wrangler Sahara, and all 3 versions of the Time Machine from the Back to the Future trilogy! 

 

[h3] Time Machine from Back to the Future [/h3]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a0c0003d2a39a01d7f15257beae6c44fce6f82fb.png[/img]

The original Time Machine from Back to the Future has arrived at the Horizon Festival! 

Lights and sounds similar to what you saw on the film will burst out of the car just when you hit 88 mph. 

[h3] Time Machine from Back to the Future Part II [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/b23a264a40320a8e22159e6599d658eb2c034d92.png[/img]

Complete with the new Mr. Fusion attachment, the second iteration of the Time Machine will also be available on the Universal Icons Car Pack.  

Just like the first Time Machine, this one will display unique effects once the classic 88 mph speed is met. 

[h3] Time Machine from Back to the Future Part III [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0a84b4e763c83156fcc860d89af02b8dcc47197d.png[/img]

Back to the Future’s Time Machine from the saga’s third instalment will be at your disposal in this Car Pack. 

The driving experience of this Time Machine really sets it apart from the previous two versions, and of course, this one will also produce the iconic VFX of its movie counterpart when it reaches, you guessed it, 88 mph. 

[h3] 1992 Jeep Wrangler Sahara from Jurassic Park [/h3]   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a472bb251c3b36394bfeed1811cda718cb7dab1d.png[/img]

From Isla Nublar, the Horizon Festival welcomes Jurassic Park’s 1992 Jeep Wrangler Sahara. 

Your vehicle of choice to race on the different off-roading courses in Mexico or to take on a cozy tour watching unusually large ancient reptiles. 

[h3] K.I.T.T from Knight Rider [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/689864a78a58ff0714bcea9b1398c347a4758d24.png[/img]

Villains hidden across the Horizon Festival, beware! A muscle car powered by justice and artificial intelligence has arrived. 

K.I.T.T also comes with a body kit (no pun intended) that allows it to activate Super Pursuit Mode! 

[h2] You’re Gonna Need a Bigger Car... [/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/496708dfff59e139b37c3c07865ff4a1b11b3d54.png[/img]

Lurking in the deepest corners of the Festival Playlist’s second week is an outfit so amazing nobody has been able to keep it in captivity. From the bottom of the ocean, get your character ready to wear the Shark Outfit--includes swim trunks and fins! 

Complete Week 2 EventLab “Laderas Core” by PinHead Larry06 to unlock this exclusive outfit. 

[h2] A Modern Construct to Add to Your Collection [/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/66b6717902ec6a5e4b10d7e102510ad4b11445d2.png[/img]

BEEP BOOP BOP! Transmission confirmed. Location of the new collectible: unknown. Coolness level: the highest. 

Modern Horizon’s second week Collectible event will give you the chance to find and smash. 

You will also be able to add this automaton to your EventLab constructions in case you were looking for a futuristic theme or build a robotic scenario. 

[h2] What’s Next [/h2] 

Time to slow things down and take a well-deserved breather!  

Forza Horizon 5’s next update will feature a new Evolving World Coffee Shop, as well as new collectibles and clothing items, and, of course, new cars to unlock and collect!

Porsche reaps the past by adding elements of its racing legacy into this model which perfectly contrasts with the new generation additions such as touch screens and, of course, the completely modern electric power train bringing the racing history of the brand into the modern era.
From the big screen to your gaming monitor, these icons from your favorite movies and TV shows take the Horizon Festival for a retro revival!
Experience new adventures for K.I.T.T. from Knight Rider, the Jurassic Park 1992 Jeep Wrangler Sahara, and all 3 versions of the Time Machine from the Back to the Future trilogy!
The original Time Machine from Back to the Future has arrived at the Horizon Festival!
Lights and sounds similar to what you saw on the film will burst out of the car just when you hit 88 mph.
Complete with the new Mr. Fusion attachment, the second iteration of the Time Machine will also be available on the Universal Icons Car Pack.
Just like the first Time Machine, this one will display unique effects once the classic 88 mph speed is met.
Back to the Future’s Time Machine from the saga’s third instalment will be at your disposal in this Car Pack.

The driving experience of this Time Machine really sets it apart from the previous two versions, and of course, this one will also produce the iconic VFX of its movie counterpart when it reaches, you guessed it, 88 mph.
From Isla Nublar, the Horizon Festival welcomes Jurassic Park’s 1992 Jeep Wrangler Sahara.
Your vehicle of choice to race on the different off-roading courses in Mexico or to take on a cozy tour watching unusually large ancient reptiles.
Villains hidden across the Horizon Festival, beware! A muscle car powered by justice and artificial intelligence has arrived.
K.I.T.T also comes with a body kit (no pun intended) that allows it to activate Super Pursuit Mode!
Lurking in the deepest corners of the Festival Playlist’s second week is an outfit so amazing nobody has been able to keep it in captivity.
From the bottom of the ocean, get your character ready to wear the Shark Outfit--includes swim trunks and fins!
Complete Week 2 EventLab “Laderas Core” by PinHead Larry06 to unlock this exclusive outfit.
Modern Horizon’s second week Collectible event will give you the chance to find and smash.
You will also be able to add this automaton to your EventLab constructions in case you were looking for a futuristic theme or build a robotic scenario.
Forza Horizon 5’s next update will feature a new Evolving World Coffee Shop, as well as new collectibles and clothing items, and, of course, new cars to unlock and collect!

notes.title: This Decade’s Greatest Cars Gather Round in Modern Horizons!
notes.content:
Now that flashback is over, it’s in with the new as Modern Horizons brings some of the greatest machines of our current decade.  

Technology, innovation, and a lot of power come to play as this series’ Festival Playlist Reward cars: the 2024 Ford Mustang Dark Horse, 2023 Hyundai IONIQ 5 N, 2021 Toyota GR Yaris, 2023 Porsche Taycan Cross Turismo Turbo S, and the 2023 KIA EV6 GT. 

18 new EventLab props to create your dream highway are joining your collection complete with everything you need to create a modern motorway. 

Five icons from your favorite movies and TV shows for a spin across the Horizon Festival with the Universal Icons Car Pack available for purchase now. 

This series’ collectible item takes technology even further than we thought. Meet the Robot Collectible on the second week of the Festival Playlist. 

The 21st century shines on Horizon Festival in our latest update: Modern Horizons. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/b2fe766300d9a345845205619eeac0aeb2e8c859.jpg[/img]

There are some who will do anything to escape the traffic and mundane sensation of driving on a motorway.  

Then there are others who replicate their daily commute or create new highways on their favorite games.  

For this second group of people, we have added the latest 17 EventLab props that include everything you need to build a modern road. 

This list of props includes:

notes.title: Get Soaked in the Horizon Retrowave!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ed703e4cbf2df726714922741594b2cadfcf5537.png[/img]
A wave filled with neon lights, synthwave music, and retro vibes floods the Horizon Festival with Horizon Retrowave, the latest update coming to Forza Horizon 5. 

5 new retrofuturistic rides join your collection as this series’ reward cars including the 21st century version of a Lambo legend and Hyundai that fuses past and present in the same vehicle. 

Enjoy the new radio Station, Horizon Wave, that will be providing a synthwave soundtrack to your driving adventures through the Festival. This new station brings a new host and over 10 new tracks all in synthwave style. 

A new Neon Highway appears with neon decorations that will vibe with the music playing on your radio as you drive by.  

Keep on reading to get splashed with the retro revival taking over the Horizon Festival on Horizon Retrowave! 

[h2]Release Notes & Game Fixes[/h2] 
[list] 
[*]20 new EventLab props including 12 with lights synched to the music being played through in-game radio. 
[*]New Horizon Wave Radio Station featuring a new DJ and 21 new songs 
[*]New Neon Highway 
[*]General  
[list] 
[*]Fixed an issue where AI Traffic cars were not present in Street Races 
[*]Improvements made for an issue where some players were getting “Forza Horizon Server Not Available” error message while trying to connect to the Auction House, Message Centre, Leaderboards or browse Liveries, Tunes and Vinyl 
[*]Fixed an issue where players were not able to follow/unfollow creators via the Creative Hub 
[*]General performance and stability fixes[/list] 
[*]Cars 
[list] 
[*]Fixed an issue with the 2020 Audi TT RS where front fenders were disappearing when equipping the customized hood 
[*]Fixed an issue with the 2020 Audi TT RS where the digital gauge in the cockpit view had some texture inconsistencies [/list][/list][url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409616884883-FH5-Known-Issues]You can find a list of issues we are currently investigating here[/url]. The [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting Hub[/url] is always open for you to leave any reports you have. 

[h2]Get Your Sunglasses Ready for Cruise on the Neon Highway.[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/009b3d3337e63a8028724fa95ee44760856871a8.png[/img]
The lights are bright and the highway long, the Neon Highway shows up at the Horizon Festival to set the retro mood for the series. 

Going for a drive on the Neon Highway, you’ll spot tons of different decorations all with a sweet neon groove. Take a look at the neon rails, palm trees, and tank mascots scattered around the highway as you drive.  

The vibes and mood aren’t the only thing the Neon Highway has; its decorations will be synched to the song playing on your in-game radio, so go for a drive and change your station to see how the highway fits your mood. 

Find these new decorations on the Highway near “The Marathon” event. 

The Neon Highway isn’t the only part of the map getting flashy this series; neon decorations from Midnight at Horizon are coming back to races featured on series 34, and the extended night cycles are coming back with them to get a better view of all the neon lights shining through the Festival.  

[h2]Feast Your Eyes with the Drone Retro Show.[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/6f933479a63cfc37db041c26b441e9717a7b9e1f.png[/img]
Drive to the right side of the Stadium, close to “The Marathon” event and take a look at the neon-fueled drone show brought to you this series. 

A big, bright sun made by drones will set on the edge of the Neon Highway for you to gaze at for a completely retro experience. 

Use this setting and event to score some amazing pictures and to dampen yourself with the retrowave coming for the next four weeks.  

[h2]Get Your Synth-Vibe on with the New Radio Station.[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/28a162fbf2516af4867a65f504e9299a1dd50d91.jpg[/img]
The lights are set, and the location is vibing; get the complete Retrowave experience with the brand-new radio station coming to Forza Horizon 5. 

As soon as you enter the game, our new DJ, Isabel Moss will welcome you to Horizon Wave, the synthwave radio station kicking off transmissions with the new update. 

This new radio station features 21 new songs including the streamer friendly “Encanto Remix” by Mitch Murder.  

All seasonal events will have their ambiance set with the music of this new station. 

The complete list of songs includes:  

[table] 
[tr][th][b]Title[/b][/th][th][b]Artist/Writer[/b][/th][/tr]

[h2]A Suit to Withstand the Blast from the Past.[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/af4c42d309aafc50f468c1514456edf25761cfe4.png[/img]
All the style and ambiance of the Retrowave could not stay on the Highway and decorations alone; we have also added a suit drenched with a vintage feel. 

The Retrowave Outfit will be available to unlock by completing the Festival Playlist’s first week photo challenge. A purple suit and a glove full of power to become completely submerged in the wave. 

[h2]Visitors Coming from Different Realms![/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/3d0567573db1da9b3616999e537341aba9a7ab0b.png[/img]
Crafted with the finest materials found across the Minecraft Overworld and the Nether, celebrate Minecraft’s 15th anniversary with two new cosmetic items.  

Dress your character as Minecraft's most recognizable mobs with the Minecraft Creeper Helmet and the Minecraft Enderman Helmet.  

Redeem both items through the Message Center from 05/23 until 12/31! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/eb679bf5881670ebf68775710d7d35940b3562ad.png[/img]

[h2]Retrowave horns[/h2] 

Your cars will not avoid getting dripped by the Retrowave this series.  

We have added 6 new horns to fit into your car and spread the nostalgia throughout the Festival.  

This is the complete list of the flashback-inducing horns for you to enjoy:  
[list] 
[*]Cassette 
[*]Cat Wave 
[*]Dial Tone 
[*]Plasma 
[*]Synth Toms 
[*]Synth Horn[/list] 
[h2]Blinded by the Lights of Your EventLab Creations[/h2] 

Give your EventLab creations a nice razzle-dazzle with the 20 Retrowave props featured in this series.  

Every prop brought on this new update (except for the Horizon Wave sign and the Retro Sunset) will flash in-synch with the music playing on your in-game radio. Pieces include three light pattern variations: Animated, Pulsing, and Static. 
[list]

[list]

[*]Neon Double Street Light 
[*]Neon Street Light[/list] 
[*]Signs & Flags 
[list] 
[*]Horizon Wave Sign[/list] 
[*]Gameplay 
[list] 
[*]Retro Sunset[/list][/list]As you might have guessed, the Retro Sunset prop in the Gameplay section is the new collectible item you will be able to find during the second week of Horizon Retrowave to add to your collection! 

[h2]What’s Next.[/h2] 

We drive off the Retrowave sunset and approach Modern Horizons! 

This next series will feature new cars including one a lot of our players have been requesting as well as new EventLab props and a brand-new collectible. 

Keep on adventuring and we’ll see you next series, adiós!

The power in this car is brought to you by a 3.5-liter twin-turbocharged EcoBoost V6 engine; the same one that took home the gold at the Rolex 24 hours at Daytona and the 12 Hours of Sebrig.

notes.title: GT Racers Rush Through Mexico’s Roads in Apex AllStars
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7d10ccb23c970dfc14ebbef81f3995edb163f4de.png[/img]
The Apex Outpost takes the spotlight with Apex AllStars, the latest update coming to Forza Horizon 5. In Apex AllStars you’ll be able to race in some of the greatest GT cars the Horizon Festival has ever seen as the 5 new reward cars exclusive to the Festival Playlist. 

The highly requested Asphalt Road and elevation Props are finally here! Builders will have the greatest time adding 23 new props to their EventLab creations. 

Blink and you might miss the Apex AllStars Car Pack driving along this update. Collect 7 new cars built for racing across Mexico’s greatest roads. 

A traffic-stopping outfit and the 2024 Chevrolet Corvette E-Ray appear in this update too! 

[h2]Release Notes & Game Fixes.[/h2] 

[list] 
[*]Fixed an issue where sometimes no inputs were registered after quick resuming the game  
[*]General performance and stability fixes  
[*]Fixed an issue with the 2019 Ginetta G10 RM: Vinyls will no longer show the car’s paint[/list] 
[h2]Hit the Road with Your EventLab Creations.[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/cf4808ffb7470f9654fbe8ce4d451b2c51e9568a.png[/img]
They are finally here! Apex AllStars introduces new road pieces to add to your creations. 

You will be able to build roadways with the 8 Asphalt Road Props available in this new update.  

All road props come with a road-marked version, to add a bit of urban flare to your creations, and a non-marked version in case you are going with more of a track-oriented idea. 

Your EventLab tracks are getting to the next level, literally, with the elevated road pieces added with this update as well. The 15 Elevated Road Props are available in both road-marked and non-road-marked versions to choose from. 

Both new sets include snapping functionality! 

[h2]Chevrolet’s Thunder Strikes Twice![/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a76929d81a34eb338ff62141e7af6539c3326f5c.jpg[/img]
A hybrid thunder strikes the Horizon Festival once more to join the AllStar team that comes with this update.  

Initially only available as a loyalty reward for players who played Forza Motorsport, the 2024 Chevrolet Corvette E-Ray has returned! Starting April 23, the E-Ray will be permanently available in the Autoshow for 181,000 credits. Additionally, during the Festival Playlist’s fourth week, the fastest hybrid in Chevrolet’s arsenal will also be available as a reward for winning the “Going the Distance” Seasonal Championship. 

[h2]An Icon of The Road Takes the First Position (in Your Wardrobe)[/h2] 

Apex AllStars finally gives us the chance to get in the shoes of a road racing icon with a traffic stopping outfit that arrives as a Festival Playlist reward. 

Complete the Photo Challenge on the second week of the Festival Playlist to unlock the unique Traffic Cone outfit. 

Wear the true style of the streets and share your photos in our official Discord. ([url=https://discord.com/invite/forza]Discord[/url]) 

[h2]The Festival’s Mascot Goes for Gold.[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/6eeda1e1c7fbf359629a610b8cd38707059a3493.png[/img]
A new collectible celebrates your wins on the Apex Outpost! 

Find the Podium Tank collectible hiding around the Apex Outpost during the third week of Apex AllStars. 

Unlock this new version of the Horizon Festival’s favorite mascot and include it in your EventLab creations! 

[h2]Try the New Editor’s Choice tab.[/h2] 

In the PG Editor’s Choice tab in EventLab was sorted by the number of times a course was played. This meant that new picks would be relegated to the bottom of the list. Now, the PG Editor’s Choice tab is sorted by recency, so the most recent courses chosen by the team will appear first. 

This change will also mean that events will no longer be removed from the list, but rather we’re now able to continually showcase more and more of your creations and bring back some of our favorites. 

Explore our new selection of EventLab creations each week and try the amazing, curated catalogue of our favorite events!           

[h2]Apex AllStars Car Pack.[/h2] 

A collection of the world’s finest GT racers lines up at the starting line.  

Collect 7 new cars supercharged with loads of power and history to tour around the greatest roads México has to offer. Climb to the top of the Apex Outpost with the Apex AllStars Car Pack available from April 23 for 9.99$ / 9.99€ / 7.99 £ 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2894270/Forza_Horizon_5_Apex_Allstars_Car_Pack/?curator_clanid=40722422

Not included with the Premium Version or Forza Horizon 5 Car Pass. 

[h3]2018 BMW #1 M Motorsport M8 GTE[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a144fb64b8429fc567f49266384363137910a59d.png[/img]
To make their return to the 24 Hours of Le Mans after six years of absence, BMW created the most efficient engine they have ever created and trapped it to the first M8 car ever made. The result was an endurance powerhouse racer named the 2018 BMW #1 M Motorsport M8 GTE. 

The M8 GTE used a BMW TwinPower Turbo Technology engine restricted to 4 liters by regulations, however this remarkable engine could produce 592 bhp. Over 700 pieces fitted into the engine came from other BMW Motorsport projects. 

This car finished 5th in the 2018-2019 FIA World Endurance Championships and came in second in the 2020 IMSA SportsCar Championship results. 

[h3]2015 Cadillac #3 Cadillac Racing ATS-V.R[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/6cbd04dc1445facbb4c15f9281916ef423077a82.png[/img]
Taking the staff from the CTS-V.R Coupe, the 2015 Cadillac #3 Cadillac Racing ATS-V.R rushes in and takes the position as Cadillac's GT3 specialist. 

The ATS-V.R was fitted with a racing version of the LF4 3.6L twin-turbo V6, but what sets it apart from its commercial counterpart are the twin BorgWarner turbochargers, engine management, and intercoolers with larger capacity; those tweaks and upgrades produce 600 bhp  

Completing the fit and finish, the ATS-V.R got a body kit upgrade including new fenders, front bumper, a massive wing, and an under tray. 

[h3]2020 Chevrolet #3 Corvette Racing C8.R[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7881b947aaa71b8c735acae242a20705810554f5.png[/img]
Lined up on the grid as Chevrolet’s latest endurance competitor, the 2020 Chevrolet #3 Corvette Racing C8.R is a former champion who is getting used to sitting on the podium. 

The C8.R (racing version of the traditional mid-engine Corvette) started its path to glory in the 2020 24 Hours of Daytona during which it finished 4th in its class. The C8.R was eager to win the gold and ended up taking the entire championship that year and repeating the next one. 

Built to win, the C8.R comes with a 5.5 -liter V8 engine (mounted in the middle, of course) that produces 500 horsepower- 480 pound-feet of torque. Take this car around Mexico’s and hang more medals around its mirrors 

[h3]2018 Mercedes-AMG GT3[/h3] 

Mercedes-AMG came up with a surprise for those who thought the limit was reached with the AMG GT: the 2018 Mercedes-AMG GT3, a bigger, stronger, and faster car upgraded for racing performance. 

From the sheer looks of its front, you already know this ride is dangerously fast. Its enhanced version of the 6.3-litre naturally aspirated V8 engine that you can find in an SLS AMG 63 shoots up the car from 0-100 kmh in just 3 seconds. 

An engine fitted low for balance and handling, electronic assistance controls for precision, and the appearance of a champion, the Mercedes-AMG GT3 is in it to win it all. 

[h3]2020 Lexus #14 VASSER SULLIVAN RC F GT3[/h3] 

After scoring VASSER SULLIVAN’s and Lexus’ first victory at 12 Hours of Sebring 2024 in which the pilot Jack Hawksworth secured pole position with this car, the 2020 Lexus #14 VASSER SULLIVAN RC F GT3 is still hungry for more wins.  

To secure this and many more trophies, the RC was fitted with a 5.4-liter V8 engine that produces around 500 bhp inside of a lightweight chassis and a body built with carbon fiber. This equation results in a GT3 car that can reach 100 kmh in just 3 seconds. 

[h3]2019 Ferrari #62 Risi Competizione 488 GTE[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d06491705c36734d6cbdcea1478c63200af74710.png[/img]
Few car makers have as rich of a racing history as Ferrari, the famous winners of multiple endurance racing events come back with a win taking the 24 Hours of Daytona with one of their best machines: the 2019 Ferrari #62 Risi Competizione 488 GTE. 

The 488 GTE was built with a 3.9-liter V8 twin-turbocharged engine that produced over 600 horsepower and gave the car 538 lb-ft of torque. Its body, made from aluminum and carbon fiber provides a rigid but light structure to ensure every single one of those 600 bhp is put to good use. 

Excelling on grip, speed, pedigree, and so much more, 2019 Ferrari #62 Risi Competizione 488 GTE is waiting to take home new accolades in the Horizon Festival.  

[h3]2018 Porsche 911 GT3 R[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e8ca20068ac00c6ae551faa14d48120b66ff8c30.png[/img]
The 911 bloodline got a new heir thirsty to get set and go around the track. The 2018 Porsche 911 GT3 R is everything that makes the 911 line so legendary and a little bit more. 

Powered by a new naturally aspirated 4.0-liter straight-six engine reworked to include a new crankshaft, intake manifold, and valvetrain; the GT3 R’s response and torque output is almost unmatched.  

Even though this car only packs 500 bhp, the engine’s response, body panels, aerodynamics, and gearbox make this car accelerate like the greatest competitor’s you have ever seen. 

[h2]What’s Next.[/h2] 

A wave from the past floods the Horizon Festival. 

Next series will see a new Radio Station come to the Horizon Festival and new EventLab props will be available along with highway decorations. 

Join us when Horizon Retrowave arrives on May 23rd. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2ad1a3efc8316a42438621013582c579b22e1d0f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Race Towards the Finish Line in Horizon Race-Off!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/772d5f9c161dda8599714ff59ef77a4fab38f471.png[/img]
A new timed event has arrived at the Horizon Festival. This time, the entire Forza Horizon 5 community will race together to unlock rewards in every player’s garage.  

The Horizon Festival will also receive a new moving outpost for you to locate in Free Roam. 

18 new props will become available for your EventLab creations including the latest collectible to join Forza Horizon 5’s gallery of smashable items.  

Aside from the cars unlocked by completing the Race-Off goals, 4 exclusive Festival Playlist rewards will be available to obtain as well. 

The race is on in Horizon Race-Off! 

[h2]Release Notes & Game Fixes.[/h2] 

The following list details some of the fixes and changes we are implementing with this new update. 

[list] 
[*]Fixed an issue with EventLab where “Disable Standard Scoring” rule was not working 
[*]Fixed an issue with EventLab where Players made events were automatically set to 5 minutes when launched from the shared events menu[/list][url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409616884883-FH5-Known-Issues]You can find a list of issues we are currently investigating here.[/url] The [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting Hub[/url] is always open for you to leave any reports you have. 

[h2]3, 2, 1...and the Horizon Race-Off is on![/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8834843f46ddaa5c7495be614d734e65e117c79b.png[/img]
Horizon Race-Off pitches two new community-wide goals for our players to complete, one for Asphalt Racing and one for Off-Road. After each goal has been met every player will receive a reward in their Message Center. 

Add points to the Asphalt Racing goal by completing events in the following categories: 
[list] 

[*]Mexico 
[list] 
[*]Drag Racing 
[*]Road Racing 
[*]Street Racing 
[*]Midnight Battles[/list] 
[*]Hot Wheels
[list]
[*]Speed Racing[/list] 
[*]Rally Adventure 
[list] 
[*]Apex Predators Races[/list][/list]When the Asphalt Racing goal has been completed, every player will unlock the 2024 Ford Mustang GT. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/fd46b0f3bcb94ab6b22220c96328f894e7193653.jpg[/img]
[i]Unlock the 2024 Ford Mustang GT completing the Asphalt Racing goal.[/i]

You will be able to contribute to the Off-Roading goal by clearing these types of events: 

[list] 
[*]Mexico 
[list] 
[*]Dirt Racing 
[*]Cross Country Racing[/list] 
[*]Hot Wheels 
[list] 
[*]Hazard Racing[/list] 
[*]Rally Adventure 
[list] 
[*]Grit Reapers Races 
[*]Horizon Raptors Races[/list][/list]Once enough points have been gathered for the Off-Roading goal, the entire community will receive the 2023 Ford F-150 Raptor R. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/4fc181c0e0541a33c6201d113d0abe29f98bd840.jpg[/img]
[i]Complete the Off-Road challenge to unlock the 2023 Ford F-150 Raptor R for every player.[/i]

Please bear in mind that Rivals, Mothly Rivals/Forza EV, Showcases, Horizon Stories, Expeditions, or EventLab events will not count towards the contribution of either goal.  

The entire Horizon Festival teams up to beat the goals and unlock rewards for every member in the community! 

Don’t forget to check each goal’s progress and look at your Message Center when they are cleared. 

[h2]Wear Your Team and Go for the Win![/h2] 

We couldn’t let the opportunity to let you show off your favorite team in style, so as early as March 28, you will receive the Horizon Race-Off outfits via in-game message as soon as the season switches. 

Hit the tarmac and feel the blue racing in the Asphalt Racers race suit. 

Get ready to get dirty with the Off-Road racers race suit. 

Both outfits will be available to redeem during the four weeks of Horizon Race-Off. Get yours and represent your team’s colors.  

[h2]An Adventuring Outpost Arrives.[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/68d651238ff687e01ed1bf15fc28d12d4644de11.png[/img]
Horizon Race-Off will feature a new, unique Outpost in this series. 

The Horizon Race-Off Outposts will be decorated with the distinctive colors and logos of each racing division featured in the same name; the blue is for Asphalt while the orange represents Off-Roading. 

What sets these Outposts apart from others found at the Horizon Festival is that these new ones will change locations on each week of the series. 

Once inside the Race-Off Outposts, you’ll be able to check up on the progress of the Asphalt and Off-Road challenges.  

Chase after this moving Outpost and share where you found it with the community! 

[h2]Piñatas for All, No Matter Your Team[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/6c78ab1300a9b5414e6b39152d201d8ab66fe2c3.png[/img]
After you are done chasing and finding the moving Outpost featured in this series, the Horizon Festival will also get two new collectible items to search for.  

On week 2, find and collect the Offroad Helmet Pinata Collectible. Look for it in Playa Azul’s sands 

An Asphalt Helmet Pinata will also be available to collect, this one will be available during week 3. Start going round Ópalo de Fuego to find it! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/61216d153c59eb03efe1fb1f0ebed195051b0231.png[/img]
[h2]Racefy Your EventLab Creations[/h2] 

Creators will also be able to get their share of the Race-Off with the brand-new EventLab props added to the game in this series. 

Support team Asphalt, Off-Road or both using the themed flags, billboards, and other decorations featuring the colors and branding for each team.  

Furthermore, you will be able to include both Piñata Helmets scattered throughout the Festival to your EventLab races and events. 

The complete list of new props features:  
[list] 
[*][b]8 Signs & Flags[/b] 
[list] 
[*]Asphalt Billboard 
[*]Off-Road BillBoard 
[*]Asphalt Flags 
[list] 
[*]White 
[*]Blue 
[*]Dark Blue[/list] 
[*]Off-Road Flags 
[list] 
[*]White 
[*]Orange 
[*]Dark Orange[/list][/list] 
[*][b]2 Gameplay[/b] 
[list] 
[*]Asphalt Helmet Piñata 
[*]Off-Road Helmet Piñata[/list] 
[*][b]6 Festival[/b] 
[list] 
[*]Horizon Race-Off Display 
[*]Horizon Race-Off Entrance 
[*]Asphalt Entrance 
[*]Off-Road Entrance 
[*]Asphalt Festival Tower 
[*]Off-Road Festival Tower[/list] 
[*][b]2 Walls & Fences[/b] 
[list] 
[*]Asphalt Barrier 
[*]Off-Road Barrer[/list][/list]Both barriers include Snap Functionality! 

[h2]Acceleration Car Pack[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2a24b0c912cc42a88cf9d5b6e67b480c6751c755.png[/img]
Get four new rides to conquer the many races featured in Horizon Race-Off. 

The Acceleration Car Pack features four limited-build cars created to achieve the highest speed possible in the shortest amount of time.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2868420/Forza_Horizon_5_Acceleration_Car_Pack/?curator_clanid=40722422

One classic drag-race titan and three modern super-fast racers are available for purchase starting March 26 for 4.99$ / 4.99€ / 3.99 £ on the Acceleration Car Pack!*

[i]*This Car Pack is not included in the Premium Version or in the Forza Horizon 5 Car Pass[/i] 

[h3]2021 McLaren Sabre[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/be4ea98a4a450eb2a62307a9440b4d0d77cc506c.png[/img]
What goes beyond a hypercar? We believe the answer to that question is “2021 McLaren Sabre”. Only 15 units of the Sabre will ever be produced, and each one will arrive at their owner’s garage with a unique livery. However, styling isn’t what makes this car shatter our hypercar parameters.  

The Sabre comes equipped with a twin turbocharged V8 engine that puts out 824 HP and can produce close to 800 Nm of torque. Put this engine into action to achieve this car’s top speed of 350 kmh, making it the fastest non-hybrid McLaren ever made. 

Of course, no hypercar is complete without a supreme exterior design. The Sabre takes some inspiration from previous McLaren designs (mainly the Senna) and adds a few upgrades that give the car the insurmountable aerodynamics it needs to make the best out of such a magnificent engine.  

[h3]2019 Ginetta G10 RM[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/fdbce27b41f6ac44b9dea2bfecde6df1907ba488.png[/img]
The closest Forza Horizon 5 will get to time traveling is taking a ride in the 2019 Ginetta G10 RM. Just in case you were wondering, the RM stands for “remastered”, meaning this high-speed classman is a new take on the already amazing original G10. 

Built to put the modern touch into Ginetta’s already extraordinary racing pedigree, the RM brings the finest contrasts between vintage and modern. For starters, the finishes on the inside of the car are made from wood and leather, the entire car is built by hand; while its glorious 6.2-liter V8 comes from the brand’s most recent prototypes.  

Get a sense of what it feels like to travel to the past with the latest technology and atention to detail in the 2019 Ginetta G10 RM. 

[h3]2022 Ford Supervan 4[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/95023d68eb7508f64726b681914545e366b40146.png[/img]
A Ford utility vehicle fitted with a 2,000 hp producing electric train? Sounds like a superhero hiding behind the outfit of a reporter.  

It might not be faster than a speeding bullet, but the 2022 Ford Supervan 4 power train can still cover massive amounts of distance in a very limited time, Four electric motors fitted underneath a built-for-the-track body make the most out of the 50 kW producing battery included in the Supervan give this van the power to sprint from 0-100 kmh in just under 2 seconds.  

Rather than holding a symbol of hope on its front, the “S” in Supervan represents Speed.  

[h3]1967 Shelby GT 500[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a6e9b865fd99ec490febf69e7e4c62fabdffff91.png[/img]
Driving off a huge victory at Le Mans, Ford took a bunch of the lessons they learnt and applied them to a performance-focused version of their next powerhouse, the 1967 Shelby GT500. 

Powering Carrol Shelby’s latest creation was a 7.0-liter V8 engine called the Cobra Le Mans, a for-the-road version of the already great 427 cu- in. Engine made by Ford. It came with 355 bhp and a rumble that very few cars of the era could match. The GT500 could run a quarter mile in 15 seconds and go from 0 – 100 kmh in just 6.5 seconds. 

The exterior of this car matched its speed and loudness, precisely what you need to stand apart from other Mustang models. Its new fiber glass front and back, as well as headlights, and characteristic grill made this car a street racer with a very sportive, modern look. 

A classic muscle car ready to take on the challenge offered by its more modern counterparts will hit the Horizon Festival on the Acceleration Car Pack. 

[h2]What’s next?[/h2] 

Apex All-Stars are approaching Forza Horizon 5! 

This next series will feature new sets of EventLab props, an all-new collectible item, and new reward cars to add to your garage will be available to unlock on the Festival Playlist! 

See you on our next series, Apex All-Stars.

notes.title: Forza Community Hubs Update #3 – Let’s Talk Cars, Tracks, and Features
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/84a0aea650ad6cfde0bd5b83ae194bd2db8ed891.jpg[/img]
Over the past few months, for both Forza Motorsport and Forza Horizon 5, we’ve been fully focused on developing new content and fixes based on your reports. Today we wanted to reflect on some of the additions to both games over the past half-year and celebrate those inspired directly by your posts on the [url=http://aka.ms/SHUB]Suggestions Hub[/url] and [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting Hub[/url].

[url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-community-update-2]In our previous blog last July, we had 239,000 votes cast[/url]. Today more than 470,000 votes have been counted across both Forza Motorsport and Forza Horizon topics. That number breaks down into 450,500 votes on the Suggestions Hub and 19,500 votes on the Troubleshooting Hub. Thank you for participating in these topics – your feedback is invaluable and helps make Forza games better for everyone.

[h2]Car Voting[/h2]

Cars are the most popular forum in the Suggestions Hub! One primary reason for this is because there are so many cars to vote on – after all, we all have our favorite cars that we would love to see in Forza someday. Out of the 14,800 topics on the Suggestions Hub today, over 9,500 of those available to vote on are car model topics. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2b0573eaa41cf0a52ce8fde69d5c9b807c017fd6.png[/img]
Here’s a look at some of the most notable vehicles we’ve introduced in Forza Horizon 5 recently:
[list]
[*][url=https://forums.forza.net/t/-/557647]2012 Nissan Tsuru[/url] was the most upvoted topic in Community Hubs history with 4,086 votes before it was added to Forza Horizon 5 in October 2023 with the Dia de Muertos series update.  
[*][url=https://forums.forza.net/t/-/557860]2023 Aston Martin Valkyrie[/url] was the 16th most requested with 826 votes when it was gifted to all players as part of the Secret Santa event in December 2023.
[*][url=https://forums.forza.net/t/gordon-murray-t-50-2022/559299]2022 Gordon Murray T.50[/url] was a top 50 requested car with 451 votes when it was gifted to all players as part of the Secret Santa event last December.  
[*][url=https://forums.forza.net/t/-/557747]2017 Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio[/url] reached 761 votes when it was added in August 2023 with the Italian Automotive series update.[/list]There are 15 Forza Horizon Car Voting topics with over 1000 votes each. These include some of the newest and fastest cars on the market today, as well as 1990s JDM cars, hot hatches, and cars seen in previous Forza games. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a99f0559af44be037f0c364ee13a74c205ed095c.jpg[/img]
Always keep in mind that highly voted cars on the Suggestions Hub aren’t guaranteed to be added in future updates. Community input is just one aspect we consider when introducing new cars or features to Forza games. There are many steps required to introduce a new or returning car to Forza, from licensing agreements and sourcing of a pristine model to 3D scanning and modelling work – all necessary steps before integrating a vehicle into the game.

Forza Horizon 5 has reached a total of 823 cars over 129 manufacturers and counting. Manufacturers like Rivian, Automobili Pininfarina, Elemental, Czinger, Lucid Air, and Gordon Murray Automotive all debuted in Forza from September through December. Forza Horizon 5 has the most makes of any Forza game in history with the largest roster of production and racing spec models.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/b37ea4f09e6635fb7f3a678f005a3b62b23f7434.jpg[/img]
Forza Motorsport also recently added the Aston Martin Valkyrie (and AMR Pro) and Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio, however Motorsport players are showing a strong interest in racing-spec models. Forza Motorsport responded to community requests for a focus on racing with 50 new racing models released across Showroom, Race Day Car Pack and Car Pass, including the following cars:
[list]
[*]Vintage to modern prototypes like the 1970 Porsche #3 917 LH, 1983 Porsche #11 John Fitzpatrick Racing 956, 1999 Nissan #23 NISMO Clarion R391, and 2023 Cadillac #01 Cadillac Racing V-Series.R.
[*]Touring cars like the 2020 Hyundai #98 Bryan Herta Autosport Veloster N.
[*]Factory race cars like the 2019 McLaren Senna GTR.
[*]Trans-Am series cars like the 2018 Chevrolet #23 Ruman Racing TA Corvette.
[*]GT3 cars like the 2019 McLaren #03 720S GT3 and 2018 Mercedes-AMG GT3.
[*]And finally, the [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/ferrari-488-gte/571518]2019 Ferrari #62 Risi Competizione 488 GTE[/url] was added as a top 30 requested car with 143 votes in January 2024 with Update 4.[/list]Forza Motorsport also debuted manufacturers BRM, Ginetta, and Oreca, as well as new-to-Motorsport Gordon Murray Automotive.

[h2]Track Voting[/h2]

On the topic of Forza Motorsport, let’s talk tracks! We've added four tracks since the launch of the game, starting with Yas Marina in November 2023.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/f33d8a79640a4a6e776bc6ba9831a320b8178fb7.jpg[/img]
We knew the Nürburgring-Nordschleife was a top community request and took the time to make it look great. Initially announced for Spring 2024, [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-5]it was released in February 2024 with Update 5[/url].

[url=https://forums.forza.net/t/daytona-international-speedway/551070]Daytona International Speedway[/url] was the 7th most requested track when it was released in January 2024, with 572 votes. Following the addition of Daytona, players requested a revision to the [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/correct-daytona-road-course-pit-exit/663256]pitlane exit[/url], quickly making that the number one topic in the Environment category with 241 votes; [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-6]we included that change in Update 6 this month[/url]. Meanwhile, [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/hockenheimring/551049]Hockenheimring[/url] was ranked 11th with 448 votes when it was added to the game in December 2023.

The current top requested track is the iconic [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/interlagos-jose-carlos-pace/551040]Interlagos Circuit (Jose Carlos Pace)[/url] in Brazil, with over 1,750 votes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/1e3018e985aa7f265851c26d0cfc925a2af4e33a.jpg[/img]
As a reminder, community voting is one element considered when a track location receives the green light for Forza Motorsport, and like cars, there are several steps required before it can be considered final and introduced to the game. Track development milestones include licensing approval, laser scanning and photogrammetry, environment art and 3D asset creation, as well as the integration of track limits, AI driving lines and other gameplay features.

[h2]Horizon Features[/h2]

With all the cars introduced to Forza Horizon 5 over the past few years, players naturally wanted more storage space for their vehicles and UGC creations. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/dc4bce06e67c5f45b74b4f92ae8314920ee0f44c.jpg[/img]
[url=https://forums.forza.net/t/increase-file-limit-500-limit-for-a-game-that-launched-with-500-cars-fh5/553394/163]Italian Automotive increased tuning and livery save slots to 1,000 each[/url]. With 451 votes, this one was a top 5 feature request for Forza Horizon 5. We also increased garage space to 2,000 cars, [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/increasing-car-limit-up-from-1000-fh5/569715/66]an important quality-of-life update which had 204 votes[/url] on the Suggestions Hub. 

The European Automotive Series update in February 2024 [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/lower-classes-rivals-for-rally-expansion/591949/33]added the full list of classes to Rally Adventure Rivals[/url]. This was the 7th most requested Forza Horizon 5 feature, with 98 votes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/1b89ce952342f09a79d517593aaba931e59dabb3.png[/img]
Top Forza Horizon 5 feature requests are typically focused on car customization; in the American Automotive series released in November 2023, we added 3 Forza Bodykits to the 1987 Pontiac Firebird Trans AM GTA, 2016 Shelby GT350R and 2017 Chevrolet Camaro ZL1. This was accompanied by 27 new rim styles from aftermarket wheels brand HRE.

We see you asking for additional building types in Horizon Mexico, and Partnerships with popular convenience store brands. [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-horizon-creatives]With the addition of EventLab 2.0 features in the Horizon Creatives series[/url], players now have a petrol station prop and the ability to use prefabs from other players to create unlimited immersive landscape features and events.

[h2]Motorsport Features[/h2]

One of the top 20 feature requests we saw at the launch of Forza Motorsport was [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/-/98768]FOV (field-of-view) positioning[/url], with 146 votes. We continue to see voting for seat position.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/06bbf87b10474fa852c62e8380465def4754d914.jpg[/img]
Following the launch of the game, we saw multiple topics [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/-/606264]suggesting changes to Car Progression[/url], with one of them reaching the #2 most requested spot. We believe the [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-6]changes to Car Progression in Update 6 [/url]satisfy most of these requests.

Currently the most requested Forza Motorsport feature is [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/-/567743]Proximity Radar at 448 votes[/url] in place of the arrows currently available in the HUD, for awareness of other cars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/c4823fb4960cdd128a2ba9596e50e6b3c761ec7e.jpg[/img]
We're continuing to work on improving Forza Race Regulations and Drivatar AI behavior to help address issues around contact with other cars, and more of the things you care about.

[h2]Troubleshooting Hub[/h2]

Each content update released for both Forza Motorsport and Forza Horizon 5 introduce new fixes to improve overall game stability alongside experience improvements that make your gameplay better. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/51bc22c4e203c827c37136054ad2bf67185b38c6.jpg[/img]
At launch, Forza Motorsport players experienced an issue with the [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/stability-game-may-hang-on-applying-upgrades-and-does-not-save-career-mode-progress-1608827/626409]game freezing after applying car upgrades[/url]. This topic was the top voted topic in Troubleshooting Hub history with 657 votes before [url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/22126464984851-Forza-Motorsport-Update-1-1-Release-Notes-October-24-2023]Update 1.1 fixed the issue[/url]. 

[url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-5]Update 5 introduced the ability to save Short Race replays[/url]. Work to improve replay save length is ongoing. Currently when racing against a full grid, short races should save most replays, while medium races will not save full replays but will save up to 11 minutes. This update also introduced PC-specific optimizations to improve framerate consistency and added the option to Skip Practice in the Career mode pre-race menu with save points for already completed practice sessions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/903f6b3429b1ed60311ff74aec2f9dbd9d3bee22.jpg[/img]
We review issues posted by players in the Troubleshooting Hub regularly and deploy fixes based on these reports with each update. [url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/27283008634515-Forza-Motorsport-Update-6-0-Release-Notes-March-11-2024]Check out the Forza Motorsport Update 6 release notes[/url] which includes fixes and improvements for the Livery Editor and AI.

Most recently [url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/27465562988691-Forza-Motorsport-Hotfix-6-1-Release-Notes-March-18-2024]we deployed Hotfix 6.1 to address HDR flickering[/url] for PC and Xbox console players under certain framerate conditions and decrease the sensitivity for Livery Editor decal movements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/edcd95dc164a676aa943c6ba6fefe42a0b88ed5f.png[/img]
We’ve crossed the finish line of this Forza Community Hubs Feedback Update! We will continue to track all your Suggestions Hub ideas and Troubleshooting Hub reports, so please keep them coming. Be sure to upvote any issues that you are also encountering in our games, and cast your votes on the cars, tracks and features you would like to see us include in the future.

notes.title: The Horizon Festival Takes a EuroTrip in European Automotive
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2b0573eaa41cf0a52ce8fde69d5c9b807c017fd6.png[/img]
The Horizon Festival sets off on a Euro trip to celebrate Europe’s car-making legacy in European Automotive. Celebrate the European legacy with eight cars coming to your garage as Festival Playlist exclusive rewards; earn PTS and complete different challenges to unlock different icons from Europe. 

Complete your collection of European strikers with the European Automotive Car Pack available from February 27. This new Car Pack includes celebrated racers and comfortable cruisers from Germany, England, and Italy.  

Plus, new props are added to EventLab featuring ancestral creatures, different types of land, and a wide assortment of shapes to include into your creations. 

We are heading for the Motherland on the new update for Forza Horizon 5! 

[h2]Release notes & Game Fixes[/h2] 

The following list details some of the fixes and changes we are implementing with this new update. 
[list] 
[*]Fixed an issue with the 1993 Nissan Skyline GTR and the 1995 Nissan GTR LM in which artifacts were visible when using Ray Tracing 
[*]It is now possible to remove the wing from the 2022 Porsche Cayman 718 GT4 RS 
[*]Fixed texture issues on the doors of the 2008 Aston Martin DBS 
[*]Fixed the cosmetic issues with the Hyundai Kona Forza Aero’s front bumper[/list] 
[url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409616884883-FH5-Known-Issues]You can find a list of issues we are currently investigating here[/url]. The [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting Hub[/url] is always open for you to leave any reports you have. 

[h2]Giants Walk the Earth Again with New EventLab Props[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/fbb569beae067f9866ae520d8d2dd8a0ac01e82d.png[/img]
European Automotive brings very special additions for creators in EventLab, several new props will add new interesting layers to creations and put your creativity to the test. 

First, 5 platforms of different terrains will be added to incorporate into your events and game modes. Choose between the different ice, grass, asphalt, dirt, and snow structures to give your events texture and depth.  

We are adding 40 new shapes all with snapping functionality. You will now be able to add 4 new cubes, cones, pyramids, wedges, and more in both plastic and concrete versions. Every plastic version of these shapes comes in 8 different colors as well. 

Did you hear that rumble? The final addition for EventLab in this series is the dinosaur props. Add 6 different scaly giants to your events and create unique game modes featuring prehistoric reptiles. Your creativity is the limit to find the best use for these new titanic props! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0132926f6837089c87aae21f1e236171ce55ff94.png[/img]
The complete list of additions includes:  
[list] 
[*][b]25 Ramps & Platforms[/b] 
[list] 
[*]5 Asphalt platforms 
[*]5 Dirt platforms 
[*]5 Grass platforms 
[*]5 Ice platforms 
[*]5 Snow platforms[/list] 
[*][b]40 Shapes[/b] 
[list] 
[*]4 Cones (2 Concrete, 2 Plastic) 
[*]4 Cubes (2 Concrete, 2 Plastic) 
[*]4 Cuboids (2 Concrete, 2 Plastic) 
[*]4 Cylinders (2 Concrete, 2 Plastic) 
[*]4 Pyramids (2 Concrete, 2 Plastic) 
[*]4 Frustums (2 Concrete, 2 Plastic) 
[*]4 Spheres (2 Concrete, 2 Plastic) 
[*]4 Torus (2 Concrete, 2 Plastic) 
[*]4 Wedges (2 Concrete, 2 Plastic) 
[*]4 Large Wedges (2 Concrete, 2 Plastic)[/list] 
[*][b]6 Dino Props[/b] 
[list] 
[*]Ankylosaurus 
[*]Brachiosaurus 
[*]Pterodactyl 
[*]Stegosaurus 
[*]Triceratops 
[*]Velociraptor[/list] 
[*][b]1 Gameplay Prop[/b] 
[list] 
[*]Star Trophy[/list][/list] 
Remember: both the shapes and platforms come with snapping functionality and plastic versions of the shapes are available in 8 different colors. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8d07443b9f8bdf96252ee24b8d6e1b798a76c597.png[/img]
[h2]Set Your Best Times in Rally Adventure![/h2] 

Sierra Nueva welcomes all racers looking for an off-roading challenge! 

European Automotive makes all classes (D, C, B, A, S1, S2, X) available to set lap times on every route on Forza Horizon 5’s second expansion Rally Adventure. 

Put your favorite rally vehicles to the test or see how good your tune ups turned out on the different stages of Sierra Nueva. 

[h2]European Automotive Car Pack[/h2] 

Celebrate Europe’s automotive legacy with a new car pack featuring four cars from some of the greatest car manufacturers Europe has gifted to the world. 

This new Car Pack contains four high-speed cruisers eager to take on the fastest courses and roads the Horizon Festival can put beneath their wheels. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2814020/Forza_Horizon_5_European_Automotive_Car_Pack/?curator_clanid=40722422

Germany, England, and Italy team up to give you some of their greatest automotive accomplishments on the European Automotive Car Pack available from February 27 for $4.99 USD/4.99€ /3.99 £. This Car Pack is not included in the Forza Horizon 5 Car Pass or in the Premium Edition. 

[h3]2021 Bentley Continental GT Convertible[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8051cb1a141eaf592e14b4a8a160359212a5c4ca.png[/img]
One of Grand Touring’s biggest icons has arrived. The power, style, and luxury of the 2021 Bentley Continental GT Convertible is here to ramble on at the Horizon Festival. 

Check that heavy metal underneath the hood; the 2021 Conti will get its indomitable power from a W12 engine that produces 626 horsepower that can hit 100 kmh from a standstill in just 3.3 seconds. 

That massive engine could only be covered with superb design. Really built with style, the luxurious heritage of Bentley shows in the door lines and headlights; the perfect way to wrap up the ideal GT ride. 

Feel the Conti’s power running through your hair when you lower this car’s top with the European Automotive Car Pack. 

[h3]1987 Mercedes-Benz AMG Hammer Wagon[/h3] 

A one-of-a-kind powerhouse, a family wagon turned into racer, a suburban king of the raceway; there are plenty of ways to describe the 1987 Mercedes-Benz AMG Hammer Wagon, but our favorite one is unique. 

This car started its lifetime as a regular wagon to drive around on Sundays with your family, until it got into the hands of AMG North America. It was then fitted with a 6-liter Mercedes V-8 and a body kit. This upgrade made the once-made-for-comfort car sprint from 0 – 100 kmh in just 5 seconds, the Hammer can also obliterate a quarter mile in mere 13.5 seconds. 

You know what they say: when in doubt, strike it with a Hammer.  

[h3]2019 Jaguar XE SV Project 8[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/6446e6bce10229528fc441a6e23fb909fb11de26.png[/img]
An apex predator of the track, the Jaguar is a magnificent specimen of British automotive prowess. And this particular type of Jaguar, is not afraid to get its claws dirty when looking for a meal. 

In the wild the 2019 Jaguar XE SV Project 8 tends to find its prey racing. When it's ready to pounce, the Project 8 puts its carbon fiber upgrades, aerodynamic remodeling, and supercharged 5.0-liter V8 engine to work, surprising any unsuspecting opponent it finds on the road.  

Unsurprisingly, this big cat’s looks are as striking as its power. A rear wing showing its power, a grill that entices racing, and racing strips that ensure maximum speed.  

Like any other feline of this lineage, taming the Project 8 is near impossible. Do you dare? 

[h3]2020 Automobili Pininfarina Battista[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/6dec7603650e406b96c689024dd60ed9f6a87e3a.png[/img]
Zero emissions and unbelievable power come together to create the Automobili Pininfarina Battista – the fastest GT car to ever come out of Italy.  

Four electric motors send power to each wheel producing a combined total of 1900 bhp, a number that will stay in your mind until you experience it firsthand. Same with its 350 km/h top speed. The Battista can accelerate from 0 – 100 km/h in 1.89 seconds, quicker than you will be able to mutter arrivederci as it flies past you.  

Tradition in design and trend setting technology come together in the latest electric warrior joining the Horizon Festival, the 2020 Automobili Pininfarina Battista 

[h2]What’s Next[/h2] 

Wait for the light to turn green and floor the accelerator! The Horizon Festival is off to the races with Horizon Race-Off, the next update coming to Forza Horizon 5 

Get ready, set, and go for Horizon Race-Off!

notes.content:

Even though this car’s name will ring a few bells and bring back memories, the new 2023 MG MG7 is like nothing you have seen before.

The classic MG went a complete redesign that you can clearly see with that new body that features a deployable spoiler that also widens as it rises. 

The MG7’s new features do not stop in aerodynamics and cosmetic changes, it also includes a 1.9-liter engine that can amass 257 bhp.
