notes.title: Drive Icons of Speed in Forza Horizon 5’s Summer Party
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/b20ed3c30e3ee351cfb6f04f9f8b76dcc831ddce.jpg[/img]
Mexico’s Summer Party is here and what better way to celebrate the sunshine festivities than with 6 unmissable cars, and for those eager to drive into the sunset and beyond, we’ve heard your feedback and permanently extended the night cycle in Forza Horizon 5.  

We recognized how much you loved the longer nights during the Midnights at Horizon series and carefully evaluated the best way to prolong the night hours indefinitely without it feeling too stretched overtime. What we’ve landed on is a balance where night-time is noticeably longer than before, but not as long as during Midnights at Horizon. This change was made entirely [url=http://aka.ms/SHUB]thanks to your contributions to the Suggestions Hub[/url], the best place to share your Forza Horizon 5 feedback. So, try out the new extended night duration and let us know how you feel about it! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/b4d3ce6687594c3432a77d425bfcf9feea4fcbaf.png[/img]
Forza Horizon 5 Summer Party will be available to download from Tuesday, July 18 with series content available to play from Thursday, July 20 until August 17. 

[h2]Games Fixes & Release Notes[/h2] 

Here’s a look at some of the fixes and improvements you can look forward to in this update:
[list]
[*]Sometimes Auction House thumbnails would not match the car paint. 
[*]Horizon Test Track UI “Performance Class” filter displayed instead of Manufacturer. 
[*]Fixed incorrect collisions and clipping issues on the 2003 Donut Media 350Z ‘Hi Car’ and 2021 Mercedes-AMG GT Black Series. 
[*]Improvements for 2022 Pagani Huarya R – flaps now function as an air brake, paintable panels, fixed displacement stat displaying 0 when switching between stock and race engine block. 
[*]Added missing anti-lag pop animation to 2019 BMW Z4, 2019 Subaru STI S209 and 1997 BMW E36 M3 when respective AC Schnitzer, Varis and Rocket Bunny bodykits are installed. 
[*]2021 Mercedes-AMG GT Black Series V12 engine swap price has been reduced to 75,000 CR. 
[*]Removed invisible thumbnail for Alejandra’s Truck from appearing in Horizon Promo. 
[*]Fixed the audible blimp sound on the highway despite it not being there. 
[*][PC] Graphics setting reset upon closing the game. 
[*][PC] Binding or unblinding Steer Left or Steer Right might also unbind the other 
[*][PC] Combine Steering and Combine Acceleration/Brakes options are not saved after changing unless Steering and Gas/Brake are rebound. [/list]Once the Summer Party update has released for download, [url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/sections/4408834302355-Release-Notes-and-Known-Issues]we will publish the release notes with the full list of included fixes[/url]. Here’s where you can [url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409616884883-FH5-Known-Issues]stay in the know with the issues that we’re investigating[/url]. Remember to report any game bugs that you encounter on the [url=https://forza.net/news/troubleshooting-hub]Troubleshooting Hub, our official issues tracker available on the Forza Forums[/url]. 

[h2]Icons of Speed[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d2a8071dd79baa9b2e4f3070b9b7412bffdca292.jpg[/img]
Available to play on Thursday, July 20, the next Horizon Story introduces you to Icons of Speed. You’ll experience the first chapter once the summer season kicks into gear. Across 8 chapters, team up with Alejandra, the head mechanic at the Horizon Festival, and experience iconic cars across the history of racing as you inspire her spark once more! 

[h3]2019 Hennessey Camaro Exorcist[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0ab08f2fcbbd00c6fabbd8894bacc59b529ea300.jpg[/img]
[i]Complete the Icons of Speed Horizon Story.[/i] 

Experience the definition of unlimited horsepower on four wheels. The Exorcist is one monstrous car with over 1,000 horses under the hood and 966 lb-ft torque, all courtesy of its powerful 6.2-liter V8 engine. The performance numbers are just as wild, accelerating from 0-60mph in 2.1 seconds before reaching a top speed of 217mph. With its high-flow supercharger upgrade, the hypercar manufacturer has successfully transformed the Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 and its already impressive performance into a formidable muscle car that celebrates the thrill of the open road and supercharges it to new heights. 

[h3]Icons of Speed Accolades[/h3] 

Unlock 10 new accolades by playing the Icons of Speed Horizon Story and unlocking the 5 Festival Playlist reward cars included in this series. 

[table]
[tr][th][b]Accolade [/b][/th][th][b]Description [/b][/th][th][b]Career Points [/b][/th][th][b]Reward [/b][/th][/tr]
[tr][td]Back to School [/td][td]Complete the "Lessons from the Past" chapter of Icons of Speed [/td][td]1500 [/td][td] [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]No Parachute Required [/td][td]Complete the "History 101" chapter of Icons of Speed [/td][td]1500 [/td][td] [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]The Golden Age [/td][td]Complete the "Hot Rod Time Machine" chapter of Icons of Speed [/td][td]1500 [/td][td] [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Time to Flex [/td][td]Complete the "Come With Me If You Want To Race" chapter of Icons of Speed [/td][td]1500 [/td][td] [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Breaking 200 [/td][td]Complete the "One Thing After Another" chapter of Icons of Speed [/td][td]1500 [/td][td] [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Join The Club [/td][td]Complete the "Past Midnight" chapter of Icons of Speed [/td][td]1500 [/td][td] [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]That was close [/td][td]Complete the "Pressure and Time" chapter of Icons of Speed [/td][td]1500 [/td][td] [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]A New Era [/td][td]Complete the "A Race for the Ages" chapter of Icons of Speed [/td][td]1500 [/td][td]2019 Hennessey Camaro Exorcist [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]A True Icon [/td][td]Earn 3 Stars on all chapters of Icons of Speed [/td][td]1500 [/td][td] [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Summer Party Collector [/td][td]Own the 2022 Toyota GR86, 1970 Hot Wheels Pontiac Firebird Trans Am Custom, 2018 DeBerti Ford Mustang GT, 1973 Ford XB Falcon GT and the 1973 Pontiac Trans Am SD-455 [/td][td]1000 [/td][td] [/td][/tr]
[/table]

[h2]Enter the Summer Party Stadium[/h2] 

The Horizon Stadium is transformed for the warm weather with its own Summer Party vibes. With summer-style ramps and smashable props, it’s the perfect location to break a sweat! Horizon Street Scene is also dressed up for the occasion with new decorations and smashable objects. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2e188c6f0eb210d6261332b07cc91f05a06e9917.jpg[/img]
Our Horizon Facilities team are here to help you cool off in the hot weather. Look for their smashable Ice Cream Cone Collectibles on the beach near Playa Azul in Week 2 of the series. That’ll keep the engines at optimal temperatures, hopefully! 

EventLab creators will find the Palm Tree Cut-Out, Wave Cut-Out and Ice Cream Cone in the Blueprint Builder. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/daf88487a0446250b6ddae5244484319420955ec.jpg[/img]
[h2]What’s Next[/h2] 

Italian Automotive celebrates its rich heritage in Horizon Mexico as Alfa Romeo, Fiat, Abarth and Lancia all return to the festival this August. We can’t wait to share more details about this incredibly exciting event in Forza Horizon 5 next month. Until then, we’ll see you at the Horizon Summer Party! 

[h2]News from the Forza Franchise[/h2] 

[h3]Add Forza Motorsport to your Steam Wishlist[/h3] 

With [b]Forza Motorsport[/b] launching [b]October 10[/b], be sure to visit our new Forza Motorsport Steam page and hit [b]Wishlist[/b] to be notified of its release. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2440510/Forza_Motorsport/ 

[h3]Check out the Forza Horizon 5 Horizon Racing Car Pack[/h3] 

Discover your next favorite car in the [b]Forza Horizon 5 Horizon Racing Car Pack[/b], featuring 4 incredible new-to-Forza cars for you to collect and drive! These high-performing cars are perfect for all the unique driving experiences the [b]Horizon Festival[/b] offers: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2440490/Horizon_Racing_Car_Pack/?curator_clanid=40722422

notes.title: Drive Iconic Cars from the New Movie, BARBIE, in Forza Horizon 5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8e522229f0e73b0ba50d674d7c849ecbd89ab086.jpg[/img]
The highly anticipated film of the summer, BARBIE, comes to the big screen taking audiences to the vibrant world of Barbie Land – where every day is the best day ever! Now, the Horizon Festival will celebrate by giving Forza Horizon 5 players the keys to two stunning cars featured in this bold movie adaptation.

See BARBIE only in theatres from July 21 and feel the magic of Barbie Land by driving the movie’s iconic cars in Forza Horizon 5 now.

[h2]HOW TO REDEEM THE BARBIE MOVIE CARS[/h2]

These The BARBIE Movie cars are available to claim in Forza Horizon 5 from 6:00 AM PT June 26, 2023 through 6:00 AM PT August 14, 2023. Here’s how you can get yours:
[olist]
[*]Once in-game open the pause menu and navigate to the "My Horizon" tab.
[*]Open the Message Center.
[*]Select the Gifts tab and look for a new message.
[*]With the gift message highlighted press the "Download" button as indicated in the bottom left corner of the screen.
[*]Enjoy driving your BARBIE cars in Mexico![/olist]

notes.title: Experience Donut Media’s Hi-Low Cars in Forza Horizon 5 Upgrade Heroes
notes.content:
Car tuners, you’re in the spotlight at Horizon Mexico’s latest event. This is Upgrade Heroes, the freshest series update in Forza Horizon 5 packed with new reward cars, new story missions and new unlockable cosmetics. Drive the iconic Hi-Low cars from our friends at Donut Media, build your cars and push them to their absolute limits at the Horizon Test Track, and fit a selection of new rims to your favorite cars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/dbd526a96ca154aac7b9888e1b1033d3f79c4013.jpg[/img]
Download the next game update on Xbox, Windows and Steam from Tuesday, June 20 and immediately check out the Horizon Test Track and new rims. Once the series begins on Thursday, June 22, play the new Donut Media Hi-Low Story and unlock some sweet new cars. 

[b]Forza Motorsport[/b] is coming to Xbox Series X|S consoles, Windows 10 and 11 PCs via the Microsoft Store and Steam, and Xbox Game Pass for console, PC and Cloud Gaming (Beta) on [b]October 10, 2023[/b]. Be sure to hit[b] Wishlist [/b]to be notified the moment preorders are available on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2440510/Forza_Motorsport/

[h2]Games Fixes & Release Notes [/h2]

Below is a snapshot of the fixes and improvements you can look forward to in this update: 

[list]
[*]New engine sound for the 2003 Nissan Fairlady Z (350Z). 
[*]ASL/BSL has been introduced for Donut Media Part 1 Horizon Story. 
[*]Improved replication of ghosting during anti-griefing measures in Multiplayer races. 
[*]Game could crash after receiving an invisible “DLC Car” as a gift. 
[*]Traction Control reactivated after restarting an EventLab from the finish screen. 
[*]Smashed Bonus Boards would sometimes display the incorrect stat in the UI. 
[*][Console] Steering Wheel Rotation default value was incorrectly set. 
[*]The Eliminator timeout bar would display the incorrect time and eliminates players early. 
[*]“Racing Champion” accolade wouldn’t unlock despite winning a Horizon Open event. 
[*]2021 Audi RS6 Avant steering wheel had inverted shift paddles and incorrect media controls. 
[*]Anti-lag pop animation was missing or clipping on specific car and body kit combinations. 
[*]Player’s character might disappear after saving a Photo Mode preset 
[*]Select cosmetic items were marked incorrectly as available through wheelspins. 
[*]Quick Chat phrases not shown when using the Logitech G920 d-pad in Freeroam and events. [/list]
We will share the [url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/sections/4408834302355-Release-Notes-and-Known-Issues]full list of fixes in our release notes[/url] once the update is released. [url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409616884883-FH5-Known-Issues]Here is where you can find the issues that we’re currently investigating[/url]. You can also report the game bugs that you encounter on the [url=https://forza.net/news/troubleshooting-hub]Troubleshooting Hub, an official issues tracker available on the Forza Forums[/url]. 

[h2]Donut Media Hi-Low Story[/h2]

The Donut Media crew are back and since their last visit, they’ve driven their Hi-Low cars to Horizon Mexico so you can experience them in a new Horizon Story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/bf3c67dac66f01d000ec9cde77e18577aa3a12e8.jpg[/img]
Get started by playing the intro mission and progress through 2 unique paths: Hi and Low. Each has 6 chapters to complete with four incredible cars to unlock: 

[h2]Donut Media Nissan 350Z Hi-Low Cars[/h2]

[i]Complete the Donut Media Hi-Low Story Chapters.[/i]

This iconic pair of “Hi-Low” Nissan 350Zs were highly modified by the Donut Media crew. The “Hi” vehicle was customized with expensive components, while the “Low” vehicle features cheaper, more budget-friendly parts. The result is a duo of wildly varied cars, both transformed from their original shared chassis.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/5d14eb6152c9246a4d15fac3c2295a7eb64858a7.jpg[/img]
Both 350Z's have "MO POWA BABEH!" thanks to an $8,100 Jim Wolf twin-turbo kit on Hi car and a $3500 single turbo on Low car. Hi car produces a solid 373hp (measured at the wheels) whilst Low car manages an impressive 302hp. 

Team Hi car's bodywork features a classic C-West body kit and Advan RG-II rims to give the car a classic JDM tuner style. Team Low car opted for a much cheaper Duraflex N1 kit, a "JGTC style" carbon hood, XXR rims and a surprisingly expensive Street Faction rear wing. Covered in light blue Plasti-dip, low car definitely stands out from the crowd! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/953acdab4b810d4aa19687e68d7898a1abe808d3.jpg[/img]
In the series, both team Hi and Low struggled with reliability, with the teams eventually choosing to V8 swap both cars later in the series. With the Horizon Festival's upgrade shop on hand, you can do the same, hopefully enjoying much more time behind the wheel and much less time wrenching than the Donut crew managed!

[h3]1994 Ford Supervan 3 'Donut Media Edition' [/h3]

[i]Complete the Donut Delivery Story Chapter.[/i]

First built in the 1970s as promotional vehicles, the Supervan combined Ford Transit vans with sports car underpinnings, for some reason. It made its first appearance at Brands Hatch, before experiencing two more iterations between 1971 and 1994. That was the year that the Supervan 3 made its debut, sporting the V8 that would eventually be used in the Benetton F1 car. In a Transit van. This special 'Donut Media Edition' features an esteemed livery topped off with an actual, literal donut. Delicious.

[h3]1996 Formula Drift #51 Donut Media Nissan 240SX[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7ecbf6e88a35d7c8a26b9105477e0f5bb5823f5e.jpg[/img]
[i]Complete the Bumper-2-Bumper Story Chapter.[/i] 

Adam Knapik is Donut Media's Technical Producer and "Shop Daddy". Having taken part in multiple different series of both Time Attack and drifting in his career, he gained his Formula D drifting license and has built this ProSpec Nissan 240SX to compete in. Under the hood of the Donut Media 240SX is an LQ9 engine, an iron-block 6.0 litre V8 usually found in much more humble SUVs and trucks. This engine has been supercharged and now produces a mighty 823hp and 884lb-ft of torque - perfect for turning rear tyres into smoke! ProSpec Formula D cars are fully specialised drift cars, Knapik's 240sx is no exception. With a huge amount of steering lock and power, they are regularly thrown into a drift at speeds in excess of 100mph. This makes the 240SX perfect for the drift zones of Horizon, maybe even with a few donuts thrown in!

[h2]Horizon Test Track [/h2]

The first Donut Media Story introduced you to the Horizon Test Track. It’s back for Upgrade Heroes and without car restrictions. Tune your car in real-time and test drive your modifications on the track. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/34036ee3efaed63cb1985390977a62d843b367d3.jpg[/img]
Once you’re comfortable with your build, you can save the tune which automatically purchases the necessary parts, or discard the tune to keep your credits – it's entirely your choice. 

The Horizon Test Track can be accessed at the Horizon Festival in Mexico through its dedicated map icon. It can also be played alongside your friends with up to 12 players in a Convoy. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/901dd7fd55c9b4ed79a502f03398f011b0a047bf.jpg[/img]
There are 15 new accolades associated with the Horizon Test Track:

[h2]Horizon Racing Car Pack [/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2440490/Horizon_Racing_Car_Pack/?curator_clanid=40722422

Discover your next favorite car in the Horizon Racing Car Pack, featuring 4 incredible new-to-Forza cars for you to collect and drive! These high-performing cars are perfect for all the unique driving experiences the Horizon Festival offers:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/1e63b25e3493e40b537ddf602dc7ffb63bb39866.jpg[/img]
[h3]2023 Lotus Emira [/h3] 

Experience the latest icon in the Lotus story, the Emira. This exotic supercar features a powertrain built to deliver blistering performance and maximum thrills – a 400-horsepower 3.5-litre supercharged V6. Once your foot is on the accelerator, it reaches 60mph in just over 4 seconds with a top speed of 180mph.  

[h3]2022 Pagani Huayra R [/h3] 

Drive the most extreme Pagani hypercar ever. Built for the racetrack, this celebration of performance and technology is an early preview of the future of Pagani craftsmanship. It's also the pinnacle of Pagani design with a V12 monster that produces 850 horses of heart-racing action. While only 30 models are destined to make their way to the real-world, the Horizon Festival has reserved one just for you.  

[h3]2021 Forsberg Racing Nissan ‘Altimaniac’ [/h3] 

Possibly the most fitting vehicle name ever, ‘The Altimaniac’ built by three-time Formula Drift World Champion Chris Forsberg is simply epic. This GT-R-powered, four-seater drift machine undertook an extensive drivetrain swap to RWD to ensure it slides once your foot hits the accelerator – a small push is all it needs to kick sideways because this Altima can deliver over 2,000 horses of ludicrous drifting power! 

[h3]2020 Saleen Sportruck XR Black Label [/h3] 

Master the off-road trails and challenges of Mexico in the rugged Sportruck XR. With a modified 5.0-liter supercharged V8 that produces 700 horsepower and 600 lb-ft of torque, as well as specially tuned front by-pass shocks with 12-inches of travel and rear shocks complete with an impressive 14-inches of travel, this performance truck deserves to be the vehicle of choice for your next expedition.   

Once the pack is purchased, you are granted a one-time only, free addition of each car to your Forza Horizon 5 garage, with no additional in-game credit cost. The Horizon Racing Car Pack is available from June 20 for $4.99 on the Microsoft Store and Steam, and is not included with the Forza Horizon 5 Car Pass, Standard, Deluxe or Premium Editions.  

[h2]Festival Playlist [/h2] 

During the Upgrade Heroes series, look out for 3 Donut Media Merch Stalls located around Guanajuato and Horizon Mexico. You will also find a smashable Tank Mechanic Pinata Collectible around the Horizon Baja circuit in the Week 2 Festival Playlist. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/69746f2f44a00320b5ad37ca03cb0c1e99ea449b.jpg[/img] 

5 incredible reward cars are featured on the Festival Playlist, including the new-to-Forza 2021 Mercedes-AMG GT Black Series and 2023 Formula Drift #64 Forsberg Racing Nissan Z.  

[h3]2023 Formula Drift #64 Forsberg Racing Nissan Z[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/15018c87ac8bd37eb7bf193bc4e25e689aa4d031.jpg[/img] 
[i]Earn 160 PTS on the Upgrade Heroes Festival Playlist. Available from June 22 – July 20.[/i] 

Three-time Formula Drift champion Chris Forsberg’s latest drift car is a 2023 Nissan Z, modified to produce an incredible 1,300 horsepower! Drifting is all about more power, and with Forsberg Racing already familiar with the 370Z line in previous competitions, its newest drift car is meaner, safer, and more performant than ever before, ready to produce an endless supply of tire smoke. This custom drift ready Z features a highly modified VR38DETT twin-turbocharged V6 engine, as found in the Nissan GT-R, but re-tuned for the drift track. It’s also an eye-catcher with its widened body kit featuring a splash of NOS Energy Drink and its exhausts popping through the hood. With numerous chassis and bodywork modifications, this Nissan Z is primed for drift competition.  

[h3]2021 Mercedes-AMG GT Black Series[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/106916112a58f7bf3e889ff60f8571dcdc3436bd.jpg[/img] 
[i]Earn 20 PTS during the Week 1 “Summer” Season on the Upgrade Heroes Festival Playlist. Available from June 22 – June 29.[/i] 

Let’s cut to the chase: the 2021 Mercedes-AMG GT Black Series is the most AMG you can have in a single chassis. By reaching impressive new heights in power, agility, style and even fun with unprecedented performance to boot, this track toy brings the latest and greatest innovations in motorsport to the open road. Under the hood is the most powerful turbocharged AMG 4.0-liter V8 engine, fine-tuned for optimal firing at minimal displacement. The numbers it achieves are truly staggering: 720 horsepower and 590 lb-ft of torque, 0-60mph in 3.1 seconds, 0-124mph in less than 9 seconds and a top speed of 202mph. This is the closest you’ll feel to the intensity of driving a racecar on the track. Aerodynamic design features like the carbon-fiber outlets on the hood help to improve downforce and high-speed control, while the mechanically adjustable diffuser and blades on the rear spoiler seamlessly adapt to the driving conditions. Its front-mid engine placement and rear-mounted transaxles also make for a perfect weight distribution. This allows for an optimal balance between speed and stability, which are undoubtedly the perfect words to encapsulate this incredible road-ready, track-focused car.  

[h3]1991 GMC Syclone[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/66b81166b3a0e07241487affeef61f28937cf9be.jpg[/img] 
[i]Earn 20 PTS during the Week 2 “Autumn” Season on the Upgrade Heroes Festival Playlist. Available from June 29– July 6. [/i] 

Sure, it looks like a pickup truck. But don’t try to haul anything except tail because payload isn’t the Syclone’s strong suit. That’s because GMC conducted a sort of mad science experiment on the Syclone. Taking stock, decidedly un-sporting Sonomas off the line, they dropped a turbocharged V6 under the hood, and then bolted on a high-performance all-wheel drive system. Instead of flipping the switch to awaken some sort of deranged old movie monster, the result was a triumph vastly superior to the sum of its parts. Genuinely fast, remarkably grippy, the Syclone is a hoot to drive. More to the point, it comes close to outperforming a lot of very expensive, exotic cars of the time while costing a whole ton less—much to the irritation of anyone who’d dropped twice the coin on a slower car. The Syclone is slightly lighter than the similarly modified Typhoon SUV, and while there’s a bit more weight over the front end, it performs essentially the same—which is to say, it’s very fast. While the sport truck segment has grown recently, few are as innovative as this AWD mini-truck, and it will take something wild to dethrone the Syclone as the best GMC pickup ever.  

[h3]1992 GMC Typhoon[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ad8ec2ecddce6c6f13533bc2ebe24b53d0656756.jpg[/img] 
[i]Earn 20 PTS during the Week 3 “Winter” Season on the Upgrade Heroes Festival Playlist. Available from July 6 – July 13. [/i] 

How audacious is the GMC Typhoon? It’s an SUV that can’t go off-road but can out-accelerate a contemporary Ferrari. With tenacious grip from a full-time all-wheel drive system, it can pull nearly 0.8 Gs on a skid pad—and this with a live rear axle sitting on leaf springs. It even uses a relatively common powerplant, the GM 4300 V6, and bolts on an intercooled turbocharger to make totally uncommon horsepower. The 280 horses on tap allow the Typhoon to do things unthinkable for an SUV before its introduction, like blasting to 60mph in 5.3 seconds. A sleeper, however, the Typhoon is not. Slammed low to the ground and sporting a full aero kit, it couldn’t possibly be mistaken for the stock GMC Jimmy that it is inspired by, even at a distance. That’s not such a bad thing, though, as the Typhoon is a truck that backs up its show with an unexpected amount of go, for an unexpectedly audacious experience.  

[h3]2009 Mercedes-Benz SL 65 AMG Black Series[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/932a12a3fe63f58a42fc7f14fad18ca67224d692.jpg[/img] 
[i]Earn 20 PTS during the Week 4 “Spring” Season on the Upgrade Heroes Festival Playlist. Available from July 13 – July 20. [/i] 

If AMG’s already impressive creations simply aren’t enough for you, there are a very small number of models that have been improved to Black Series specification, and the SL 65 joined the ranks in 2009. Starting with the standard SL 65 AMG, already potently endowed with a twin-turbocharged V12, AMG mainly focused on weight reduction. The folding hardtop and metal fenders, front bumper, and trunk are ditched for units made of carbon fiber composite, saving more than 200 lbs. (a lot of which was in the roof, so the center of gravity is lowered somewhat). Engineers also managed to enhance engine output by almost 60 horsepower, for a total of 661 horsepower (although torque, while still immense, is unchanged at 738 ft-lbs.). Performance is about what you’d expect given the modifications to the SL-Class, with a 0-60 time of well under 4 seconds and a top speed beyond 215 mph. It’s not a coupe for the faint-of-heart, but if you’re looking for a DTM-style driving experience without having to wear a fireproof suit every time you drive it, perhaps the SL 65 AMG Black Series is your car.  

[h2]What’s Next[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a10a34c079530e57af44500d71b3aa89513d8c34.jpg[/img] 

Heat up the barbecue, get sunscreen on, and drive your fastest convertible – we’re throwing a Summer Party at the Horizon Festival in July. Look forward to a new Horizon Story, new cars, collectibles, and all the necessities for a good time out in the sunshine. We’ll see you there!

notes.title: New CUPRA EVs Arrive with Explore the Horizon
notes.content:
Explore the Horizon introduces 2 new-to-Forza cars sent to all players - the 2021 CUPRA Formentor VZ5 and 2022 CUPRA Tavascan Concept! Here are the details: 

[h3]2021 CUPRA Formentor VZ5[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e88810dbfa4e2b41d3862f10576cc114d453f225.jpg[/img][i]This vehicle will be distributed at no cost to everyone who plays Forza Horizon 5 during the Explore the Horizon series. It can be redeemed by navigating to Pause > My Horizon > Message Center > Gifts from May 24 through June 22, 2023. In the following series, Upgrade Heroes, it will be available to purchase from the Autoshow for 70,000CR.[/i] 

Dream fast and break all limits in the CUPRA Formentor VZ5. This powerful road-going car features the biggest engine ever seen in a CUPRA, a 2.5-liter TSI 5-cylinder that reaches 0-62mph in 4.2 seconds with a top speed of 155mph (250km/h), and a unique firing order to minimize acceleration vibration. Its race-inspired sculpted bodywork is accentuated by matte black details, a carbon fiber front splitter and rear diffuser, and the distinctively CUPRA use of copper on the exhaust pipes and 20-inch alloy wheels. The rear of the car features an infinite light that illuminates brightly with a VZ5 emblem that beams onto the ground. Its suspension is also reduced for more precise control, especially when approaching corners at speed to ensure stability and max drivability. 

[h3]2022 CUPRA Tavascan Concept[/h3] 

[i]This vehicle will be distributed at no cost to everyone who plays Forza Horizon 5 during the Explore the Horizon series. It can be redeemed by navigating to Pause > My Horizon > Message Center > Gifts from May 24 through June 22, 2023. In the following series, Upgrade Heroes, it will be available to purchase from the Autoshow for 50,000CR.[/i] 

Meet the first all-electric SUV coupé from CUPRA. Set to arrive in the real-world in 2024, Forza Horizon 5 players can get their hands on the Tavascan early as its concept car will be made readily available to all Horizon Festival drivers. It’s the second fully-electric car from CUPRA and it’s both stylish and functional with Incredible aerodynamics and zero tailpipe emissions. Two motors housed in each axle produce a combined 250kW of power to all four wheels, while the 77kWh lithium-ion battery pack allows drivers to venture out onto the open road for up to 280 miles (450km) before a recharge. The Tavascan is also illuminated with bright coast-to-coast lights and logos, sleek exterior lines and a liquid metal paint that emphasizes its unique design details. 

[b]UPGRADE HIGHLIGHT:[/b] This vehicle features a [b]Motor and Battery Swap[/b] which also changes the EV audio for the car, try it out! 

[h3]HOW TO REDEEM YOUR FREE CUPRA EVS[/h3] 

Available to redeem from May 24 through June 22, 2023: 
[olist] 
[*]Once in-game open the pause menu and navigate to the "My Horizon" tab.  
[*]Open the Message Center.  
[*]Select the Gifts tab and look for a new message.  
[*]With the gift message highlighted press the "Download" button as indicated in the bottom left corner of the screen.  
[*]Enjoy your gift![/olist]

notes.title: Coming to Your Garage in Explore the Horizon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ba4d641defbc06eca9e9a2419845cfb477bea680.jpg[/img]
Explore the Horizon features the return of eight Seasonal PR Stunts with four Danger Signs; Ranas Saltarinas, San Juan Jump, Salto De Rio, and Metal Bird, as well as four Trailblazers; River Rapids, Cruse De Granja, Festival Descend, and Jungle Traversal. These are visible on the map with a unique purple and blue hue icon. You’ll have to drive fast to get 3 stars in all of them as they’ll only be available until the end of the series. 

There’s a new Showcase Remix available in the Summer “Wet” season – the “Splash of the Titans” event features the all-new 2019 DeBerti Ford Super Duty F-250 Lariat ‘Transformer’ racing a competitive team of jet skis. This Showcase Remix is only unlocked once the “Flood, Sweat and Gears” event (which is the standard version of this Showcase) is complete. 

New cosmetics available in Explore the Horizon include 3 Car Horns: Raptor Rawr, Reaper Cackle and Predator Howl. Players can also unlock the CUPRA Race Suit in celebration of the new CUPRA vehicles that will be gifted to all players during the series. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/5401c6c8a719cee4a0a5ffdea2cef6cf4b8b2e5e.jpg[/img]
Each Weekly Photo Challenge in Explore the Horizon has a different mini-camp site location to discover. In addition, smashable animal-shaped cardboard cut-out collectibles can also be found in different locations each week.  

Explore the Horizon introduces six new-to-Forza cars – here are the details for four that can be unlocked in the Festival Playlist: 

[h3]2019 DeBerti Ford Super Duty F-250 Lariat 'Transformer'[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e9d07004bdae45a0a3d0aedcc92666fd256f57e5.jpg[/img][i]Earn 20 PTS during the Week 1 “Summer” Season on the Explore the Horizon Festival Playlist. Available from May 25 – June 1.[/i] 

Forza Horizon players are already familiar with how DeBerti can truly transform both the looks and performance of a vehicle with unique and outlandish modifications. Their conversion of the Ford Super Duty F-250 might just be their biggest and most unforgettable build ever! It’s called the 'Transformer' for a reason with utility bedsides that can be unlocked to reveal additional stowage compartments. While the factory fitted 6.7-liter diesel engine remains under the hood, DeBerti made extensive modifications to achieve 850 brake horsepower and ensured the truck was all-terrain ready with a robust suspension system, high-visibility LED beacons and massive 37-inch tires. The load bed is also fully custom with two spare wheels at disposal and a pull-out utility box so you can always have the tools necessary to Explore the Horizon. 

[h3]1986 Ford F-150 XLT Lariat[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e86cef5531123bd96c7ea962e1fda3bb6f26578e.jpg[/img][i]Earn 20 PTS during the Week 2 “Autumn” Season on the Explore the Horizon Festival Playlist. Available from June 1 – June 8.[/i] 

The Ford F-Series of trucks have been America’s best-selling truck for the past 46 consecutive years, and America’s best-selling vehicle for 41 years. An F-Series was sold every 49 seconds in 2022! This seventh-generation “bullnose” 1986 F-150 was the model that helped secure this incredible sales feat and was a revolutionary model for Ford. With its independent Twin I-Beam 4x4 front suspension and modern, comfortable interior styling, the F-150 bridged the gap between car and truck better than ever before – a workhorse of a vehicle suitable for any task. This F-150 has the 5.0 (302) V8 under its hood producing a modest 185 horsepower. In stock form this F-150 will leave you plenty of time to see the sights of Mexico, but a quick Festival visit to explore the upgrades available will reveal that this truck can be hopped up into a serious overlanding rig. 

[h3]1972 Chevrolet K-10 Custom[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7b4d0a8c7354020f01dc61b00d448362016c6436.jpg[/img][i]Earn 20 PTS during the Week 3 “Winter” Season on the Explore the Horizon Festival Playlist. Available from June 8 – June 15.[/i] 

Chevrolet’s C/K Series trucks are some of the most popular collector trucks. This 1972 K-10 Custom is from the last year of the second generation of C/K trucks, nicknamed “Action Line.” With features including an immediately recognizable egg-crate front grille, a big squared off hood and the highly desirable Fleetside short bed, this K-10 has a truckload of retro style! The “C/K” model code refers to the drivetrain of the truck, this 1972 K-10 is fitted with a 4x4 driveline (whereas a “C-10” would be rear-wheel drive). Under the hood is the faithful Chevrolet 350 Small block V8 engine, in this application pushing out 175 horsepower. While it may be tuned for rugged reliability and not outright performance, this V8 powered 4x4 truck has all the ingredients to make a great fun Horizon exploration vehicle. 

[h3]2022 GMC HUMMER EV Pickup[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/29ee65d6bfd808e55691811bb456ed7543816202.jpg[/img][i]Earn 20 PTS during the Week 4 “Spring” Season on the Explore the Horizon Festival Playlist. Available from June 15 – June 22.[/i] 

Super cruise the roads of Mexico with the GMC HUMMER EV. This fully-equipped electric truck has 3 motors that can reach up to 355 miles of electric range on a full charge. Performance numbers include 1,000 horses of raw power with up to 11,500 lb-ft of wheel torque. There are zero tailpipe emissions and a brief 12-minute charge can get you towards an impressive 100 miles of range. Built to Explore the Horizon and traverse its most rugged terrain with ease, the HUMMER EV has unique four-wheel steering with the rear wheels capable of turning an impressive 10°, extreme off-road tires and adaptive air ride suspension options. Combined they ensure the HUMMER EV is ready to surpass all obstacles, from massive boulders to fording water. In Forza Horizon 5, it is set to “Terrain Mode” and players can fit an optional roof tent upgrade or enable its convertible functionality to remove the four modular sky panels and achieve that “infinity” setup. The truck can even reach 0-60mph in just 3 seconds – a remarkable feat for a vehicle of such sheer size and off-roading capabilities. 

[b]UPGRADE HIGHLIGHT:[/b] This vehicle features a [b]Motor and Battery Swap[/b] which also changes the EV audio for the car, try it out!

[h2]What’s Next[/h2] 

On June 22, Forza Horizon 5 celebrates Upgrade Heroes with the Horizon Test Track, new cars, new rims, new Player Badges, and more! Stay tuned for details closer to release.

notes.title: Explore the Horizon with Enhanced Photo Mode and Pathfinder Challenges
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/be397069d37e9af0fc78816a4ed5ef3e0762f744.jpg[/img]
From races and stories to road trips and expeditions, since arriving in Mexico you’ve embarked on the most incredible journeys through beautiful landscapes, vibrant towns and diverse biomes. There is so much rich heritage and culture to discover in this locale, so just how well do you know it?  

Explore the Horizon will test your Forza Horizon 5 map knowledge and lead you to breathtaking scenery along the way. With 6 new-to-Forza cars, upgraded Photo Mode features, overlanding modifications for select vehicles, and Pathfinder accolades to complete, this will be a Mexican journey like no other. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/64c1bbf06de83979a4f9b4fc651e3ed8a427ae7e.png[/img]
Dust off your camera and charge up your sat-nav, we're going on an adventure! 

[h2]Game Fixes & Release Notes[/h2] 

Explore the Horizon will be available to download on Xbox, Windows and Steam from Tuesday, May 25. Players can immediately try out the new Photo Mode improvements and explore Mexico under a new lens with Pathfinder accolades. Series content will be available on Thursday, May 25 until June 22. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ba4d641defbc06eca9e9a2419845cfb477bea680.jpg[/img]
Here is a snapshot of the new fixes and improvements included in this version: 
[list] 
[*]Launch Control settings would not save after restarting the game. 
[*]Vehicle wheels would sometimes return to their default position in Photo Mode. 
[*]On PC, the mouse cursor would occasionally disappear after some time. 
[*]Missing side-marks on the 2020 Lamborghini Huracan STO when installing the race splitter. 
[*]On the 2018 Italdesign Zerouno, the incorrect color was shown the front wheel rims and the engine frame incorrectly displayed when opening the front hood. 
[*]Taller tires option was missing on the 2014 Mercedes-Benz Unimog U5023. 
[*]Improvements have been made for some EventLab Blueprints which could cause a game crash when editing saved projects. 
[*]Fixed an issue with weather management in Multiplayer races where weather conditions in certain conditions were not consistent between players. 
[*]Controller vibration would suddenly stop working after disconnecting from an online session. 
[*]Playground Games Team Flag Rush match score could revert to 0 once a player from the opposite team left the match. 
[*]Scoreboards in Playground Games Survival Mode would disappear instead of minimizing.[/list]The full list of fixes will be published in our release notes once the update is available. Click here to see the issues that we’re currently investigating. You can also report any bugs that you’re encountering on the Troubleshooting Hub, our dedicated issues tracker on the Forza Forums. 

[h2]Upgraded Photo Mode[/h2] 

Horizon Festival organizers have sent drivers enhanced Photo Mode cameras that will make capturing incredible moments all the easier and more fun!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7c7f98b0765545273ef5ec869cbe8e0405deddd8.png[/img]
Here’s a look at the new features and selectable options for each one: 

[list] 
[*][b]Time of Day Changes:[/b] Default, Dawn, Sunrise, Morning, Early Afternoon, Late Afternoon, Sunset, Evening, Night. 
[*][b]Weather Changes:[/b] Default, Clear, Clear Post Rain, Cloudy, Cloudy Post Rain, Overcast, Light Precipitation, Heavy Precipitation, Gale, Fog. 
[*][b]Wheel Tilt:[/b] Default, Straight, Left, Right. 
[*][b]Guidelines:[/b] Disabled, Different Aspect Ratios, 9x9 Grids, Golden Ratios. 
[*][b]Character Positions*:[/b] Driver Seat, Centre Front, Left Front, Right Front, Centre Back, Left Back, Right Back, Left Side and Right Side. 
[*][b]Character Emotes:[/b] Various emotes unlocked by the player are supported. 
[*][b]Photo Presets:[/b] Added to the “Effects” menu, players can save, rename and delete Photo Mode presets to quickly load their favorite Photo Mode settings. 
[*][b]Portrait Mode Toggle:[/b] Accessed through the Guidelines, this allows players to view how the photo will appear in portrait view.[/list]*The vehicle must be stationary to access character positions outside of the car. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/cf82b50e2dfe4c27530fa37810b93e99431fb911.png[/img]
These improvements have been inspired by your feedback, and we would love to hear ideas for other features, changes and additions you would like to see in Photo Mode in the future. Let us know over on the Suggestions Hub where the team will review your submissions. 

[h2]Overlanding Modifications[/h2] 

Players who have completed Forza Horizon 5 Rally Adventure may have noticed that the 2022 Ford F-150 Lightning Platinum features a unique overlanding modification that can be fitted. It’s the perfect way to ensure your vehicle is setup for “car camping” and in Explore the Horizon, we’re rolling out this customization option to 16 additional trucks in Forza Horizon 5: 

[list] 
[*]2017 Chevrolet Colorado ZR2 
[*]1972 Chevrolet K-10 Custom 
[*]2019 DeBerti Ford Super Duty F-250 Lariat 'Transformer' 
[*]2020 Ford Super Duty F-450 DRW Platinum 
[*]2019 Ford Ranger Raptor 
[*]2017 Ford F-150 Raptor   
[*]2011 Ford F-150 SVT Raptor 
[*]1986 Ford F-150 XLT Lariat 
[*]2022 GMC HUMMER EV Pickup 
[*]2019 Hennessey VelociRaptor 6x6 
[*]2020 Jeep Gladiator Rubicon 
[*]1997 Land Rover Defender 90 
[*]2014 Mercedes-Benz G 63 AMG 6x6 
[*]2018 Mercedes-Benz X-Class 
[*]2016 Nissan TITAN Warrior Concept 
[*]2017 RAM 2500 Power Wagon[/list]Future series updates introducing new car customization pieces like body kits, parts and rims will feature a “New” label to help players locate the latest additions. 

[h2]New EventLab Props[/h2] 

The Blueprint Builder Library in EventLab continues to expand with new props and structures to help you bring your creations to life in Forza Horizon 5. In this series, we’re introducing a set of snappable asphalt pieces used to build the Horizon Oval Circuit. These can be found in a new category called “Racing.” 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2d7d92457517e41e33deb331232671823b0d2431.jpg[/img]
In addition, five new props featuring lights and a backdrop, ideal to build a photo studio, can be found in the “Decorations” tab.  

[h2]Pathfinder Challenges[/h2] 

Prove your mastery of Forza Horizon 5’s map in all-new Pathfinder Challenges. A total of 12 unique routes highlighted by markers have been added to Free Roam, with 3 available to complete in each week of the series. An associated accolade is also unlocked upon reaching the Pathfinder destination. 

Each season, the first accolade is automatically unlocked and pinning it will set a GPS marker to the start of the first route. They will be marked by a series of trail marker balloons, which will be green at the start and finish line, and red along the route. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/f3380e24b84b19e9e47db08aadb97e4d2784b995.jpg[/img]

Once the first route has been completed, a second accolade will be unlocked, however it will not be marked on your GPS – you'll need to refer to the accolade description to find out where the next one starts. This also applies to the third accolade that is unlocked upon completion of the second route. 

Once all 3 routes in a week have been finished, a Treasure Chest is unearthed near the end of the third route. By achieving all the Pathfinder accolades, a new Player Badge and the 1953 Morris Minor Series II Traveler is unlocked. 

[h2]Pathfinder Accolades[/h2]

[table]

notes.title: Set Your Fastest Speeds in Lamborghini’s Track-Fused Huracán STO
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7e9ed3db19ea3359edae697e30b58f0f49c22d65.jpg[/img]

The first week of [b]High Performance[/b] is almost here and the name of the game is SPEED! Join us at the all-new [b]Horizon Oval Circuit[/b] located within the Horizon Stadium and set your fastest laps in your favorite cars. Not sure which to choose? Luckily for you, we’ve got the perfect contender – the impeccable [b]2020 Lamborghini Huracán STO[/b], it’s new-to-Forza and it’s an unstoppable force on our racetrack! 

The Huracán STO fuses a high-end, road-legal supercar with modern race car technologies like extreme aerodynamics for incredible downforce, custom race-tuned handling, carbon-ceramic brakes, a lightweight chassis and a powerful V10 engine. Capable of 0-62mph in 3 seconds with a top speed of 192mph (310km/h), it’s blistering fast. For [b]20 PTS[/b] on the [b]Festival Playlist[/b], you too can experience decades of Lamborghini excellence and its winning motorsport heritage in a spectacular car like no other. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2d38e85a746b5e3374e88260ad13c0053cb3d311.jpg[/img]

Looking to drive more awesome cars like the Huracán STO in Forza Horizon 5? [url=http://aka.ms/SHUB]Upvote your favorites on the Suggestions Hub[/url] today and they’ll be considered for future updates. [url=https://forza.net/news/community-hubs-update-1]You can learn more about this process in our first Feedback Update to the community[/url]. 

Here are the events and rewards available on the Festival Playlist until Thursday, May 4! As always, the overall series rewards can be earned over the next four weeks:

tags.feature: The first week of High Performance is almost here and the name of the game is SPEED! Join us at the all-new Horizon Oval Circuit located within the Horizon Stadium and set your fastest laps in your favorite cars.
Not sure which to choose? Luckily for you, we’ve got the perfect contender – the impeccable 2020 Lamborghini Huracán STO, it’s new-to-Forza and it’s an unstoppable force on our racetrack!

notes.title: Experience High Performance in 4 New-to-Forza Cars
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8e08476717d33a6a333479850e21851630aa8824.png[/img]

Drive at speed on the all-new Horizon Oval Circuit with four unmissable cars all centered around High Performance. These cars are all new-to-Forza and available on the upcoming Festival Playlist. Let’s check them out! 

[h3]2020 Lamborghini Huracán STO[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/5c0384ed774e2aab06f8e18772ae0d6a4ee60d17.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during the Week 1 “Summer” Season on the High Performance Festival Playlist. Available from April 27 – May 4.[/i] 

To elevate the Huracán into a super-sports car with the prowess of a track machine, Lamborghini built the Huracán STO with one clear priority – give the world a high-end, road-legal supercar that fuses the innovative technology and unmatched driving experience of a modern race car. To achieve this, the Italian manufacturer's talented team of engineers created a bespoke design that includes extreme aerodynamics to produce incredible downforce, custom handling honed from the racetrack, special carbon-ceramic Brembo brakes derived from Formula 1, a race-ready lightweight chassis and a powerful V10 engine infused with Squadra Corse learnings that enables the Huracán STO to reach 0-62mph in 3 seconds with a top speed of 192mph (310km/h). In short, it’s blistering quick, representing decades of Lamborghini excellence and a winning motorsport heritage in a spectacular car like no other. 

[h3]2019 Porsche #70 Porsche Motorsport 935[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d663a7d5421f6f99203e7c684e028b54eac2930b.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during the Week 2 “Autumn” Season on the High Performance Festival Playlist. Available from May 4 – May 11.[/i] 

In celebration of its legendary 935/78 Le Mans racecar, Porsche reignited the storied legacy of the often dubbed “Moby Dick” with the all-new 2019 Porsche #70 935. While its heritage is deeply rooted in motorsport, the car itself isn’t homologated for competition, which gave its engineers and designers the freedom to create something truly special. Porsche DNA is written all over this car with technology based on the 911 GT2 RS, rear wing endplate LEDs from the 919 Hybrid LMP1, side mirrors taken from the 911 RSR, and exposed titanium tailpipes modelled on the 1968 908. Its 3.8-litre 6-cylinder twin-turbo engine is also nearly identical to the unit found in the 911 GT2 RS and can produce 700-horsepower with increased downforce courtesy of all-new aerodynamics. While only 77 units have been produced and are already naturally spoken for, Forza Horizon 5 players can join those lucky buyers in getting their hands on the 959’s robust carbon wheel, fittingly inspired by the 2019 911 GT3 R. 

[h3]2021 Audi RS 6 Avant[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/23e050c8e7c0df5da0f0f9a0d97ec7fe58845662.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during the Week 3 “Winter” Season on the High Performance Festival Playlist. Available from May 11 – May 18.[/i] 

Combine a 4-liter twin-turbocharged V8 engine with the chassis of a station wagon and you get the car that Audi enthusiasts have always desired. Indeed, the 2021 Audi RS 6 Avant is dream come true for fans of the German automaker, and it's backed by high-speed performance numbers that are staggering for a vehicle of its class. Its high-end Tiptronic transmission delivers the engine’s 591 horses to the signature Quattro all-wheel drive system to achieve a top speed of 189mph and it reaches 0-60mph in just 3.5 seconds. With notably aggressive yet nuanced RS-specific styling including a wide body design and flared wheel arches, a classy modern interior, and a large capacity trunk to secure all your road-trip essentials, the RS 6 Avant has it all, and is undoubtedly a road champion in true practicality. 

[h3]2021 Porsche Mission R[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/540062f2f0d24d03ebeda2ebc5fa06a58d6b9df6.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during the Week 4 “Spring” Season on the High Performance Festival Playlist. Available from May 18 – May 25.[/i] 

Pioneering the incredibly exciting future of electrified Porsche GT4 race cars, the 2021 Porsche Mission R makes a clear statement by bringing together everything that the Porsche lineage has always set out to achieve and doing it with astounding performance numbers. While the car is proof of concept and won’t enter production, the vision behind the all-wheel drive, lightweight and fully electric car has been to show how racecars could evolve over the next five to six years. Its two electric motors deliver over 800 kW (1,088 PS), which translates to 1,000 horsepower, and the car itself achieves 0-62mph in less than 2.5 seconds with an overall top speed of 186mph (300km/h). Porsche also patented the car’s distinct carbon fiber Exoskeleton roof. As for the fast-charging, thermal efficient and high-capacity 82 kWh battery powered by 900-volt technology, the car can be charged from 5% up to 80% in just 15 minutes which makes it perfect for high-intensity sprint racing. The Mission R is a testament of Porsche’s innovative engineering and technology, a truly astonishing piece of craftsmanship that is as unique as it is forward-looking because put simply, today, there’s nothing else quite like it. 

[h2]What’s Next[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/3c3d2e1396acc4588c66ea704aea3bffd0e5daae.jpg[/img]

Explore the Horizon with exciting new Photo Mode improvements and unique overlanding modifications for select vehicles that will be essential for completing new Pathfinder accolades. We’ll have more to say about this Forza Horizon 5 update closer to its release in May, stay tuned!

notes.title: Break Speed Records with High Performance in Forza Horizon 5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/9e86e7dd89e7a6d271e77c74fc4c221fc1cf9707.jpg[/img]

The latest Forza Horizon 5 series update is all about High Performance. That means fast cars, a new and permanent race oval and the opportunity to set new speed records in returning PR Stunts. 

[h2]Game Fixes & Release Notes[/h2] 

Download the new Forza Horizon 5 series update starting on Tuesday, April 25 and you’ll be ready to jump into the High Performance content two days later from Thursday, April 27. 

This version introduces some fixes to community reported issues in Forza Horizon 5 Rally Adventure: 
[list] 
[*]The 2001 #4 Ford Focus RS has been added to the Autoshow for reacquisition. 
[*]An issue that caused the Arzate Sprint Challenge and Forest Trail Master to not be marked as completed has been resolved. 
[*]Fixed an issue that prevented the Apex Predators “Let it B” mission from being completed. 
[*]We’ve addressed an issue that saw the stock PI rating being shown in various menus and event leaderboards despite the player’s car being upgraded. 
[*]Pinned Challenges showing unintendedly doubled requirements have been fixed. 
[*]On PC, improvements have been made to performance degradation that occurred in two scenarios: while driving through the deformable sand dunes, and while driving the 2021 Audi RS e-tron GT. 
[*]On Steam, we've fixed the mismatched achievements unlocked in the Xbox app.[/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8e08476717d33a6a333479850e21851630aa8824.png[/img]

In addition to those fixes, we continue to make improvements to the base Forza Horizon 5 experience using your feedback. Here are some of the fixes you can look forward to in this update: 
[list] 
[*]Requirements to bind ANNA and Forza LINK on the d-pad while creating Custom Controller Profiles have been removed. 
[*]We’ve made improvements to EventLab Rules of Play to alleviate issues where rulesets would not correctly function in multiplayer and cause players to desync. 
[*]Festival site objects have been removed from select Race Routes as those couldn’t be shown to all players. 
[*]An issue where roads would not be marked as discovered on the map has been fixed. 
[*]Fixed an issue that caused Auction House searches filtered by “Car Type” to not return results. 
[*]An issue that caused Forzathon Weekly Challenges to reset after a game restart has been fixed. 
[*]On Xbox, the HUD is no longer stuck in the center of the screen if playing on an ultrawide display.[/list]As always, [url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/sections/4408834302355-Release-Notes-and-Known-Issues]we’ll share the full list of fixes in our release notes[/url], which will be published once the update has been released. [url= https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409616884883-FH5-Known-Issues]Click here to see a list of the issues that we’re currently investigating[/url]. You can also report any bugs that you’re encountering on the [url= https://forza.net/news/troubleshooting-hub]Troubleshooting Hub, our dedicated issues tracker[/url]. 

[h2]Gear up for the High-Speed Horizon Oval Circuit[/h2] 

This series, the Horizon Stadium has been transformed into Oval Circuit decorated with various Horizon race-inspired props. While this area can be fully explored in Free Roam for the High Performance series only, the track itself has been permanently added as a race route to the game.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/77f5cdcbe99d5d54aa7982bd04c22a0b7159651a.jpg[/img]

Players can launch the Horizon Oval Circuit as a Road Racing event for solo, cooperative and competitive play, set their fastest leaderboard lap time on it in Rivals and even use it as a new EventLab build stub. 

20 new accolades have been added for the Horizon Oval Circuit along with the new series car collector accolade. Check them out below:
[table]
[tr][th][b]Title [/b][/th][th][b]Description [/b][/th][th][b]Career Points [/b][/th][th][b]Reward [/b][/th][/tr]
[tr][td]An Ellipse of the Heart [/td][td]Visit the Oval Track at the Stadium in Freeroam [/td][td]100 [/td][td]  [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Rally-go-Round [/td][td]Drive 1 mile around the Oval Track in any Modern Rally Car while in Freeroam [/td][td]100 [/td][td]  [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Cirque de Skill [/td][td]Earn a total of 25,000 Skill Score in any American Car at the Oval Track in 1 minute while in Freeroam [/td][td]100 [/td][td]  [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Through a Circular Lens [/td][td]Take a photo of your car at the Oval Track while in Freeroam [/td][td]100 [/td][td]  [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Whorl of a Time [/td][td]Earn 3 One-Eighty Skills at the Oval Track while in Freeroam [/td][td]100 [/td][td]  [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Drop the Ball [/td][td]Earn 5 Awesome Drift Skills or E-Drift Skills at the Oval Track in any Classic Muscle Car while in Freeroam [/td][td]100 [/td][td]Clothing “Light Blue High Tops” [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Spherely Stocked [/td][td]Reach a speed of 100mph (160km/h) in the 1972 Ford Falcon XA GT-H0 at the Oval Track in Freeroam [/td][td]100 [/td][td]  [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Stadium Snapshot [/td][td]Take a photo of any Retro Muscle Car at the Oval Track while in Freeroam [/td][td]100 [/td][td]  [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Disc Drifting [/td][td]Earn 3 Awesome Drift or E-Drift Skills at the Oval Track while in Freeroam [/td][td]100 [/td][td]Forza LINK: “Preparing for Take-Off” [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Spin the Wheel [/td][td]Earn 4 Ultimate Burnout Skills in any Retro Rally Car while at the Oval Track in Freeroam [/td][td]100 [/td][td]  [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Friendly Circle [/td][td]Complete a Race at the Oval Track Event [/td][td]100 [/td][td]Horn “Tape Rewind” [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]All-Around Winner [/td][td]Win a Race at the Oval Track Event [/td][td]100 [/td][td]  [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Centrifugal Force [/td][td]Earn 10 Speed Skills in any Classic Muscle Car at the Oval Track Event [/td][td]100 [/td][td]  [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Polished off the Competition [/td][td]Earn 5 Clean Racing Skills in the Oval Track Event [/td][td]100 [/td][td]  [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Rally Ring [/td][td]Reach a Speed of 100mph (160km/h) in any Modern Rally Car while in the Oval Track Event [/td][td]100 [/td][td]Clothing “Leaf Pattern Leather Boots” [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Pivot and Pace [/td][td]Drive above 200mph (321 km/h) in any Porsche while in the Oval Track Event [/td][td]100 [/td][td]  [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Passing the Perimeter [/td][td]Earn 5 Triple Pass Combos while in the Oval Track Event [/td][td]100 [/td][td]  [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Slingshotted Out of the Ring [/td][td]Earn 3 Slingshot Skills while in the Oval Track Event [/td][td]100 [/td][td]  [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Perfectly Tuned Turn [/td][td]Win a Race at the Oval Track Event while in a Super Hot Hatch upgraded to 'S1' Class [/td][td]100 [/td][td]  [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Cool, Collected, Concentric [/td][td]Earn 3 Awesome Speed Skills while in the Oval Track Event [/td][td]100 [/td][td]  [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]High Performance Collector [/td][td]Own the 2021 Audi RS 6 Avant, 2020 Lamborghini Huracán STO, 2019 Porsche #70 Porsche Motorsport 935, 2021 Porsche Mission R  [/td][td]1000 [/td][td] [/td][/tr]
[/table]
In addition to the Horizon Oval Circuit, look out for the return of six returning PR Stunts with four Speed Traps including Horizon Baja, East Resort, Pantano Pass and Tulum, as well as two Speed Zones including Green Hills and River Run. These are visible on the map with a unique purple and blue hue icon. You’ll have to drive fast to get 3 stars in all of them as they’ll only be available until the end of the series. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/9775feece4d7afa237a7552fa9897ecae98b4d9f.jpg[/img]

In the second week of the Festival Playlist, smash through the Pinata Helmet Collectible found around the Horizon Festival Mexico to complete the “Safety First” challenge and unlock the “It is the way” chat phrase for Forza LINK. The Pinata Helmet prop has also been added to the EventLab Blueprint Builder, under the Gameplay category. 

[h2]New Badges and Character Cosmetic Improvements[/h2] 

Players can unlock new Profile Badges based on the number of unique cars stored in their garage: 
[list]
[*][b]Ghost Badge:[/b] Own 500 unique cars 
[*][b]Blue Heart Badge:[/b] Own 600 unique cars 
[*][b]T-Rex Badge:[/b] Own 700 unique cars[/list]Please note that duplicate cars will not count towards unlocking these new Badges. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/90efd1bb27514d2a2e61472b0d02bb9731a88847.jpg[/img]

In addition, we’ve added a new feature to Character Customization which automatically adapts the color of a prosthetic or hearing aid to the character’s skin tone. 

[h2]What’s Next[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/3c3d2e1396acc4588c66ea704aea3bffd0e5daae.jpg[/img]

Explore the Horizon with exciting new Photo Mode improvements and unique overlanding modifications for select vehicles that will be essential for completing new Pathfinder accolades. We’ll have more to say about this Forza Horizon 5 update closer to its release in May, stay tuned!

notes.title: Feel Luxurious in the Truly Elegant 2021 Lexus LC 500
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/5adbe6798ce8d5f991db23717027c65e293828b0.jpg[/img]

[url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-midnights]It’s the penultimate week of Midnights at Horizon[/url]! Now is the perfect chance for you and your Convoy to soak in the neon-transformed airfield south of Mexico and discover epic drone shows, the Neon Lights Tank and extended nighttime available until April 27.  

Looking for fellow drivers to join your driving adventures? [url=https://aka.ms/ForzaForums]Join the Forza Forums[/url] to discuss the latest Festival Playlist content, [url=https://aka.ms/SuggestionsHub]check out the Suggestions Hub[/url] to share your feedback and upvote cars you would like to see added in the future, and [url=https://forums.forza.net/c/troubleshooting/247]report any game issues on the Troubleshooting Hub[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e2a23b02aa4c6a3457a7d6dfffcb43ec3aa58218.jpg[/img]

This week is all about luxury driving with the [b]2021 Lexus LC 500[/b] available to unlock for 20 PTS on the Festival Playlist. The 2021 spec features cornering assist with braking control, so you can maximize its 5.0-liter, naturally aspirated V8 with confidence. Once unlocked, the Horizon Festival mechanic can get it fitted with an optional [b]Liberty Walk body kit[/b] – available from the Tuning & Upgrades menu.  

You have until [b]Thursday, April 20[/b] to secure this week’s rewards on the Festival Playlist with the overall series reward cars available until April 27: 

[b]SERIES REWARDS [/b]
[list]
[*][b]80 PTS:[/b] 2012 Porsche 911 GT3 RS 4.0 
[*][b]160 PTS:[/b] 2012 Lamborghini Aventador J [/list][b]WINTER REWARDS [/b]
[list]
[*][b]20 PTS:[/b] 2021 Lexus LC 500

Welcome to [b]Midnights at Horizon[/b], the latest Festival Playlist series [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-rally-adventure-now-available]accompanying the launch of Forza Horizon 5 Rally Adventure[/url]. If you’ve yet to experience the rugged Sierra Nueva, jump in today and race on the most challenging and exciting roads in Forza Horizon history. Featuring asphalt roads, dirt trails and thrilling night routes, as well as 10 incredible new off-road cars to unlock, can you prove your mastery across all facets of rally driving? 

To celebrate the Grit Reaper’s love of night rally, look out for the neon-transformed airfield south of Mexico, epic drone shows, the Neon Lights Tank and extended nighttime until April 27.

For some sideways action, disable the front motors by pushing the Left Stock to enable “Drift Mode.”

notes.title: Forza Horizon 5 Rally Adventure is Now Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/13b1892cf1c6c783ea5f6df4cae0295dd4d1feb1.jpg[/img]

Today is the day! All of us here at Playground Games are excited to welcome you to Sierra Nueva as you begin your Forza Horizon 5 Rally Adventure. Play it today on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, PC on Windows and Steam, and Cloud Gaming (Beta). 

Ready to jump in? If you already own the Forza Horizon 5 Premium Add-Ons Bundle, Premium Edition, or Expansions Bundle, you’re all set to begin playing. Simply download the latest Forza Horizon 5 series update and the Forza Horizon 5 Rally Adventure expansion from the Microsoft Store or Steam. For those of you who do not yet own Forza Horizon 5, all versions of the game are now 40% off the full price on the Microsoft Store and Steam. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1613281/Forza_Horizon_5_Rally_Adventure/?snr=1_5_9__405

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/21685/Forza_Horizon_5_Premium_AddOns_Bundle/?snr=1_5_9__403

[previewyoutube=ajFf2RaiZu4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]How to Play[/h3] 

As noted above, to play Forza Horizon 5 Rally Adventure you will need to download both the latest game update and the expansion separately. Once installed, you can load into the game and begin the Horizon Badlands Expedition by accessing the Rally Adventure icon on the northwest coast of the game map in Dunas Blancas. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/67d67616f4507cdad45388fc4582f6b2ac01daa7.jpg[/img]

Players who are brand-new to Forza Horizon 5 will need to complete the initial experience of the base game before travelling to Sierra Nueva. This includes the first drive to the Horizon Festival, the creation of your character and selecting a starter car, the first Showcase Event featuring the Cargo Plane, and completing either of the first two available Horizon Story chapters. 

Once the Horizon Badlands Expedition is completed, you can access the Sierra Nueva map through the Pause Menu at any time. Fast Travel is free and immediately available to those who own the Buenas Vistas Player House in Mexico. Players have access to their full garage in Sierra Nueva and can begin exploring the new map and career in their favorite cars without any class restrictions. 

[h3]Build Your Rally Career[/h3] 

Forza Horizon 5 Rally Adventure introduces players to an all-new rally career. In the first hour of gameplay, familiarize yourself with all three rally teams as you get a flavor of asphalt, dirt and night racing in Sierra Nueva. Each team has a dedicated captain who will be your co-driver in events. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/6baf7996f33e4d2e46e480c1623b739d66983954.png[/img]

Captained by Alejandra, the Apex Predators are all about the asphalt in Road Rally. Alex leads the Horizon Raptors ready to kick up the dust in Dirt Rally. Finally, as the Grit Reapers ambassador, Ramiro will put that dramatic helicopter spotlight to use in Night Rally.  

Once you’ve experienced the first rally of all three teams, you’ll choose your starter team. Each unlocks new events and challenges, featuring a dedicated progression tree with nine Reputation Ranks and unique rewards. Completion of Reputation Challenges will contribute to unlocking new events, rewards and the invites to join the other rally teams. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a4f1e2bb2e9ec4e6bff8735e54300e6497824d0c.jpg[/img]

Once Reputation Rank 8 and eight race victories have been achieved in each team’s career, the associated head-to-head Ambassador Race is unlocked. Beating the team captain rewards the player with their car, while winning all three unlocks the Horizon Badlands Goliath, where you can race to become the Horizon Rally Champion and drive home in the all-electric 2022 Ford F-150 Lightning Platinum. 

[h3]Leave Your Mark[/h3] 

Sierra Nueva introduces several new biomes to explore including the town of Pueblo Artza, a huge Abandoned Quarry perfect for some Gymkhana action, epic deformable Sand Dunes, the tight and twisting Desert Gorge, rolling Green Hills, and an entirely smashable Palm Forest. You’ll even find the remote village of Cráteres Secos nestled into a breathtaking crater! These biomes will change every week as seasonal rotations occur and bring new weather changes, just like on Mexico. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ed35246dcc4f082acabd0decf5590459b2634592.jpg[/img]

With a great mix of asphalt and off-road tracks, Sierra Nueva features a drivable area of 6.25 miles squared – that's 16.2km squared – with 38 miles (61km) of roads full of unpredictable adverse-camber turns, blind crests and thrilling asphalt jumps. For a closer look at the environments of Sierra Nueva, [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-rally-adventure-map-reveal]check out our deep dive here of each biome[/url]. Now let’s explore the improved deformation technology in Forza Horizon 5 Rally Adventure.  

Over the years rally drivers have put Sierra Nueva through its pace and this is nowhere better reflected than in the rugged deformable sand roads interwoven with pre-deformed tire tracks. As deformable surfaces are driven over repeatedly, they accrue multiple tire tracks and trails. Tire tread is visible in these deformed tracks while the deformation-width is adjusted based on the car’s speed, tire size and steering angle.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/3fd7d3902b5de5f0184575bad5ae091a77f30c3f.jpg[/img]

Meanwhile, sand trails kicked up by vehicles can be seen in the far distance, so you can spot the work of other drivers that are miles away! It also persists for longer with shadows and camera-lens accumulation as you drive through it. These dust plumes are physics-driven and result in the most complex weather effect in a Forza Horizon game.  

[h3]Horizon Rally Modes[/h3] 

All events in Sierra Nueva feature two distinct flavors of off-road racing: Horizon Rally and Horizon Race. Both modes do not enforce car restrictions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/45be680605241ed9771601c2584aab00bf11a1a5.jpg[/img]

Horizon Rally is a race against the clock. Follow your co-driver's pace notes and drive as fast as possible through the four split gates that are placed at around each 20% interval of the track. The co-driver is on standby from the Horizon Rally Helicopter, which dynamically follows the car and provides audio-visual callouts like upcoming turn and obstacle alerts. Hold up, did they say Chicken? 

Each split-gate crossed is accompanied by a notification to highlight where you’re currently positioned on the leaderboard stage. Here's how to interpret these colors:
[list]
[*]Red: You have lost a position relative to other competitors.  
[*]Orange: You have maintained your position.  
[*]Green: You have improved your position. 
[*]Light Green: You are in first place.[/list]Horizon Rally events can be played in co-op with collisions disabled. For a more immersive rally experience, disable the Rally Driving Line option in the driving assists menu. This separate toggle only applies to Horizon Rally events. You can also further spruce up the challenge by increasing the AI difficulty or the PI class of your car. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/564cc4145f65df07cfeecf5caa9ff5d266449434.jpg[/img]

Secondly, there’s Horizon Race – the racing action you already know and love from the Horizon Festival. Only this time, you’re taking on a pack of rally drivers on the thrilling roads of Sierra Nueva. Race against Drivatars or other players with collisions enabled. This mode does not feature the co-driver or helicopter. 

[h3]Race Events and PR Stunts[/h3] 

Forza Horizon 5 Rally Adventure features the largest number of racing events of any Horizon expansion, and in Sierra Nueva, this means the most thrilling routes in Horizon history, so buckle up.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/510ba2c60619d194fa08ff387e67e90f77377520.jpg[/img]

Here’s a look at the new Horizon Rally and Horizon Race events with all routes also supported in Rivals:
[list] 
[*]Road Racing: 8 Apex Predators tracks. 
[*]Dirt Racing: 8 Horizon Raptors tracks. 
[*]Mixed Surface (Night only): 8 Grit Reapers tracks. 
[*]Head-to-Head: 3 Ambassador Races with mixed surface cross-country events. 
[*]Goliath Race featuring a mix of asphalt and dirt surfaces.[/list]Here’s the breakdown of the 20 new PR Stunts:
[list] 
[*]5 Speed Traps: Unlocked through Apex Predators. 
[*]5 Speed Zones: Unlocked through Apex Predators. 
[*]5 Danger Signs: Unlocked through Horizon Raptors. 
[*]5 Drift Zones: Unlocked through Grit Reapers.[/list]With the Midnights at Horizon series, new Rally Adventure events will be added to the Festival Playlist. These will include a Seasonal Championship and PR Stunt every week and are unlocked upon completion of the Horizon Badlands Goliath. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2b12a5b8145331c89e28313d1af6cc9193966b4b.jpg[/img]

Look out for new smashable objects in Sierra Nueva including the Horizon Raptors Pinata Trucks at day and the Grit Reapers Crates at night, both of which respawn, as well as the Apex Predators Promotion Boards. There are 30 of these scattered around the map and they do not respawn once smashed! 

[h3]Multiplayer[/h3] 

Horizon Open, Horizon Tour and Rivals are all available to enjoy in Sierra Nueva. Join a Horizon Open or Rivals event through the Rally Adventure tab in the Pause Menu. Go to the Horizon Tour icon located in the center-right area of the map to team-up with fellow players and race a team of Drivatars. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2d6ffc6aaafe8d41ae522bd77c6b9ad29542decf.jpg[/img]

Horizon Open features available in Sierra Nueva include Badges, Open Racing, Custom Racing and Leaderboards. The custom filters include Road and Dirt with class options for Any, S2, S1, A, and B. All the Rally Adventure routes mentioned above are present in Horizon Open. 

[h3]Create A Rally Monster[/h3] 

New features introduced in the [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-midnights]Midnights at Horizon series update[/url] – available free for all Forza Horizon 5 players – allow you to build the rally machine of your wildest dreams.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/bde4be90e97399aba9efbd32a6e2c2158f1d2ea2.jpg[/img]

Look out for all-new rally parts and body kits, adjustable Tire Profile Size on select vehicles to fit massive wheel arches, and an anti-lag system that delivers more power to turbocharged engines while producing spectacular flame effects and fire-cracker audio. Players can also enable launch control as a new driving assist to ensure a perfect start in both rally and drag racing!  

Over in the EventLab Blueprint Builder, we’ve introduced new objects including branded barriers, flags and civilian vehicles, allowing you to build races that capture the look and feel of a Horizon Rally event! 

[h3]Start Your Rally Adventure Today[/h3] 

[previewyoutube=gvSwqtK4Eso;full][/previewyoutube]

Between its challenging roads and epic dust kick-up, we’ve designed every mile of Sierra Nueva to be incredibly fun and exciting. We can’t wait for you to embark on your Forza Horizon 5 Rally Adventure. Get it today on the [url=https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/forza-horizon-5-rally-adventure/9PCR7TSM1S96]Microsoft Store[/url] or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1613281/Forza_Horizon_5_Rally_Adventure/]Steam[/url] if you haven’t already, and we’ll see you at the Horizon Badlands Festival!
