notes.title: Forza Year in Review – 2022
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ce2401f54f4fe238263149d9204fe23b61fe1ed4.jpg[/img]

[h2]It’s almost time to ring in the New Year, however before we turn those calendars over to 2023, we’re looking back on the last twelve months of Forza. This is the 2022 Forza Year in Review![/h2]

From the release of Forza Horizon 5: Hot Wheels and the 10-Year Anniversary celebration of the Forza Horizon series to the first gameplay reveal of the all-new Forza Motorsport, as well as monthly series updates for Forza Horizon 5 and ongoing community Rivals events in Forza Motorsport 7, this has undoubtedly been a busy year for Forza fans.

To kickstart this Year in Review, we’re celebrating some of the most creative content submitted into our weekly Forza Horizon 5 Photo and Livery Contests. We’ve taken all the frontrunners from the past year and put them head-to-head in the ultimate showdown! Here are the winners and don’t forget to check out the Forza Forums for the full gallery of submissions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/10384e1b444cfead9b07237427a9ebb32da9500e.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][url=https://forums.forza.net/t/best-of-2022-in-fh5-photos/578752][b]Best of 2022 in FH5 Photos[/b][/url]
[*][url=https://forums.forza.net/t/best-of-2022-in-fh5-liveries/578733][b]Best of 2022 in FH5 Liveries[/b][/url][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/fca99c4a9dff3e4de1cd156e73e4f85919ecbb29.jpg[/img]

[h2]Community Leaders[/h2]

Community is at the heart of the Forza franchise, and we’re constantly in awe of the incredible accomplishments of our players. Before we dive into everything that we’ve done this year, here’s an overview of what just some of most prominent community leaders have achieved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e934023f48feac0321123683333e4fa24e751a32.jpg[/img]

The Forza Spec Racing Series kicked off 2022 with its 44th season. LS Subaru continued their success from the year prior by securing a third consecutive championship and would go on to dominate the year’s schedule. In total, 47 drivers took on 54 races in six different vehicles. For 2023, the series celebrates ten years running with Season 50 starting January 10. No matter your racing finesse, everyone is invited to participate. Learn more and register on the r/FM4 subreddit.

In March, the long-running community racing league TORA (The Online Racing Association) hosted the 12 Hours of Sebring Revival on Forza Motorsport 7, where a staggering 106 teams – yes, you read that correctly – took the green flag across six lobbies with Daytona Prototype and GT machinery producing some epic racing action. From morning into darkness, the fight for the lead was never certain, with multiple teams holding the top spot in each stint. This event proved you should never give up on a race, as the winners ESV can attest to!

Fast forward to June when Forzatography Central hosted their special FTC30 event, 30 days of Forzatography. Each day featured a unique theme to spotlight the absolute best of the community's creativity. With so many wonderful pictures from both newcomers and veterans alike, it was truly incredible to see it all come together. To stay up to date with their latest Forzatography goodness, [url=https://twitter.com/FTCentral_]be sure to follow the FTCentral page[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/f73cec6445bc29bcb67ec7f39dedbf006fb1a76e.jpg[/img]

2022 has been an exciting year for the FH5 Livery & Designs team resulting in 60 incredible designs being shared for everyone to download in Forza Horizon 5. With livery competitions ranging from Muscle Cars, Drift Kings to Halloween, the creativity and skill of this community was on full display all year long. The Halloween event proved to be a particular favorite among the team’s admins thanks to a staggering number of fearsome entries suitable for some thrilling scares across the Horizon Festival.

[h2]January[/h2]

We started 2022 by [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-series-3-update]celebrating the Lunar New Year in Forza Horizon 5[/url] with lanterns dressing the streets of Guanajuato, new Trailblazer PR Stunts, new Festival Playlist reward cars such as the 2003 Toyota Celica SS-I and the 2016 Zenvo TS1, and new Car Pass vehicles like the 1993 Jaguar XJ220S TWR and the 2018 Ferrari FXX-K Evo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/25548b729ab63f44426106d7aaac1d988549103d.jpg[/img]

Over in Forza Motorsport 7, we highlighted the return of Master Chief following the release of Halo Infinite one month prior. Players would drive the 2016 Jeep Trailcat on the Dubai Mountain Circuit to unlock Master Chief Driver Gear and an exclusive Halo Infinite livery – with a special Spartan-117 version reserved exclusively for those fastest lap times in the top 20% of the leaderboard.

At the end of the month, we invited [url=http://josefnewgarden.com/]our close friend of the Forza franchise and two-time IndyCar champion Josef Newgarden[/url] to throw it down in a special Rivals events featuring the 2019 Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 Pace Car on Watkins Glen. Josef would return in March and May with two additional events, featuring the 2015 #10 Konica Minolta Corvette on Brands Hatch GP and his very own 2019 Chevrolet #2 Team Penske Dallara at “The Brickyard” on Indianapolis Motor Speedway to celebrate the Indy 500. Rewards were just as aplenty, including exclusive Josef Newgarden liveries for each vehicle, as well as special variants for those who beat Josef’s time. Chevrolet and Indianapolis Driver Gear were also up for grabs.

[h2]February[/h2]

The [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-series-4-update]Horizon World Cup made its Mexico splash in February[/url]. You could support France, Germany, Italy, Japan, the UK or the USA by driving the cars of the country you wanted to cheer on in Festival Playlist events. Racesuits representing each of the competing countries were unlocked, while new Chinese cars were introduced into the Forza franchise for the first time, including the all-electric 2016 NIO EP9, the 2013 Wuling Sunshine S microvan and the 2015 MG MG3, which is the most popular Chinese manufactured car sold today in the UK!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/1ae3012d5801a4eefd8c54a1ac18e35924251f9e.jpg[/img]

Car Pass owners also received a new collection of cars, including the aggressively styled yet iconic 2005 MG XPower SV-R, a modern revision of one of the most renowned hatchbacks in the world, the 2021 Volkswagen Golf R, and a legend in Japanese hot-hatchback design, the 1992 Mazda 323 GT-R.

With this update, we also introduced the option to save and edit EventLab Blueprints, which had been highly requested from the community since Forza Horizon 5 released.

Japan emerged on top of the Horizon World Cup followed by France and Germany respectively. Check out the infographic below for a refresher on your incredible accomplishments throughout the greatest sporting event at the Horizon Festival:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/c00e044c529efcbdef2939e77dee996dada736e0.jpg[/img]

[h2]March[/h2]

The [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-series-5-update]Horizon Rush Takeover introduced several new PR Stunts[/url] and even transformed the Horizon Stadium into a dedicated Stunt Park where players could show off their best driving skills. With this update, we also expanded our accessibility options with [url=https://news.microsoft.com/features/forza-horizon-5-introduces-sign-language-support-throughout-in-game-scenes/]American Sign Language (ASL) and British Sign Language (BSL) for cinematics[/url], a feature that makes Forza Horizon 5 accessible to more players.

In addition to new EventLab props for creators, this update introduced some important fixes to the Festival Playlist and Photo Mode, as well as improvements to the Livery Editor interface and traffic synchronisation. For your garage, there was the aggressive and fast 2020 Nissan GT-R NISMO (R35) and the 1965 MINI Cooper S Forza Edition, while Car Pass holders received the 2006 Noble M400 and the 2017 Ferrari #25 Corse Clienti 488 Challenge.

[previewyoutube=7-LqVe2PArM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

In March, we also [url=https://forza.net/news/the-new-forza-forums-have-arrived]launched the new Forza Forums[/url] with a revamped navigation layout and faster loading, forum tags, as well as thread sorting.

To celebrate women in motorsports as part of Women’s History Month, we teamed up with professional race car driver Shannon McIntosh who inspired a new Rivals event, and its reward, in Forza Motorsport 7. Drivers would set their fastest times in the 2013 Ford Formula Ford EcoBoost 200 on Maple Valley to unlock an exclusive livery for that vehicle, which pays homage to Janet Guthrie and the IndyCar that she raced in the 1978 Indy 500. Drivers in the top 40% also received the elusive M. Rossi Driver Gear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e82e2fc5b08d506bcc396f6bb0b379d14f9fd9ba.jpg[/img]

Later in the month, we released another Forza Horizon 5 update. [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-series-6-update]Horizon Customs celebrated both the creative and racing talents of our community[/url] with Horizon Open Custom Racing, new unlockable Badges, and new EventLab features such as the Scale Gravity rule and improvements to terrain visibility at high altitude to provide a better visual experience when playing certain Blueprints.

Drift Club also made its mark on Mexico with the return of Welshman Robert Glenn and a new set of challenges, where you could get behind the wheel of the revolutionary 2021 Ford Mustang Mach-E 1400, courtesy of Formula Drift champion and RTR Vehicles founder Vaughn Gittin Jr. This car is incredibly unique with its ability to seamlessly swap between RWD and AWD at a button push.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/b29ac0987381cb361f99df597236ee0893fcb169.jpg[/img]

Over on the Festival Playlist we introduced the 2021 McLaren 765LT Coupe and the 2012 Ascari KZ1R, while Car Pass holders could drive the race-ready 2021 McLaren 620R and the 2021 MINI John Cooper Works GP, the fastest MINI ever.

[h2]April[/h2]

April saw us bring [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-series-7-update]Cinco de Mayo to life in Forza Horizon 5[/url]. As an annual celebration of Mexico’s culture, cuisine and heritage, new colorful decorations were displayed in Guanajuato, and we introduced new character cosmetics inspired by Mexico’s murals. We also added over 200 new Horizon Tour championships including S2 class racing, while new props and customizable rule conditions become available in EventLab, such as “Get Engine Torque” and “Get Gravity.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ca7398937ddd492e4360d7ee19cb17f2b6c2edea.jpg[/img]

We also brought in fixes for Treasure Chests not solving, the Weekly Forzathon Challenge not registering the required car being owned and driven in the first chapter, and stalls on PC when challenging other players to head-to-head races.

Over on the Festival Playlist, we gave players a chance to unlock the car that celebrated 90 years of Scuderia Ferrari, the 2020 Ferrari SF90 Stradale, as well as the 2020 Ferrari F8 Tributo, a car that pays homage to the Prancing Horse’s most powerful V8 yet. Meanwhile, the Car Pass received the 2014 Forsberg Racing Nissan 'SafariZ' 370Z and the 2008 Dodge Magnum SRT8.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/89a834f7ad13d24d79d13ad6c1254acb0ec19efa.jpg[/img]

To celebrate Earth Day on April 22 and support Microsoft and Xbox’s commitment to reduce our carbon footprint and to raise awareness with our community, we featured a Forza Motorsport 7 Rivals event on VIR – Grand West featuring the 2010 Chevy #99 Green Earth Team Gunnar Oreca FLM09. All participants received an Earth Day themed livery on the 2015 BMW i8, while those in the top 40% unlocked an Earth Day themed Driver Gear.

[h2]May[/h2]

Just before Forza’s busiest month on the calendar, [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-series-8]we celebrated German Automotive Excellence in Forza Horizon 5[/url] with new cars like the 2021 Porsche 911 GT3 and the 2018 Audi RS 4 Avant, while over in the Car Pass, we introduced the 2020 BMW M8 Competition Coupe and the 2020 Audi RS 3 Sedan.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2d5350f868379bf0c55e6f788822d4c4f3cb3abc.jpg[/img]

We teamed up with the [url=https://www.petersen.org/]Petersen Automotive Museum[/url] for a special Rivals event in Forza Motorsport 7 as they celebrated BMW’s 50th anniversary of the M series car. Players would set their fastest lap times on Laguna Seca in the 1975 BMW #25 BMW Motorsport 3.0 CSL to unlock two unique red and blue liveries for the car, inspired by the exterior design of the Petersen Museum.

[h2]June[/h2]

Undoubtedly the biggest month of the year for Forza fans, we were at the Xbox & Bethesda Games Showcase to reveal Forza Horizon 5: Hot Wheels, which released on July 19, as well as the first ever gameplay of Forza Motorsport.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/08209baf83c44ccbc8c0c0b6a24b287b1000c2c3.jpg[/img]

In the first expansion for Forza Horizon 5, [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-hot-wheels]players would venture to the visually stunning, exhilarating new Hot Wheels Park[/url] in the clouds high above Mexico with over 200 km of twisting, looping iconic orange track! Across four new biomes packed with spectacular detail and diversity, drivers were challenged with unique track types such as gravity defying magnet tracks as well as ice, water flume, and rumble tracks. EventLab also expanded with 80 new snappable track and stunt pieces, which allows expansion owners to build their dream Hot Wheels tracks anywhere in Mexico or on Hot Wheels Park. Meanwhile, the cars… we’ll let the Bad to the Blade, the Deora II, the 2021 Hennessey Venom F5 and the 2019 Brabham BT62 all speak for themselves.

To prepare for the expansion, the Festival Playlist brought [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-series-9]four weeks of Hot Wheels themed events and rewards[/url], including returning Hot Wheels cars from previous Forza games, as well as Hot Wheels cosmetics and horns. This update saw the final Car Pass vehicles released, including the 2021 Aston Martin DBX, the 2020 Lexus RC F Track Edition and the 2019 Nissan 370z Nismo. It also introduced temporal anti-aliasing (TAA) for PC players, coop play for Horizon Stories, a duplicate car filter and expanded VO and subtitle support for additional languages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/fb0a8275e7afb96f99c134e8be5fc31f0736cdad.jpg[/img]

[url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-the-most-technically-advanced-racing-game-ever-made]In the first ever gameplay reveal of Forza Motorsport[/url], we showcased how the fan-favorite track Maple Valley is being brought to life in stunning detail and beauty. We also revealed that Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps and Laguna Seca would return, alongside Kyalami, our first ever South African track, as well as Hakone, an original, high-speed Grand Prix circuit set in Japan. Fully dynamic time of day and weather is available on every track, while our environments have been captured using photogrammetry and 3D material scans using advanced rendering features to fully immerse you in our Motorsport world.

Based on your feedback, Forza Motorsport introduces new features like tire and fuel management, multiple tire compounds and new in-depth car building. With a 48 times improvement in the fidelity of our physics simulation, advanced car damage reproduced down to the individual scratches on the bodywork, and real-time ray tracing on-track that makes everything feel more connected, natural and real, Forza Motorsport is a generational leap in immersion built from the ground up to showcase the Xbox Series X|S consoles.

[previewyoutube=5qZRgVD_niU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

A few days later, we were joined by Forza Motorsport Creative Director Chris Esaki on Forza Monthly to discuss everything you saw in our trailer and gameplay video. [url=https://youtu.be/mfcmJor6tXY?t=440]If you missed it, be sure to check out the interview[/url].

To celebrate Pride 2022 alongside Xbox, in June we gifted all players an exclusive Forza rainbow livery adorning the 2009 Pagani Zonda Cinque Roadster in Forza Horizon 5 and Forza Horizon 4, as well as Forza Motorsport 7.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/113cb7e1e26b6185aa23404622d444767e16d7ad.jpg[/img]

Lastly, we retired ForzaMotorsport.net and [url=https://forza.net/news/welcome]launched the new Forza.net[/url] to celebrate our players and combine cars, community, and creativity in a sleek, modernized website. It’s very likely that you’re reading this blog on it!

[h2]July[/h2]

In July, [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-hot-wheels-now-available]we launched the Forza Horizon 5: Hot Wheels expansion[/url] and announced a partnership with Extreme E inviting players to get behind the wheel of the fully-electric Extreme E ODYSSEY 21 e-SUV and experience [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-series-10]four weeks of off-road racing action on the Festival Playlist[/url]. We also introduced the Hot Wheels signature redline tire compound and 12 new Hot Wheels Spectraflame colors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/88a5c32f7c234f4d707dffe35f64e2ac94659a2b.png[/img]

[h2]August[/h2]

Forza Horizon 5 players were invited to [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-ramis-racing-history]tour Mexico’s rich heritage of automotive manufacture and racing history in Rami’s Racing History[/url]. It featured an eight-chapter Horizon Story called Made in Mexico which explored the major eras of manufacturing and car culture in the country. This update introduced display integration support for the Thrustmaster T248X and a Festival Playlist highlighting four unique eras of cars with special Classic Wednesday Sales on the Forzathon Shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/97c6ace76ebfa5855d1e915c380a54c0b4e8ecb0.jpg[/img]

New cars included the second generation 2021 BMW M4 Competition Coupe and the futuristic 2020 Xpeng P7 sedan. The Autoshow also received its most expensive car, the 1955 Mercedes-Benz 300 SLR priced at 140 million credits in honor of the real-world auction that saw it become the most valuable car in the world!

[h2]September[/h2]

The Horizon Road Trip introduced the first of several new body kit pre-sets for Forza Horizon 5, like the ADRO USA widebody for the 2019 Hyundai Veloster N and the APR Performance Inc. widebody for the 2010 Volkswagen Golf R. For character customization, we added a new category called Amplification with a selection of hearing aids in various colors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/5ed47d3dfa7769b4fc752c6044f0f1678c1366fc.jpg[/img]

The Festival Playlist for this series was [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-horizon-road-trip]inspired by the variety of racing activities available throughout Mexico’s vast landscape[/url] with some championships featuring additional races and Goliath-type routes. This update also introduced three new to Forza cars, including the futuristic all-wheel-drive 2021 Audi RS e-tron GT, the aesthetically wild 2021 Audi RS 7 Sportback and the 2021 Lynk & Co 03+ sports saloon.

Later in September, [url=https://forza.net/news/get-ready-horizon-10-year-anniversary]we announced at the Tokyo Game Show[/url] that Forza Horizon 5 would celebrate the 10-Year Anniversary of Forza Horizon with a special update featuring a new story, as well as returning cars, music and more.

[previewyoutube=onFtzs2mmI8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Meanwhile, on Forza Monthly, we were joined by GM of Motorsport, Dan Greenawalt and Creative Director Chris Esaki for an insightful discussion into the development and production cycles of Forza Motorsport. We also said we’d be sharing more about the game next year leading up to its release in Spring 2023. [url=https://youtu.be/D82BR774SVg?t=1395]Be sure to check it out if you missed it[/url].

[h2]October[/h2]

The Horizon 10-Year Anniversary arrived with [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-celebrates-horizon-10-year-anniversary]four weeks of events reliving the series’ most iconic gameplay moments[/url]. Completing all five chapters of the Horizon Origins Story unlocked the 2013 Dodge SRT Viper GTS Anniversary Edition paying homage to the original Forza Horizon cover car. Across 16 Street Races, four head-to-head Midnight Battles emerged with each allowing you to score the competitor’s car. Meanwhile, a new Horizon Classics Prop Pack expanded EventLab with 97 recognizable props and structures from previous Forza Horizon games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2828f0e830bc570c2355e23dba74ea63525c1657.png[/img]

The Horizon Mixtape brought a flash of throwback music to your radio dial, with additional songs unlocked on the Festival Playlist. In addition to 22 ADV.1 rims, iconic Forza Horizon cars returned, including the 2010 Ferrari 599XX, the 2011 Koenigsegg Agera, the 2012 Eagle Speedster and the 2010 Aston Martin One-77. With each week themed around Forza Horizon 1-4 and temporary Festival outposts setup around Mexico, there was plenty of nostalgia-fueled driving on tap!

To coincide with the Horizon Festival’s 10-Year Anniversary, we hosted four Rivals events in Forza Motorsport 7 that put your driving skills to the test in special car and track combos that not only celebrated past Forza Horizon games, but also corresponded to the game in the Festival Playlist spotlight in Forza Horizon 5! In addition to exclusive Forza Horizon branded Driver Gear, those who set a lap time in all four events unlocked the highly coveted 1958 MG MGA Twin-Cam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e22e6f03a0ea827e1c92ba9e262a96327cbd2247.png[/img]

We also posted a special anniversary blog looking back on the past decade of the Forza Horizon series, reflecting on its growth and evolution over the past ten years. [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-celebrating-a-decade-of-festivals]Check it out for a deep dive tour into the history of Forza Horizon[/url]!

Additionally in October, we launched the Suggestions Hub on the Forza Forums, the next step on our journey in listening to player feedback. This is a central location for you to share your constructive input and ideas with the teams at Turn 10 and Playground Games. We also have car and track voting, and you can even upvote feature suggestions posted by other players. [url=https://forza.net/news/introducing-suggestions-hub]Here’s a link with all the details to help you get started[/url].

[h2]November[/h2]

[url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-donut-media]Donut Media was on the menu for November’s Forza Horizon 5 update[/url] as James and Nolan flew into Horizon Mexico with a brand-new tire-burning Horizon Story. PC players received access to several new options, including NVIDIA DLSS Super Resolution, NVIDIA DLAA and AMD FSR 2.2, as well as enhanced DirectX Raytracing pre-sets with car self-reflections in Free Roam and Photo Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a01098050b6c5e0e11a6170574b9268761afd597.jpg[/img]

This update also included 21 Rocket Bunny kits, a Festival Playlist full of Donut Media goodness and the new-to-franchise 2020 Lynk & Co #100 Cyan Racing 03. Remember that this update was only the beginning of our collaboration with Donut Media with more tasty treats to come in 2023!

[h2]December[/h2]

To mark the end of the first year of the Horizon Festival, Playground Games shared this infographic to highlight all the updates to Forza Horizon 5 over this past year. With 137 cars, over 270 EventLab props and 23 body kits, on top of the constant flow of new events and challenges on the Festival Playlist, 2022 has undoubtedly been a packed year of driving adventures for Forza players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/f89735e6a0a145f42feccd995ff5a68d455facf2.png[/img]

[url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-holidays]Today, we’re celebrating the Horizon Holidays in Mexico[/url] with the return of car gifting through Secret Santa – and thanks to the generosity of our Forza Horizon 5 community, everyone has already unlocked two incredible rewards: the dazzling Holiday Tree Outfit and the open-top hybrid 2020 Lamborghini Sián Roadster. Redeem yours today from the “Gifts” tab of the Message Center if you haven’t already, where you’ll also find the 2022 CUPRA UrbanRebel Concept through January 5, 2023.

Once you’ve collected all your holiday treats, spread the seasonal joy by visiting the Horizon Wonderland in Mulegé, where you can find limited time holiday sales in the Forzathon Shop, and don’t forget to bring your Convoy to the Ice Rink Stadium for some sliding shenanigans. You’ll also find festive decorations aplenty, from the towns and city of Guanajuato to even your own home!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2c892910f9d8247825d0a98dbc80c12200d61aac.png[/img]

Over in Forza Motorsport 7, the Triple Crown Rivals event is live through January 3, 2023! You’re invited to race the Turn 10 Community Team across three events voted for by players including Open-Wheel, Prototype and GT Cars, and score incredible rewards along the way. 

The events include the 1988 McLaren #12 Honda McLaren MP4 at Suzuka with the Olympia Driver Gear reward, the 1991 Mazda #18 787B at Road Atlanta featuring the JD Driver Gear, and the 2009 BMW #92 Rahal Letterman Racing M3 GT2 at Hockenheimring where you’ll receive the Kait Driver Gear. Those who set a time in all three events will also receive the 2010 Maserati Gran Turismo S Forza Edition and the Master Chief Driver Gear. [url=https://forza.net/events/ForzaTripleCrownTakeontheForzaTeam/]Check out the event where you can find the list of participating Turn 10 Gamertags[/url]. You might even find T10 Tio Forza on the leaderboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/4ee7597ff29ba9a23dcac8542994fbead2b6f6ca.jpg[/img]

That wraps up this edition of the Forza Year in Review! Thanks to our incredible community for their continued support, their constructive feedback and input, as well as their creative spirits. We’re grateful to have you all on every road-trip, and we hope you join us in 2023 as we gear up for the launch of the all-new Forza Motorsport and the debut of Forza Horizon 5’s second expansion. Until then, we wish everyone a happy and safe holiday, and a wonderful New Year.

notes.title: Build Your Custom Stadium EventLab in Forza Horizon 5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/80fbed686c9c113588b8910c49f1b626f24c869a.jpg[/img]

EventLab creators, we’ve added a new EventLab build stub to the[b] Horizon Stadium[/b]. This feature allows you to create Blueprints [b]using the arena itself as a spawn point[/b], so you no longer need to find the closest route. Simply drive towards the Horizon Stadium and look out for the build stub to get started. 

Once your EventLab is published, share your creations with us and don’t forget to include the Share Code! You can [url=https://twitter.com/ForzaHorizon]tag us @ForzaHorizon on Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ForzaHorizon/]Facebook channels[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/forzahorizonofficial/]@ForzaHorizonOfficial on Instagram[/url], and you can also [url=https://aka.ms/ForzaForums]post your event on the Forza Forums[/url] and the [url=https://discord.gg/forza]official Forza Discord server[/url]. 

[h3]We can’t wait to see what you create![/h3]

tags.feature: EventLab creators, we’ve added a new EventLab build stub to the Horizon Stadium.

notes.title: Celebrate the Festive Season in Forza Horizon 5
notes.content:
The Horizon Holidays are coming to Mexico as Forza Horizon 5 celebrates the festive season with the new Festival Playlist series beginning on Thursday, December 8.

Look out for new reward cars, the return of Secret Santa improved for this year, and Evolving World changes such as the Horizon Wonderland in Mulegé and the Ice Rink Stadium featuring a hockey-rink in the middle of the arena.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/f971237718f689764a922b40fed7d969893eb84a.png[/img]

It’s undoubtedly been an exciting first year at Horizon Mexico! Check out the above infographic for the complete visual summary of everything we’ve added to Forza Horizon 5 from launch through to the Donut Media update.

[h2]Game Fixes and Release Notes[/h2]

Available to download beforehand on Tuesday, December 6 is the next Forza Horizon 5 update with fixes to community reported issues. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/28c3ffea915eb3cca59c728d732ed6d3a84246dc.jpg[/img]

Here’s some of the most notable changes that you can expect:
[list]
[*]We have introduced support for Japanese and Traditional Chinese VO. You can switch to any of the available VO pre-sets under “Language Select” in the Settings menu. 
[*]An EventLab build point has been added to the Horizon Stadium.
[*]Accolades tasking players to use Vinyls would previously not be unlocked as usage would not increment your progress. This has now been fixed.
[*]The Tuning Setup and Livery applied to a car before the creation of a Super7 event will now be reflected in the published Challenge Card as intended.
[*]Any tuning adjustments made to your selected car in Donut Media Chapter 2 now persists onto later chapters.
[*]Previously the stat tracking for areas discovered would increase beyond the total number of findable areas in the game. This has been fixed.
[*]We’ve fixed the issue which caused liveries to be misaligned when a widebody kit is applied to the 1992 Honda NSX-R.
[*]Players can now paint the roof of the 2010 Forsberg Racing Toyota Gumout 2JZ Camry Stock Car.[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/26f374d2562657cea663881e743fe0cd0fff5dfb.jpg[/img]

As always, the full list of fixes and improvements will be [url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/sections/4408834302355-Release-Notes-and-Known-Issues]published in our release notes[/url] once the update is available to download. Our team is closely monitoring your Forza Horizon 5 feedback as new fixes are developed and introduced in each series update. [url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409616884883-FH5-Known-Issues]Here’s where you can stay up to date on the issues that we’re currently investigating[/url].

[h3]Secret Santa[/h3]

Secret Santa returns to Forza Horizon 5! We’ve tweaked and adjusted how it works based on your feedback from last year, so you’ll find it easier to unlock that snazzy top-tier car and who knows, if you give enough gifts then the holiday season may well start before you expect it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/79dc13625665bed54bc56468660fe82d3421c361.jpg[/img]

Available until January 5, 2023, Secret Santa is a special Horizon Holidays event that challenges the entire community to cooperate and share the festive joy by sending gifts to each other. Gifts can be sent through the Forzathon Shop and using the Gift Drop feature.

While only one car from the Forzathon Shop can be gifted per week, you can gift as many cars as desired through Gift Drops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/320184aec5dc938554ba4e64cdebd00f4db4a598.jpg[/img]

Every gift sent contributes to the progression bar which includes two unmissable rewards, so don’t miss out! Once the community reaches the points threshold, the reward will be immediately sent out and can be redeemed through the in-game Message Center.

[h3]Horizon Wonderland[/h3]

Visit the Horizon Wonderland in Mulegé, a holiday-themed marketplace where you can access the Forzathon Shop and enjoy the festive makeover. Be sure to look out for a large gift box by the church, as that means you have a present to collect. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2c57d02ce15457540bd985dc25d846470960181a.jpg[/img]

You’ll also find holiday decorations across Mexico including Christmas trees, lights and candy canes, as well as Snowman collectibles, which are now more plentiful compared to last year. We’ve even hidden some at Player Houses. Find them to complete the weekly Photo Challenges.

Don’t forget to visit the Ice Rink Stadium! The Horizon Stadium is fully transformed for the holidays with an icy playground to slide around with your friends, a hockey puck, and festive decorations.

[h3]Forzathon Shop Sales[/h3]

Did someone say Tommy Bargains? Cor Blimey, it’s another round of unmissable deals that you won’t find anywhere else. The Forzathon Shop will be your one-stop-destination to a selection to significantly discounted high-performance cars and seasonal cosmetics. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/de0761dcdf1eb5c2084483022c61fdda40727dfa.jpg[/img]

Here’s when you can look out for those sales:
[list]
[*][b]Christmas Day Sale:[/b] From 2:30 PM UTC on Dec. 24 until 2:30 PM UTC on Dec. 26.
[*][b]New Year’s Sale:[/b] From 2:30 PM UTC on Dec. 31 until 2:30 PM UTC on Jan 2.[/list]Remember that you can gift one car to a friend or another player during each week of Horizon Holidays through the Forzathon Shop, so make the most of these sales and boost that community gifts bar!

[h3]Festival Playlist[/h3]

Get ready for a holiday-themed Festival Playlist with special events to mark the season. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d50c9fa45f5d403d15a8515e815e070b6bde1e2f.jpg[/img]

For those who missed them last year, we’re bringing back these festive themed clothing items and car horns throughout the Horizon Holidays:

[b]Clothing Items[/b]
[list]
[*]Snowman Outfit
[*]Sad Snowperson Head
[*]Happy Snowperson Head
[*]Gingerbread Outfit
[*]Santa Outfit
[*]Elf Outfit
[*]Elf Hat
[*]Holiday Sweater
[*]Santa Hat
[*]Red Nose
[*]Reindeer Antlers[/list]
[b]Car Horns[/b]
[list]
[*]Jingle Bells
[*]Sleigh Bells
[*]Merry Christmas
[*]HoHoHo
[*]Deck the Halls[/list]You’ll also find another opportunity to unlock the song “Language” by Porter Robinson for your Horizon Mixtape radio dial. There will be opportunities to unlock the other previously released 10-Year Anniversary songs in the future, stay tuned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/75476c089dd396f9cc7361454dff854e8af24737.jpg[/img]

Here’s a look at the new and returning cars available to unlock throughout the Horizon Holidays:

[b]2020 Lamborghini Sián Roadster[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/149b90b82d76c802c27f0189d63d2f15e1d4c821.jpg[/img]
[i]The unlock requirements of this car remain a mystery. Some say the holidays are a season of gifts and joy, though we’re unsure of how such wisdom is supposed to help you drive this incredible supercar.[/i]

The 2020 Lamborghini Sián Roadster is the Italian manufacturer's first open-top hybrid supercar to feature a supercapacitor. With electrified intensity, the incomparable 800-horsepower V12 that powers the Sián Roadster is at the top of its class. It’s the most powerful Lamborghini engine yet, capable of 217mph, while its unique and innovative use of a supercapacitor takes hybrid technology to the next level. It also has futuristic design features, such sculptured contours, distinct aero wings and aluminum details painted in Oro Electrum, a special type of gold paint chosen by Lamborghini to indicate their hybrid cars. It all comes together for an incredible all-wheel-drive supercar built with meticulous attention to detail, very fine materials and an ultralight body. It even has unique interior accents celebrating the very first Lamborghini Miura. While only 19 models are planned for the real world, the Horizon Festival has ensured that everyone who feels the holiday spirit over the coming series might just find the 2020 Lamborghini Sián Roadster under their garage’s festive tree in Forza Horizon 5.

[b]2022 CUPRA UrbanRebel Racing Concept[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/257c14cffd8ac6a24980aa1585ef4e511a526739.jpg[/img]
[i]This car will be distributed for free to everyone who plays Forza Horizon 5 during the Horizon Holidays series. It can be redeemed in the Message Center through Jan. 5, 2023. Also available to purchase from the Autoshow for 2 million credits.[/i]

Step behind the wheel of an all-electric racecar with a truly rebellious spirit. It’s coming to the real world in 2025 as a road-going car, however you can experience the CUPRA UrbanRebel Racing Concept first before anyone else in Forza Horizon 5. Designed, developed and built in Barcelona, Spain, this racecar mixes electrification, sustainability and performance integrating virtual aesthetics to create a design language for the future generation of electric vehicles. CUPRA said they wanted to inject a gamification look to the racing car, and they certainly achieved it, with a livery surface that adapts and changes as the light moves across it, as well as a large spoiler with integrated lights that nods to the racecars of the virtual world. So, it looks incredibly unique, but how does the UrbanRebel Racing Concept perform? It delivers 335 bhp of continuous performance with a peak of 429 bhp! It can also reach 0-62mph in only 3.2 seconds. Sounds like a perfect match for the Horizon Festival, where you can drive this unconventional concept car early and set your fastest lap time in Forza EV, as well as put it to the test in dedicated Seasonal PR Stunts. 

[b]1971 AMC Javelin AMX  [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/5330fa1c160787b7e1cf6c6459dc322daa4a9c25.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during the Summer “Wet” Season on the Horizon Holidays Festival Playlist. Available from Dec. 8 – Dec. 15.[/i]

Those huge fender arches? They’re to fit oversize race tires. The long deck? That’s for the 401 CID, Trans-Am-inspired V8 packing a four-barrel carburetor capable of 330 horsepower. From the crease running down the flanks to the quad taillights hooded by a ducktail spoiler, the AMC Javelin AMX was one of the more audacious pony cars to drive for dominance on the drag strip and the race circuit at the height of the muscle car era. Despite odds stacked up against the small, independent automaker in the face of the Big Three, the Javelin and its AMX derivative smoked them in Trans-Am racing, taking the checkered flag in eight of the ten races of the 1971 season, with Mark “Captain Nice” Donahue behind the wheel of many of them. The Javelin AMX distilled the racing success into one of the most exciting, and certainly one of the most distinctive, muscle cars to rumble out onto the scene. Whether you line up for a quarter-mile or swap paint with its Trans-Am rivals out on the track, the coupe from Kenosha is a potent competitor.

[b]1958 Plymouth Fury[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8dbc1281e0115a5de47efd4b8dcff2686ef73d85.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during the Autumn “Storm” Season on the Horizon Holidays Festival Playlist. Available from Dec. 15 – Dec. 22.[/i]

Only a car with the beautiful lines of the 1958 Plymouth Fury could have inspired the kind of obsession expressed in Stephen King’s “Christine.” While this Fury may not be possessed, this much chrome, this much tailfin, and a 305hp Golden Commando V8 under the hood are worthy of close appreciation. Sure, this Fury is a huge hunk of glistening metal that is best driven in a straight line, and it may lack braking and turning performance, but who cares? The Fury is gorgeous, and it represents an era where cars were designed to be alluring and gas prices were not an issue. Besides, once you feel the float of this boat going down the straightaway, winning may become less of a priority.

[b]2013 Cadillac XTS Limousine[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0f80285ced0cc6709c32d148ad77cde21543fffa.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during the Winter “Dry” Season on the Horizon Holidays Festival Playlist. Available from Dec. 22 – Dec. 29.[/i]

One advantage this Cadillac XTS Limousine has is its length. You are not going to just fly by this vehicle. It’s long. When toting around VIPs, you need a limousine and that’s where this rig comes in. Plunk down in its luxurious interior and watch a movie as the driver puts in a few laps or use it as a canvas for an elongated livery. With 300 horsepower in the stock version – and don’t forget you can upgrade this thing with a NASCAR engine – it’s no slouch. If you want to practice your cornering skills, the Limo will give you a new perspective on watching out behind you. Simply put, this is one hulking and fancy piece of machinery that’s certain to get you across Mexico in style and raise a fair share of eyebrows along the way. All the more reason to have it in your Forza Horizon 5 garage we say.

[b]1970 AMC Rebel 'The Machine'[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ed82bf7346a2ddf0db6e1460ef5c2818a4de79af.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during the Spring “Hot” Season on the Horizon Holidays Festival Playlist. Available from Dec. 29 – Jan. 5.[/i]

AMC was notorious for taking on the big three in its own way. When it came to the muscle car market, the AMC approach was unique with performance that could give the big boys a run for their money. “The Machine” came with a flamboyant red, white, and blue paint scheme that made as much of statement as its 340-horsepower V8. From the factory this Rebel was poised as a street legal drag race car and could run mid-14s in the quarter mile. The distinctive ram-air hood scoop and hood-mounted tachometer contributed to the car’s performance-minded attitude. “The Machine” was no poseur; developed in collaboration with Hurst Performance, it could put down the power via the “Twin-Grip” Positraction style differential. AMC always did things delightfully different, and this definitive muscle car is a perfect example.

[h3]What’s Next[/h3]

The Horizon Holidays will seamlessly lead into the next series, #FORDzathon with no new update to download. This means that you will see unreleased content from the next series before it’s officially available to unlock in-game. This can happen from time to time when we combine update files to allow us to stay ahead of schedule with bringing you future series updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/5c69ba2c4e306edf0cf1ce5afeeb45034a56d6b0.jpg[/img]

#FORDzathon will introduce a Festival Playlist themed around Ford events and rewards, as well as two new to Forza MG cars and three Renault cars returning to Forza:
[list]
[*]2020 MG #20 MG6 XPower 
[*]2021 MG MG6 XPower 
[*]2010 Renault Clio R.S. 
[*]2016 Renault Clio R.S. 16 Concept 
[*]2010 Renault Megane RS 250 [/list]We’ll share more details about these cars, including the unlock criteria, in our #FORDzathon blog on January 5, 2023. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7f8564f7fca5f0021d00dac3952493b7ac09b402.jpg[/img]

Thanks to all our players for another fantastic year at the Horizon Festival. From the extreme tracks of Forza Horizon 5: Hot Wheels to a celebration of our Horizon 10-Year Anniversary, these past twelve months have been unforgettable, and we’ll be recapping it all in our 2022 Forza Year in Review later this month.

notes.title: Spin Your Tires as Donut Media Arrives in Forza Horizon 5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a01098050b6c5e0e11a6170574b9268761afd597.jpg[/img]

It’s Donut time! The Horizon Cargo Plane has flown James and Nolan, as well as an entire new Donut Media Test Track, into Horizon Mexico. Pull off burnouts and create lots of tire smoke in a delicious new Horizon Story available to play from Thursday, November 10.

Ahead of the new Festival Playlist series and the arrival of the Donut Media crew, the next Forza Horizon 5 update will be available to download from Tuesday, November 8 across Xbox, Windows and Steam. Once it’s released, upgrade your favorite cars with the return of Rocket Bunny widebody kits, and if you’re playing on PC, test drive new resolution scaling and ray tracing options to increase performance and car reflection quality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e503342be01bed010195694ec77044909a0b3e45.jpg[/img]

It's another busy month at the Horizon Festival with plenty to unpack, so let’s dive in!

[h2]Game Fixes and Release Notes[/h2]

We continue to introduce new game fixes and quality-of-life improvements in Forza Horizon 5 as part of its monthly series updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/f075252309fcd76f7a7af90b8eb9efa3e55f6ae0.jpg[/img]

Here’s a look at the most notable changes that you can look forward to in the next version:
[list]
[*]New resolution scaling options for NVIDIA DLSS Super Resolution, NVIDIA DLAA and AMD FSR 2.2, as well as enhanced DirectX Raytracing pre-sets for PC players have been added. We have more details on these features and how they work below.
[*]Cars are now sorted Alphabetically in the “Car Type” section when players are browsing their Garage in the “My Cars” interface.
[*]We’ve fixed an issue that caused the chosen Steering Wheel Input Mapping layout to revert to its default settings after restarting the title on PC.
[*]Further improvements have been made to alleviate incorrect percentages being displayed on the Props Budget UI in the EventLab Blueprint Builder.
[*]Horizon Origins will no longer prompt players to set a route when starting the game or travelling from Hot Wheels Park to Mexico.
[*]The hat in the Tankito Doritos Outfit now correctly displays the Doritos brand logo on top.
[*]We’ve made improvements to localized VOs in Horizon Stories.[/list]We continually evaluate our tools and processes, and have introduced new security improvements to the PC version of Forza Horizon 5 to promote a healthy and secure gameplay experience for our community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2d4fcb8f300bae5a1c104a53e8b48743a1eafe9c.jpg[/img]

For the full list of fixes and improvements, [url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/sections/4408834302355-Release-Notes-and-Known-Issues]look out for our release notes[/url] that will be published once the update is available to download. We’re listening closely to your Forza Horizon 5 feedback as new fixes are introduced in each series update. [url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409616884883-FH5-Known-Issues]Here’s where you can stay up to date on the issues that we’re currently investigating[/url].

[h2]PC Improvements – DLSS, FSR and DXR[/h2]

Boost your Forza Horizon 5 framerates on PC whilst maximising image quality by enabling NVIDIA DLSS Super Resolution or AMD FSR 2.2. These resolution upscaling techniques can construct a 4K rendered image from a 1080p frame buffer, allowing higher performance at higher resolutions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/22ef419edfcca7346816d8896a5ecbef68e5adc5.jpg[/img]

NVIDIA DLSS Super Resolution is available on all NVIDIA RTX graphics cards, while AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 2.2 can be used on all PC graphics cards including AMD, NVIDIA and Intel.

We’ve also incorporated NVIDIA DLAA, which uses AI-powered technology to anti-alias a native resolution image at high quality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/06b3faf8f9bc077852c592785353e92ba724b77f.jpg[/img]

In addition, we’re enhancing our DirectX Raytracing implementation on PC with two new presets: Ultra and Extreme, which render true-to-life reflections for the player car in Free Roam and Races, as well as realistic Drivatar reflections in Photo Mode. Ray tracing is also available in Forzavista as before.

For additional information on these new PC features, [url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/10944080013843]check out this Forza Support Q&A[/url].

[h2]New Horizon Story – Donut Media @ Horizon[/h2]

On Thursday, November 10, experience a new Horizon Series Intro in the inaugural chapter of Donut Media @ Horizon. Meet James and Nolan, who are on standby to provide radio comms as you take on a series of challenges that test your car building and driving skills on the Donut Media Test Track, built exclusively for this Horizon Story. Here you can upgrade and test drive cars with the goal of transforming a Classic Muscle or Retro Sports Car into a Rally Machine!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/f32eb32ba35512d22c578545652a28e0cac3d07e.jpg[/img]

These are the three rides available to choose from on the Donut Media Test Track:
[list]
[*]1993 Ford SVT Cobra R
[*]1993 Nissan 240 SX SE
[*]1977 Pontiac Firebird Trans AM[/list]It’s important that you’ve built the right car for the challenges ahead, as once you’ve committed to it, you’ll need to prove that you made the correct car and upgrade choices as you push it to the limit across a series of objectives.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/f48c5d627390fe925f35bf50a100b4539b611b0e.jpg[/img]

Players can later revisit this Horizon Story and attempt to complete it using different car builds. By replaying Chapter 2 – The Test Track, your Story Progression across the next three chapters will be reset, allowing you to experience them using your newly upgraded car.

[h2]Rocket Bunny Widebody Kits[/h2]

Mechanics at the Horizon Festival are excited to offer 21 Rocket Bunny kits available to drivers at the Autoshow. If you’re looking to express yourself around Mexico’s Street Scene, there’s no better way to do so. Rocket Bunny widebody kits can be fitted on these rides:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/04176022b55ed38ce60e41d2cdbee943e50df094.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]1997 BMW M3
[*]2005 BMW M3
[*]1992 Honda NSX-R
[*]2003 Honda S2000
[*]2015 Lexus RC F
[*]1994 Mazda MX-5 Miata
[*]1997 Mazda RX-7 (features 2 Rocket Bunny widebody kits)
[*]1993 Nissan 240SX SE
[*]1969 Nissan Fairlady Z 432
[*]2003 Nissan Fairlady Z
[*]1992 Nissan Silvia CLUB K's
[*]1994 Nissan Silvia K's
[*]1998 Nissan Silvia K's Aero
[*]2000 Nissan Silvia Spec-R
[*]1993 Nissan Skyline GT-R V-Spec
[*]2015 Porsche Cayman GTS
[*]2013 Subaru BRZ
[*]2013 Toyota 86
[*]1992 Volkswagen Golf GTI 16v Mk2
[*]2014 Volkswagen Golf R[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2e29773139222f7e9ba4b81d85eebf2ae45c2fe0.jpg[/img]

Simply drive any of cars listed above to a Festival Outpost or Player House and navigate to the “Tuning & Upgrades” menu and select “Body Kits & Presets” to find the Rocket Bunny widebody kits.

[h2]Donut Media Festival Playlist[/h2]

Every week this series, Donut Media is serving up appropriately themed Seasonal Championships and Weekly Forzathon Challenges that are certain to be tasty. Look out for Pop Up Headlight races, Money Pip Miata races, HiLow Fairlady races, Up to Speed challenges and more!

James and Nolan are also in the radio booth to update you on the latest Festival Playlist events as they become available, ensuring you don’t miss out on the fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/f27cfd870aec0e2e2a82c831a38cb556978f196b.jpg[/img]

In addition to car rewards, Donut Media themed clothing and Forza LINK chat phrases can be unlocked, while smashable donuts can be collected alongside Mexico’s high-speed motorway.

[b]Clothing Items[/b]
[list]
[*]Donut Media Leaf Cap
[*]Donut Media Grey Hoodie
[*]Donut Media Black Jumper
[*]Donut Media HRSPRS Relaxed Tee
[*]Donut Media Black Cap
[*]Donut Media Modern Race Helmet
[*]Donut Media Black Bomber Jacket
[*]Donut Media Yellow Relaxed Tee[/list][b]Forza LINK[/b]
[list]
[*]“MO POWA BABY”
[*]“POP UP, UP & DOWN, HEADLIGHTS”[/list]Here’s a look at the new and returning cars available to unlock in the Donut Media Festival Playlist:

[b]2020 Lynk & Co #100 Cyan Racing 03[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/c5d06f07ea283ea4f3c6a22a6e88bd518444cfd4.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during the Summer “Wet” Season on the Donut Media Festival Playlist. Available from Nov. 10 – Nov. 17.[/i]

Built for the racetrack, now primed for the open road. Developed by Geely Group Motorsport in close collaboration with Cyan Racing and its drivers, the 2020 Lynk & Co #62 Cyan Racing 03 is a three-time touring car champion that has secured the teams’ title in 2019, 2020 and 2021. Driver Yvan Muller stood on the podium with a third-place finish in the Lynk & Co 03 in 2019, while in 2020 Yann Ehrlacher would take home the drivers’ title and become the first ever driver to defend it in 2021. It’s an incredible accomplishment for both Cyan Racing and Lynk & Co 03, who would later release a street-tuned Cyan version of the car to celebrate its motorsport victories. Powered by a four-cylinder, 350-horsepower two-liter turbocharged engine with direct injection that adheres to racing regulations, as well as all the trimmings of a FIA safety approved car, the Lynk & Co 03 is ready to whirl you through the vibrant and impeccable landscapes of Mexico.

[b]1965 Morris Mini-Traveller[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/149ff316cb0de1ae491b11090b554ecef1916ef0.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during the Autumn “Storm” Season on the Donut Media Festival Playlist. Available from Nov. 17 – Nov. 24.[/i]

One of the most beloved and fondly remembered British automobiles is undoubtedly the 1965 Morris Mini-Traveller. If the wood paneling hasn’t caught your attention yet, then the number of spare tires you could fit in the boot certainly will. Space isn’t an issue for this iconic estate vehicle, no matter if you’re driving with friends, family or colleagues, or you’re simply moving house. The Mini-Traveller is always a fun drive around Mexico’s quaint farmland roads – especially after the Horizon Festival’s local mechanic has swapped out the engine – though if you’re keeping it stock, you’re still in for a memorable time. Thirty-four brake horses under the hood and a 0.8L naturally aspirated I4 engine might not sound like much on paper, though with Horizon’s best drivers behind the wheel, we’re certain this front-wheel-drive cult classic will prove its legacy once more.

[b]1946 Ford Super Deluxe Station Wagon[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0b6d50c8065ed41399faf88d9a95faf3d02028a6.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during the Winter “Dry” Season on the Donut Media Festival Playlist. Available from Nov. 24 – Dec. 1.[/i]

There is a certain nostalgia about a wood-bodied vehicle or “woody.” The Ford Super Deluxe Station Wagon is a perfect post-World War II example of the halo vehicles of the time – a time when you didn’t wax your car, you went out and put on a new coat of varnish on it. It’s a work of art and since it’s a station wagon, this woody was a truckster that served families loyally with all of its 90 horsepower and ample storage space. Whether you find yourself travelling the highways and byways in search of the most picturesque spot to photograph this classic or just enjoying the ride along the way, you will find that this is one special wagon.

[b]1953 Morris Minor Series II Traveler[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/9ae5eefa2f9a7c861316f46d6fa0d72c0a28bdd0.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during the Spring “Hot” Season on the Donut Media Festival Playlist. Available from Nov. Dec. 1 – Dec. 8.[/i]

It’s not how fast you get there, it’s how much fun you are having along the way. That’s how one must look at the ride from behind the wheel of this Morris Minor Estate. Somewhat reminiscent of a chopped, channeled, narrowed, and shortened Ford Woody of the same era, the Series II Traveler featured a tiny four-banger. No doubt, you will find the Traveler to be an outstanding piece of machinery, so long as getting anywhere fast isn’t one of your needs. Tiny and efficient, made of wood, and with all of around 30 horsepower, it will quickly find a place in your heart, or maybe even a route between that thick patch of trees that nothing else could conquer.

[h2]What’s Next[/h2]

And... cut! That’s a wrap on this first season of Donut Media @ Horizon, however next week's update is only just the beginning of our collaboration with Donut Media. Keep your eyes and ears open in 2023 for even more Donut Media goodness coming to Forza Horizon 5.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d3f5f6e00043e017b36270aa44b2e540e5e4ddb7.jpg[/img]

The driving festivities aren’t slowing down in Mexico anytime soon. The holidays are coming, and Forza Horizon 5 will be celebrating with the return of festive decorations, the ice rink, and new cars to unlock. Check back for more details in December.

notes.title: Forza Horizon 5 Festival Playlist – Horizon 10-Year Anniversary: Week 1, Summer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d73aa2cfba2306481654ad88071ac4624da3539a.jpg[/img]

Welcome to the Horizon 10-Year Anniversary as we celebrate this past decade of fast cars, iconic music, and incredible road-trips all at the world’s greatest automotive festival. Whether you first joined us in Colorado, Southern Europe, Australia, Britain, or Mexico, we’re excited to have you onboard to mark this moment together! 

Starting Thursday, October 13, experience our new Series Intro the next time you play Forza Horizon 5 in the first chapter of the [b]Horizon Origins[/b]. Take a trip down memory lane with Bass Arena’s Scott Tyler and experience what made each Horizon game so incredibly special. Complete all five chapters of this Horizon Story to unlock the [b]2013 Dodge SRT Viper GTS Anniversary Edition[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/bd0490c537af58eb4c1ceaabb76e752d7c04f322.jpg[/img]

Mexico is also joining in the festivities as Forza Horizon 5’s map is redecorated for the Horizon 10-Year Anniversary. Look out for classic flags, gantries, displays and towers in races that recreate the vibes and essence of our past Horizon Festivals. 

Before we dive any further, here’s a look at the overall Series Rewards: 
[list]
[*][b]80 PTS:[/b] 2013 Wuling Sunshine S 
[*][b]160 PTS:[/b] 2015 McLaren 650S Coupe [/list]
Our [b]Monthly Rivals[/b] features the [b]2013 Dodge Viper SRT GTS Anniversary Edition[/b] on the Lookout Circuit. Meanwhile in [b]Forza EV[/b], test drive the [b]2018 Jaguar I-Pace[/b] on the Arch of Mulegé and set your fastest lap time! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/20b49e85b6fdb6700654adc69af107c721760613.jpg[/img]

Are you ready to party like it’s 2012? The first week of this Playlist, available through Thursday, October 20, features two unmissable reward cars – including the one driven by Darius Flynt, Forza Horizon’s notorious antagonist: 
[list]
[*][b]20 PTS:[/b] 2010 Ferrari 599XX 
[*][b]40 PTS:[/b] 1968 Plymouth Barracuda Formula-S  [/list]
Each week, a new Festival site will be temporarily setup in Mexico in celebration of the past games. Week 1 celebrates Forza Horizon’s Colorado in the [b]Copper Canyon[/b] – smash [b]10 Horizon Colorado Bonus Boards[/b] while there to unlock the [b]2013 Dodge SRT Viper GTS[/b]. Capture it to complete this week’s [b]Photo Challenge[/b] rewarding the [b]Colorado Cover Car[/b] horn. Don’t step out just yet because you’ll also need Forza Horizon’s cover car in the [b]Weekly Forzathon[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2828f0e830bc570c2355e23dba74ea63525c1657.png[/img]

It’s a Stock Showdown in [b]The Trial[/b]. Prove your mastery of the [b]2013 Ford Shelby GT500[/b] to win the [b]2012 Hennessey Venom GT[/b]. 

Two new unmissable [b]EventLab[/b] creations await! Take on [b]The Backroads[/b] from Veixity, a Street Race through a shipping port depot filled with trash, industrial work, a gas station, and narrow straights to win the [b]Take Off[/b] emote. Meanwhile, GT Deny presents [b]Coastal Town Circuit Pro[/b]. Race around two color-filled laps featuring coastal hotels and bars. Utilize those straights to their fullest potential and make your move to unlock the [b]Star 27 Sundress[/b]. 

A trio of [b]Super Wheelspins[/b] await in this week’s [b]Seasonal PR Stunts[/b]! Prove your love of Forza Horizon’s [b]Speed Traps[/b] by setting new records at [b]Horizon Baja[/b], [b]East Resort[/b] and [b]Pantano Pass[/b]. Head over to [b]Hot Wheels Park[/b] and break the [b]Forest Edge[/b] record for another [b]Super Wheelspin[/b].  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/529d4fe6c9916491245f4e0c74ae019cae788093.jpg[/img]

Emerge first place in this week’s [b]Seasonal Championships[/b] to expand your driving adventures with the [b]1995 Volkswagen Corrado VR6[/b], the [b]2013 Ford Shelby GT500[/b] and the first of our weekly music rewards for [b]Horizon Mixtape, “Language”[/b] by Porter Robinson – the start screen song as seen in Forza Horizon. Take on the Dragons at [b]Hot Wheels Park[/b] and the [b]2012 Jeep Wrangler Rubicon[/b] will be yours. 

Complete a [b]Custom Road Racing[/b] event in this week’s [b]Horizon Open[/b] challenge to unlock the [b]Countdown Timer[/b] car horn and never miss another calendar appointment! Test your luck in [b]Super7[/b] and you could add the [b]2008 Dodge Viper SRT10 ACR[/b] to your garage. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/eec171a5c71719b0afbc7ea506a8a78ed0ca8834.png[/img]

Lastly, over in the [b]Forzathon Shop[/b] you will find the [b]1965 Shelby Cobra 427 S/C[/b] and [b]2019 Hennessey VelociRaptor 6x6[/b], as well as the [b]Quick Draw[/b] emote, the [b]Horizon Colorado Tee[/b] and the [b]Legacy Rewind[/b] car horn. You have one week to get them, so don’t miss out! 

That’s your roundup of all things happening at Horizon Mexico during this one-week celebration of Forza Horizon’s Colorado. Next week, it’s all about Southern Europe and Forza Horizon 2. Until then, we’ll see you at the festival.

notes.title: Forza Horizon 5 Celebrates The Horizon 10-Year Anniversary
notes.content:
[h2]The Horizon 10-Year Anniversary is almost here, and Horizon Mexico is ready to celebrate the incredible milestone as Forza Horizon 5 players are invited to relive some of the series’ most iconic gameplay moments.[/h2]

Available to download on Tuesday, October 11 across Xbox consoles, Windows PCs and Steam, the Horizon 10-Year Anniversary Update includes an all-new Horizon Origins Story, the returning Midnight Battles game mode where you can score rare cars by winning intense head-to-head races, and fan-favorite festival music coming to your radio dial on Horizon Mixtape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/68c944eb55c906eecdc86f45fea8d6b02e4f3ebb.jpg[/img]
[i]Note: The Horizon Origins Story will be playable from Thursday, October 13 once the new Festival Playlist series has officially started.[/i]

October 11 only marks the start of these festivities however, as a four-week anniversary themed Festival Playlist follows from October 13 with the opportunity to unlock iconic cars from past Horizon games, new cosmetics for your character and additional Horizon Mixtape songs.

For those who have yet to jump into Forza Horizon, there has never been a better time to experience the world’s greatest automotive festival. Starting October 11 on the Microsoft Store – and from October 13 on Steam – save up to 67% on Forza Horizon 4 and up to 30% on Forza Horizon 5. These discounts will be available through October 24.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a281418ac7e9d741ef8ee013dd12eabebca37662.jpg[/img]

There’s a lot to cover in this forthcoming Forza Horizon 5 update, so let’s dive in!

[h2]Game Fixes & Release Notes[/h2]

Every month, Forza Horizon 5 receives new game fixes and quality-of-life improvements as part of its series updates, and the Horizon 10-Year Anniversary update is no different.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/56d4ad8fa04eb0b5e2fe7028f184001c72a45c38.jpg[/img]

Here’s a look at some of the most notable changes that you can look forward to:
[list]
[*]We’ve fixed an issue with EventLab props disappearing after publishing Blueprints with a high-prop count. Creators will need to edit and republish those Blueprints to ensure the number of props is in line with the budget limitation displayed on-screen, which is now functioning as intended.
[*]We’re making improvements to how the Club Tag is surfaced for players, so it more reliably shows in-game beside their Gamertag. This change only affects players who are present in a Club.
[*]We’ve calmed the intense camera shake that could occur while driving since the release of the Series 10 Update.
[*]Forza Horizon 5: Hot Wheels has received physics improvements for certain cars that could detach from the magnet at high-speed.
[*]ASL and BSL cinematics have been added to the Hot Wheels Horizon Story.
[*]We’ve fixed an issue with force-feedback load sensitivity that caused the steering wheel to pull to the right.
[*]Compatibility has been added for the Logitech G Pro Steering Wheel.
[*]An issue where there was little to no sound for cars introduced in the Horizon Road Trip update for some players has been fixed.
[*]On PC, we’ve fixed incorrect instances of the “Drivers are wrong” error message being displayed. Also, terrain deformation should now work as intended for AMD GPU users.
[*]An issue that caused black pixels to appear on-screen for players with TAA enabled has been fixed. [/list]As always, the full list of fixes and improvements will be shared in our release notes once the update is available to download next week. We’re listening closely to your Forza Horizon 5 feedback as new fixes are introduced in each series update. Here’s where you can stay up to date on the issues that we’re currently investigating.

[h2]Horizon Origins[/h2]

Take a trip down memory lane with Bass Arena disc jockey Scott Tyler in Horizon Origins, the newest Horizon Story in Forza Horizon 5 that celebrates the history of the Forza Horizon series.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d73aa2cfba2306481654ad88071ac4624da3539a.jpg[/img]

Across five chapters, relive some of the series’ most iconic gameplay moments starting with Forza Horizon 5 as you go back in time. Complete all chapters and you’ll unlock the 2013 Dodge SRT Viper GTS Anniversary Edition, a unique variant that pays homage to the original Forza Horizon cover car.

[h2]2013 Dodge SRT Viper GTS Anniversary Edition[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/bd0490c537af58eb4c1ceaabb76e752d7c04f322.jpg[/img]
[i]Complete the Horizon Origins story featured in the Horizon 10-Year Anniversary update.[/i]

As the first Forza Horizon cover car, it only felt fitting to introduce this exclusive new variant to celebrate the game’s 10-Year Anniversary. At the heart of this road-devouring snake is a totally refined all-aluminum, mid-engine, 8.4-liter V10 delivering a class-topping 640 horsepower and 600 lb-ft of torque. It’s utterly contemporary in its design, and the 2013 Viper’s gorgeous lines are at once sophisticated and hostile—form and function meeting in a sweet spot of automotive aggression. In short, the 2013 Viper’s stunning design will turn heads and its powerful performance will make sure those heads turn very, very quickly.

[h2]Midnight Battles[/h2]

Mexico’s Street Scene is about to evolve as the adrenaline-fueled Midnight Battles mode is coming to Forza Horizon 5. First originated in Australia, these head-to-head races will reward the competitor’s car to the player if they successfully win.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/b5bb28f5bf2f063e160bd90b5769cd871fbe8752.jpg[/img]

A new Midnight Battle is unlocked for every four victories you have in the Street Scene following the release of the Horizon 10-Year Anniversary update – a total of 16 race wins are required to unlock them all.

If you’d like to break some world records, all Midnight Battle routes will also be available in the Rivals section for you to set your best lap times on.

Four hard-to-find cars are up for grabs, including:

[h2]1971 Ford Mustang Mach 1[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/62577edf5ac571a79f787ff21946de54534d39a4.jpg[/img]
[i]Win four race events in the Horizon Street Scene, then win the first Midnight Battle.[/i]

To understand the Mustang Mach 1, you must understand era that produced it. Car development cycles start several years before the car hits dealerships, and the late 1960s saw the flourishing of ever-larger, more powerful muscle cars that overshadowed the pony car segment the Mustang invented. Solution: a larger, more powerful, more stylish Mustang. More wedge-shaped and angular, it was certainly aggressive. The Mach 1 was the most aggressive of them all, with a blacked-out honeycomb grille, bold contrasting graphics, and the requisite scoops and ducts. Unusually for the 1970s, the Mach 1 features a body-colored front bumper for an integrated look—a design feature that would soon become commonplace. Mach 1s came in many engine flavors, but this Mach 1 sports the most incredible of them all—the 429 CJ-R (Cobra Jet with ram-air). The dual NACA-style hoodscoops are quite functional, channeling cold oxygen-rich air to the hungry engine. The result is a 375-horsepower dragstrip monster, perfect for ruining rear tires. It also handled a lot better than the previous generation Boss 429, designed from the outset to handle such a massive engine and therefore equipped with more appropriate suspension. In the waning days of the muscle car era, the Mustang had finally matured.

[h2]1984 Honda Civic CRX Mugen[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/cd865b33c9e2806d54340853aa0be76f274da23e.jpg[/img]
[i]Win eight race events in the Horizon Street Scene, then win the second Midnight Battle.[/i]

The partnership between Honda and Mugen began with the CRX. It was an inevitable collaboration given that Mugen was formed by Hirotoshi Honda – the son of Honda founder Soichiro Honda – and veteran racer Masao Kimura. The CRX, or CR-X as it is called in Japan, carried an aggressive effort to establish Mugen in the United States. At the time, any Honda dealer could order and sell Mugen parts, and a select few became Mugen Performance Centers. The program only lasted three years but yielded a handful of uprated Mugen CRXs and many street-tuned Hondas. Dressed in the Mugen body kit, the CRX’s short, stout lines are tastefully enhanced without complicating them. A trademark feature of the Mugen CRX is the twin-pipe muffler or “Silencer Set.” With nearly 120 horsepower, a limited slip differential, and weighing in at a mere 1,800 pounds, the Mugen CRX is a thrill to drive and inspired a new generation of Honda tuners. Mugen has gone on to contribute to Honda’s racing success in Formula One and sports car racing, but it all started here with the CRX.

[h2]2003 Toyota Celica SS-I[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/6940a4c33b2ea7dbd5dab4797f7a4e693cdf7e51.jpg[/img]
[i]Win 12 race events in the Horizon Street Scene, then win the third Midnight Battle.[/i]

Powered by a 1.8-litre 2ZZ-GE engine, which significantly reduced the weight of the vehicle when compared to its predecessor, the 2003 Toyota Celica SS-I is the seventh and final model generation of the Celica line produced from 1999 to 2006. Unique in contrast to its previous renditions, the SS-I was only made available in front-wheel-drive across all trim levels. The hatchback sport coupé can produce 187 horses at 133 lb-ft of torque and gave drivers a choice of either a five or six-speed manual transmission. The car’s iconic shape is characterized by a long wheelbase and a short overhang, as well as vertically slit headlamps, a dynamic side view, and the poised rear styling. Now is your chance to relive this iconic Japanese compact car, but you’ll need to master the Horizon Street Scene before it’s yours! Are you ready for the challenge ahead?

[h2]2010 Lamborghini Murciélago LP 670-4 SV[/h2]

[i]Win 16 race events in the Horizon Street Scene, then win the fourth Midnight Battle.[/i]

The Murciélago LP 670-4 SV may be a mouthful, but consider it shorthand for one of the fastest Raging Bulls ever to roar out of Lamborghini’s Sant’Agata plant. Fitting, because the “SV” tag stands for SuperVeloce—Italian for “superfast,” and Lamborghini only uses the SV name for the most highly-tuned final edition of a model going out of production. The SV modifications for the Murciélago certainly fit the bill, managing 661 horsepower (the “670” in the name is the metric horsepower rating) from the latest generation of the 40-year-old Lamborghini V12. Of course, nearly every part of the engine has been updated and optimized over its lifespan, which should be apparent as it warbles by at full throttle. In addition, the SV was put on a diet of carbon-fiber, trimming 220 pounds, and adding spoilers and side scoops crafted from bare carbon-fiber. The Murciélago was already a stunner, and the LP 670-4 SV is a fitting send-off to one of the most ferocious supercars to ever wear the bull of Sant’Agata.

[h2]Horizon Mixtape[/h2]

Great music is at the heart of the Horizon Festival. No road-trip is complete without an iconic playlist, and the Forza Horizon games have always offered a curated selection of unforgettable songs across its diverse line-up of radio stations to enrich your driving adventures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/63c1e38c3f74d2fb978bc8045ce1f0b0b02cbca5.jpg[/img]

To celebrate 10 years of driving to incredible music, Forza Horizon 5’s radio dial is set to receive a new permanent station. Hosted by Bass Arena disc jockey Scott Tyler, the Horizon Mixtape brings together some of the greatest music featured in the Forza Horizon series over the years.

Unlock new songs for the Horizon Mixtape by completing Accolades as part of the Horizon Origins Story and expand your playlist with the iconic music that featured in previous Horizon start screens by winning the relevant Seasonal Championships on the Festival Playlist.

[h2]EventLab Prop Pack[/h2]

EventLab is expanding its Blueprint Builder Library with 97 recognizable props and structures from previous Forza Horizon games. These are divided into four subcategories: Colorado, Europe, Australia and UK.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/df4173ffc12a1ce4523d24d19ecb7d0225642dc6.jpg[/img]

Some of the highlights include Horizon Festival entrance arches and decorations, barn finds, a variety of pipes, the iconic yacht from Forza Horizon 2, and skyscrapers from Forza Horizon 3’s Surfers Paradise – and yes, you can drive on top of them! In addition, look out for new steel works and conveyor belts with snapping functionality.

[h2]Festival Playlist[/h2]

The Festival Playlist in Forza Horizon 5 celebrates 10 years of the Horizon Festival with a classic Horizon game in the spotlight each week as well as tailored activities and rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d1825e55d41f04265f3145f6d33149a495827996.jpg[/img]

While you check out the latest events, listen out for a familiar voice as Horizon Bass Arena DJ Scott Tyler is on standby to announce what’s happening on the Festival Playlist.

You’ll also be able to launch into the first chapter of the Horizon Origins Story directly from the Festival Playlist. This is the Series Intro of the Horizon 10-Year Anniversary, and upon its completion, you’ll unlock access to the rest of the Horizon Story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2472b772e596dfcbca3e962393f4d8672f127bf4.jpg[/img]

New cosmetics that celebrate the history of Forza Horizon games are coming to the Festival Playlist, including a selection of anniversary themed clothing items, emotes and car horns:

[b]Clothing:[/b]
